translation: 什么？

text: [Confidently] I'm a guest of the State. If you'd like, you can detain me while we establish that beyond doubt. But I wouldn't recommend it.
translation: [自信] 我是邦国的贵宾。你愿意的话，可以先把我扣下来，再去彻底核实这件事。不过我不建议你这么做。

text: [Wink. Begin to whistle a martial tune. Drum my fingers on the Bewitching tool.]
translation: [眨眨眼。开始吹一段军乐口哨。手指在魅惑工具上敲出节奏。]

text: But I would like to make a contribution to the Milice. Forty francisques.
translation: 不过我倒愿意给法国民兵捐点钱。四十法兰西斧币。

text: I'm afraid I've come out without any form of identification.
translation: 恐怕我出门时没带任何身份证明。

text: Unacceptable!
translation: 不可接受！

text: I have no more time for your insolences. Go away.
translation: 我没时间再听你这些无礼之言。走开。

text: [Go away.]
translation: [走开。]

text: Here - I'm a citizen of the State.
translation: 这里——我是邦国公民。

text: I wondered whether I could be of any assistance to the Milice. I have experience as a private inquiry agent.
translation: 我在想，自己能不能为法国民兵出一份力。我做过私人调查员。

text: Interesting. Most interesting. Yes. Bring me the names of malcontents, and I will bestow upon you a little gift. Five hundred francisques.
translation: 有意思。非常有意思。可以。把不满分子的名字交给我，我会给你一份小礼物。五百法兰西斧币。

text: The State is generous, to pay so freely for information.
translation: 邦国真慷慨，为情报出手这么大方。

text: The State is generous. But this is my personal initiative, you see? I use my own funds to incentivise public service. When the information is accurate, my service is recognised.
translation: 邦国当然慷慨。不过你看，这是我的个人行动。我拿自己的钱来激励公共服务。只要情报准确，我的功劳就会得到认可。

text: And when the information is not accurate? I have two names to give my superiors. So beware! Milice Léon has learnt to sniff out lies.
translation: 要是情报不准确呢？那我就有两个名字可以交给上级。所以小心！民兵莱昂已经学会闻出谎言的味道了。

text: He sneezes.
translation: 他打了个喷嚏。

text: The Milice, monsieur, does not offer such a service. Remove your lusts to the houses of tolerance.
translation: 先生，法国民兵不提供这种服务。请把你的欲望带去合法妓院解决。

text: I knew there was something!
translation: 我就知道有蹊跷！

text: It is sad. In all honesty, I am not surprised. She has always been insolent, that Linou. But now, we have someone to testify for us, should it be necessary - no?
translation: 真可悲。说实话，我并不意外。那个利努向来无礼。不过现在，若有必要，我们总算有人可以作证了——不是吗？

text: [Accept 500 Francisques]
translation: [收下 500 法兰西斧币]

text: Perhaps I might take my payment in kind? Information, I mean?
translation: 也许我可以用实物收取报酬？我是说，用情报。

text: I'll need to consult with my superiors. Wait here.
translation: 我得请示上级。你在这里等着。

text: I will consider your proposal.
translation: 我会考虑你的提议。

text: I'm looking for a woman - [[Nina Lagasse]]. I wonder if the Milice knows where to find her.
translation: 我在找一个女人——[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。我在想，法国民兵会不会知道去哪儿找她。

text: Lagasse. You have a description?
translation: 拉加斯。你有她的外貌描述吗？

text: Pale as marble.
translation: 白如大理石。

text: White as milk.
translation: 白得像牛奶。

text: Where she goes, she is remembered.
translation: 她去过的地方，人们都会记住她。

text: Wait... Lagasse. She is a widow?
translation: 等等……拉加斯。她是个寡妇？

text: She wears black, certainly.
translation: 至少她确实穿黑衣。

text: Perhaps she is in mourning, yes.
translation: 也许她是在服丧，是。

text: I know exactly. You will find her at the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui, past the park.
translation: 我知道了。你会在今日疗养院找到她，就在公园那边。

text: But you will be respectful when you call upon the Sanitarium. The director is a man of importance. Do not let me hear of you causing difficulties.
translation: 不过你去疗养院拜访时必须保持礼貌。院长是个重要人物。别让我听说你在那里惹了麻烦。

text: And do not mention the name of Milicien Léon.
translation: 也别提民兵莱昂的名字。

text: Thank you, Milicien.
translation: 谢谢你，民兵先生。

text: [Nod and leave.]
translation: [点头离开。]

text: Thank you, Milicien. Something else...
translation: 谢谢你，民兵先生。还有一件事……

text: Vive l'Amiral!
translation: 海军上将万岁!

text: Vive l'Amiral!
translation: 海军上将万岁!

text: [Nod weakly.]
translation: [虚弱地点点头。]

text: Vive l'Amiral.
translation: 海军上将万岁。

text: I mentioned earlier that I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: 我之前提过，我在找一个叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人……

text: No no - I mean that I'm trying to locate an acquaintance. Nina Lagasse.
translation: 不不——我的意思是，我在找一位熟人。尼娜·拉加斯。

text: Of course. I apologise for the misunderstanding.
translation: 当然。是我误会了，抱歉。

text: Nevertheless. In my private capacity... when I am off duty... I can make introductions for you. Girls of a generous temperament. With their papers of good health, all up to date.
translation: 不过，以我的私人身份……等我下班以后……我倒可以替你介绍。性情慷慨的姑娘。健康证明一应俱全，而且都在有效期内。

text: [Léon looks faintly disappointed, then rallies.]
translation: [莱昂看起来有一点失望，随即又振作起来。]

text: Neither does the Milice serve as an office of information.
translation: 同样，法国民兵也不充当情报处。

text: Most kind, Milicien. I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 太客气了，民兵先生。我会记着的。

text: [Nod neutrally.]
translation: [平静地点头。]

text: Here - I'm a citizen of the Republic.
translation: 这里——我是共和国公民。

text: Here - I'm a subject of her Majesty.
translation: 这里——我是女王陛下的臣民。

text: Here - I'm a citizen of the Republic.
translation: 这里——我是共和国公民。

text: May his boots always be the shiniest.
translation: 愿他的靴子永远擦得最亮。

text: Long may his reputation survive without further tarnish.
translation: 愿他的名声长存，而且别再添新的污点。

text: May he jolly well sort everything out!
translation: 愿他赶紧把这一切都收拾妥当！

text: Oh yes! Vive, what?
translation: 哦，对！万岁，什么来着？

text: This is in order. You may go about your business, monsieur. Unless there was something else?
translation: 证件没有问题。您可以去办自己的事了，先生。还有别的事吗？

text: Acceptable, I suppose. Was there anything else?
translation: 我想还算可以。还有别的事吗？

text: Acceptable, I suppose. Was there anything else?
translation: 我想还算可以。还有别的事吗？

text: This appears to be in order, Monsieur Hobson. Unless there was something else?
translation: 这份证件看起来没有问题，霍布森先生。还有别的事吗？

text: This document would be satisfactory... except that you told me, earlier, that your name was [q=alias.last]. This is an entirely different name.
translation: 这份文件本来可以通过……可您先前告诉我，您的姓是[q=alias.last]。这上面完全是另一个名字。

text: Let me see.
translation: 让我看看。

text: I am not familiar with... well, yes, hm...
translation: 我不太熟悉……嗯，是，唔……

text: I am not familiar with... well, yes, hm...
translation: 我不太熟悉……嗯，是，唔……

text: Well, we cannot choose where we are born. [A snuffle of hilarity.] Let me see.
translation: 唉，人没法选择自己出生在哪里。[他忍俊不禁地哼了一声。] 让我看看。

text: [q=alias.last]? I can't honestly call to mind anyone of that name  - you mean me? No no no - I'm afraid you must have me confused with someone else. I know how busy are the Milice.
translation: [q=alias.last]？说实话，我完全想不起有谁叫这个名字——你说的是我？不不不——恐怕您把我跟别人弄混了。我知道法国民兵很忙。

text: ...perhaps, after all, you're right. Very well.
translation: ……也许，到头来你是对的。很好。

text: I'm certain that was the name you gave.
translation: 我很确定你当时说的就是这个名字。

text: [q=alias.last]? Excuse me - do I look like a [q=alias.last]?
translation: [q=alias.last]？劳驾——你看我像一个[q=alias.last]吗？

text: Hm. Eh. Very well.
translation: 嗯。呃。很好。

text: I think that in fact you do.
translation: 我觉得你其实挺像。

text: I have no excuses. I can only throw myself upon the mercy of the State.
translation: 我无话可辩。只能请求邦国宽恕。

text: Léon looks surprised, then delighted. He unfastens his truncheon from his belt.
translation: 莱昂先是一惊，随即喜出望外。他解开腰间警棍的扣带。

text: [Shrug] Lock me up, if you like.
translation: [耸肩] 你想抓就抓吧。

text: In the name of the State, I place you under arrest! Come with me, immediately.
translation: 以邦国之名，我宣布逮捕你！立刻跟我走！

text: [Follow Léon, gloweringly.]
translation: [阴沉着脸跟莱昂走。]

text: [Follow Léon as far as the edge of the square... then feint sideways and make a dash for it.]
translation: [跟着莱昂走到广场边缘……然后突然向侧面虚晃一步，拔腿就跑。]

text: Stop! Help! Traitors! Stop!
translation: 站住！来人！叛徒！站住！

text: [Career round a corner, arrow towards an alley...]
translation: [猛冲过街角，直奔一条小巷……]

text: Splash through a puddle - turn my ankle in a hidden hole -
translation: 踩进水洼——脚踝在一个看不见的坑里猛地一扭——

text: Splash through a puddle -
translation: 踩进水洼——

text: [Cry out in fury. Stagger onwards.]
translation: [愤怒地叫出声。踉跄着继续跑。]

text: [Bite my lip to stay silent. Limp onwards.]
translation: [咬住嘴唇不出声。一瘸一拐继续跑。]

text: Léon cries out in exultation, but already he's panting. Hobbled as I am, I'm still faster.
translation: 莱昂兴奋地大叫，可他已经开始喘了。就算我腿脚受伤，还是比他快。

text: His bellows are lost in thunder. The windows stay closed. The streets stay empty.
translation: 他的吼声被雷鸣吞没。窗户紧闭，街道依旧空无一人。

text: Léon knows the streets, and I don't. But I'm still faster.
translation: 莱昂认得这些街巷，我不认得。但我依然更快。

text: But once, whispers the coming night, you were too slow.
translation: 可将至的夜低声提醒：曾经有一次，你太慢了。

text: [Léon is far behind.]
translation: [莱昂已经远远落在后面。]

text: [Out through the rain-curtain, into bright sunlight.]
translation: [冲出雨幕，闯进明亮的阳光。]

text: [Run on, slowing now.]
translation: [继续跑，渐渐放慢脚步。]

text: I'm watching you.
translation: 我盯着你呢。

text: Out of the square; down a narrow street to the back of a hulking building.
translation: 冲出广场；沿一条窄街跑到一栋庞然大楼的背后。

text: Enter.
translation: 进去。

text: [Pass through the door.]
translation: [穿门而过。]

text: [Feint, then bolt.]
translation: [虚晃一下，然后拔腿就跑。]

text: Léon unlocks a grilled door and gestures.
translation: 莱昂打开一扇带铁栅的门，做了个手势。

text: Here's a mean little door, badly painted in distemper-yellow.
translation: 这里有一扇寒酸的小门，刷着劣质的灰泥黄漆。

text: In here!
translation: 进来！

text: Through the door into a concrete corridor lined with ratty carpet and lit by a single bulb. Far off, an electric bell rings twice.
translation: 穿过门，是一条混凝土走廊，铺着破旧地毯，只靠一只灯泡照明。远处，一只电铃响了两声。

text: [Into the room. The cell?]
translation: [走进房间。牢房？]

text: Not a cell. But not a hotel room. Windowless, with stacked chairs, stacked crates, a stack of yellowing newspapers on a tilted tabletop.
translation: 不是牢房。可也不像旅馆客房。没有窗，椅子摞着椅子，木箱叠着木箱，一摞发黄的报纸斜堆在桌面上。

text: My colleagues and I - we will teach you respect.
translation: 我和同僚们——会教会你什么叫尊重。

text: Rattling his keys with ceremonious delight, Léon locks the door behind me.
translation: 莱昂郑重其事、喜气洋洋地晃着钥匙，把我锁在门后。

text: [Listen to his footsteps retreat down the corridor.]
translation: [听着他的脚步沿走廊远去。]

text: Near-silence. A burst of incoherent yelling from somewhere upstairs.
translation: 几乎一片寂静。楼上某处忽然爆出一阵听不清内容的叫喊。

text: [Wait.]
translation: [等候。]

text: [Whistle jauntily.]
translation: [轻快地吹口哨。]

text: [Open the door and step out.]
translation: [打开门，走出去。]

text: The light-bulb fizzes faintly. Léon is definitely gone.
translation: 灯泡发出轻微的滋滋声。莱昂肯定已经走了。

text: In this place, the sound is flat as stale water.
translation: 这个地方的声音扁平得像一潭馊水。

text: The door swings open. No-one in the corridor.
translation: 门摆开了。走廊里没人。

text: 'Land of Hope and Glory.'
translation: 《希望与荣光之地》。

text: 'Daphne.'
translation: 《达芙妮》。

text: Try to lock me in, will you? Cretins.
translation: 想把我锁起来？蠢货。

text: [Out into the street.]
translation: [走到街上。]

text: Léon shakes his head vaguely. He tilts his head as if he can hear martial music. Above, the flag snaps in the rising wind.
translation: 莱昂茫然地摇了摇头。他歪过脑袋，像是听见了军乐。头顶上，旗帜在渐强的风里猎猎作响。

text: Desist!
translation: 住手！

text: The rain has drowned the joy of it. Or perhaps Léon just has no imagination at all.
translation: 雨水把其中的喜悦全浇没了。也可能莱昂根本毫无想象力。

text: Glory...
translation: 荣光……

text: Perhaps he's weeping. With the rain, it's difficult to be sure.
translation: 也许他在哭。雨这么大，很难分辨。

text: What... what was I saying?
translation: 我……我刚才说到哪了？

text: I suppose then you must be a man of means - a respectable man. You may bring me your papers later.
translation: 那我想，您一定是位有财力的体面人。以后再把证件拿给我看就行。

text: My honour is not negotiable!
translation: 我的荣誉不容收买！

text: Hmmf.
translation: 哼。

text: Bah. Bah! Did you think to frighten the Milice?
translation: 呸。呸！你以为能吓住法国民兵？

text: (Ididn'twanttoseeyourpapersanyway.)
translation: （反正我也不想看你的证件。）

text: Nothing. Good day.
translation: 没什么。日安。

text: Invariably. On this side of town.
translation: 一向如此。城这一边总下。

text: And on the other side of town?
translation: 那城的另一边呢？

text: [Insincere] And you out here on duty? I'm sorry.
translation: [假惺惺] 你还得在这种天气里执勤？真遗憾。

text: [Sincere] And you out here on duty? I'm sorry.
translation: [真诚] 你还得在这种天气里执勤？真遗憾。

text: Invariably, it does not rain.
translation: 一向不下。

text: It is nothing.
translation: 没什么。

text: If I hear anything, I'll let you know.
translation: 要是听到什么，我会告诉你。

text: Good.
translation: 好。

text: If I bring you this kind of information... will you help me find [[Nina Lagasse]]?
translation: 如果我给你带来这类情报……你会帮我找到[[尼娜·拉加斯]]吗？

text: Most certainly. The State rewards loyalty.
translation: 当然。邦国会奖励忠诚。

text: [Put as much distance between me and the Milice place as quickly as possible.]
translation: [尽快离法国民兵的据点越远越好。]

text: [Keep my movements slow, moving out of town into the quieter areas of the Cap d'Antibes.]
translation: [放慢动作，离开城区，走向昂蒂布海岬较为幽静的地带。]

text: [Through glistening streets, beneath blinded windows, past scar and wailing stone, and into the sun on the other side of town.]
translation: [走过泛光的街道，经过闭目般的窗户、伤疤与哀鸣的石头，最终从城市另一头走进阳光。]

text: [Move on, up the leaf-dappled slope between stately trees, to a pair of iron gates.]
translation: [继续前行，沿庄严树木之间那条洒着叶影的坡道向上，来到一对铁门前。]

text: [On the wall beside the gate, a white bird sits: an albino crow? It cocks its head at me and blinks a gem-black eye.]
translation: [大门旁的墙上停着一只白鸟：白化乌鸦？它歪头看我，宝石般漆黑的眼睛眨了一下。]

text: It launches itself into the air, and flaps off in the direction of the building behind the gates.
translation: 它振翅飞起，朝铁门后方的建筑飞去。

text: 'In the name of the [[Beach-Crow]], who opens the earth, who sees what is lost...'
translation: “以[[滩鸦]]之名——祂开启大地，祂看见失落之物……”

text: [Follow Léon, cheerfully.]
translation: [兴高采烈地跟着莱昂走。]

text: 'In the name of the [[Ivory Dove]], who cannot be deceived, who calls each of the Dead by name...'
translation: “以[[骨白鸽]]之名——祂不受欺瞒，祂逐一唤出每一位死者之名……”

text: Well... I know an omen when I see one.
translation: 嗯……看见预兆的时候，我总认得出来。

text: [Nod knowingly.]
translation: [心照不宣地点头。]

text: Nina... is she here?
translation: 尼娜……她在这里吗？

text: [Let's find out.]
translation: [去弄清楚。]

text: Thank you, Milicien. But I just want to be close to you. [Simper.]
translation: 谢谢你，民兵先生。不过我只是想靠你近一点。[娇笑。]

text: Enough!
translation: 够了！

text: Hm... so here we are at the heart of the matter.
translation: 嗯……这就说到问题的核心了。

text: [Reply frivolously.]
translation: [轻佻地回答。]

text: An aristocratic name. In fact, 'François' is the Admiral's first name.
translation: 一个贵族气的名字。事实上，“弗朗索瓦”正是那位海军上将的名字。

text: [Consider my papers - what do I have?]
translation: [想想我的证件——手头有什么？]

text: [I have no papers I'm willing to show the milicien.]
translation: [我没有愿意给这个民兵看的证件。]

text: Apparently, the matter of my papers has been forgotten.
translation: 看来，我证件的问题已经被忘掉了。

text: In the name of the State! Stop!
translation: 以邦国之名！站住！

text: [Stop. Raise my hands and smile disarmingly.] Well, for the State...
translation: [停下。举起双手，露出讨好的笑容。] 好吧，既然是为了邦国……

text: Léon seizes my arm, glaring, to drag me back the other way.
translation: 莱昂瞪着我，一把抓住我的胳膊，要把我往回拖。

text: [Keep running.]
translation: [继续跑。]

text: [Saunter towards the building, whistling 'Land of Hope and Glory'.]
translation: [悠闲地朝大楼走去，嘴里吹着《希望与荣光之地》。]

text: [Saunter towards the building, whistling 'Daphne'.]
translation: [悠闲地朝大楼走去，嘴里吹着《达芙妮》。]

text: [TEST] Straight to Sanitarium
translation: [测试] 直接前往疗养院

text: Beyond the gates, a sign reads SANITARIUM AUJOURD'HUI.
translation: 铁门后的一块牌子上写着：今日疗养院。

text: [Look around.]
translation: [四下看看。]

text: Léon returns, smiling.
translation: 莱昂笑着回来了。

text: It's done. The State thanks you.
translation: 办妥了。邦国感谢你。

text: There are... abysses of night... in Antibes.
translation: 有……黑夜的深渊……在昂蒂布。

text: And?
translation: 然后呢？

text: No-one mentioned them.
translation: 没人提过这事。

text: Shouldn't someone... put up some sort of sign?
translation: 难道就不该有人……立块什么警示牌吗？

text: A strong state discourages frivolous chatter.
translation: 强大的国家会遏止轻浮的闲言碎语。

text: Pff. The wise walk round them. Drunks and imbeciles do not. The State loses nothing but dross.
translation: 啧。聪明人会绕着走。醉鬼和白痴不会。邦国损失的也不过是渣滓。

text: If you search the cafe - Chez Felix - you'll find a store of illicit goods.
translation: 如果你搜查那间咖啡馆——费利克斯之家——会找到一批违禁品。

text: I suspected as much. For a while now, I have had my eye on that woman.
translation: 我早就有所怀疑。那个女人，我已经盯了一阵子了。

text: Linou at the café is selling real coffee. In secret.
translation: 咖啡馆里的利努在偷偷卖真正的咖啡。

text: You are prepared to testify, if we need you later? Publicly, in court?
translation: 以后有需要时，你会出庭作证吧？公开地，在法庭上？

text: No. I would prefer to remain anonymous.
translation: 不会。我希望保持匿名。

text: Of course.
translation: 当然。

text: Disappointing. Return when you have found your courage.
translation: 令人失望。等你找回勇气再来。

text: Good.
translation: 好。

text: Just my little joke.
translation: 只是开个小玩笑。

text: Mme Zèlia - in the park - tried to commission me to place a curse on another citizen.
translation: 泽莉亚夫人——公园里那位——想雇我给另一位公民下诅咒。

text: 'A curse.'
translation: “诅咒。”

text: Secondly, the law does not recognise 'curses'. But the law does recognise fraud. I will give you an example of fraud. Let us say some ferret-faced foreigner promised Mme Badat he could lay a 'curse' for her, in exchange for money. I hope you did not accept money from her?
translation: 第二，法律并不承认什么“诅咒”。但法律承认诈骗。举个诈骗的例子吧。假设有个雪貂脸的外国人向巴达夫人保证，只要给钱，他就能替她下“诅咒”。我希望你没有从她那里收钱？

text: Firstly, that is Zèlia Badat you speak of - a patriot and a woman of excellent family. Watch what you say.
translation: 第一，你说的是泽莉亚·巴达——一位爱国者，也出身于优秀家庭。说话小心。

text: [Truth] Of course not.
translation: [实话] 当然没有。

text: I trust you did
translation: 我相信你没有

text: Of course not. But she seems a little confused. Someone else might take advantage. I thought you should know.
translation: 当然没有。不过她似乎有点糊涂。别人可能会趁机占她便宜。我觉得该让你知道。

text: Quite a lot, actually, but I've already spent it. Were you hoping for a bribe? Sorry!
translation: 其实收了不少，不过我已经花掉了。你是想收贿赂吗？抱歉！

text: For a moment, it looks as if Léon might burst entirely out of his uniform.
translation: 有那么一瞬间，莱昂看起来几乎要整个人从制服里炸出来。

text: Well... good.
translation: 好吧……很好。

text: You...!
Sorry, no coffee.
translation: 抱歉，没有咖啡。

text: 'Incorporate drink...'
translation: 「集团的饮料……」

text: That's it. 'American champagne', Aristide calls it.
translation: 正是。「美国香槟」，阿里斯蒂德是这么叫它的。

text: Tastes like what it tastes like. But there is a power in it. Keeps the spidermist from you.
translation: 它是什么味道，就是什么味道。可这里面有股力量，能让蛛雾近不了你的身。

text: [The nearest card player snuffles merrily around his pipe.]
translation: [离得最近的牌客就着烟斗，快活地吸着鼻息。]

text: Do I need to worry about spidermist here? in Antibes?
translation: 在昂蒂布这儿，我该担心蛛雾吗？

text: Not if you drink your Coca-Cola. [Linou winks.]
translation: 只要您喝您的可口可乐，就不会。[利努眨了眨眼。]

text: M'sieu.
translation: 先生。

text: Coffee, please. Black.
translation: 请来一杯咖啡。不加奶。

text: You'll have something?
translation: 您要来点什么？

text: [q=RecentPreferenceBeverageChezFelix]?
translation: [q=RecentPreferenceBeverageChezFelix]?

text: I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 「我在找一个女人,名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。」

text: What do you have here?
translation: 您这儿都有些什么？

text: Is that so?
translation: 是这样吗？

text: Order a coffee, then.
translation: 那就点杯咖啡吧。

text: I don't especially want a coffee.
translation: 我倒不是特别想喝咖啡。

text: Fortunate; since we have in fact no coffee.
translation: 万幸；因为我们确实没有咖啡。

text: [Consider ordering something.]
translation: [考虑点些什么。]

text: Coffee, please. Milk.
translation: 请来一杯咖啡。加奶。

text: A glass of white.
translation: 来一杯白的。

text: A glass of red.
translation: 来一杯红的。

text: Pastis.
translation: 茴香酒。

text: Camomile.
translation: 甘菊茶。

text: Young, sharp; it'd be better cold, but it's not so bad warm.
translation: 酒很年轻，滋味尖利；冰着喝更好，温着倒也不坏。

text: [Frown.]
translation: [皱眉。]

text: [She turns away.]
translation: [她转过身去。]

text: [Step back from the bar.]
translation: [从吧台前退开一步。]

text: Strong, warm, oaky, basically drinkable. Algerian, probably.
translation: 劲儿足，温吞，橡木味重，基本能喝。大概是阿尔及利亚的。

text: Clear amber louche-swirls into milk-yellow...
translation: 清澈的琥珀色泛起乳浊，旋成奶黄……

text: The familiar blossom-apple taste. Like a gently sanctimonious aunt.
translation: 熟悉的苹果花香。像一位温和而一本正经的姑母。

text: And this is my third!
translation: 这已经是我的第三杯了！

text: The nearest card-player calls out in a hoarse stage-whisper: 'Be careful! Linou always overcharges foreigners!'
translation: 最近的那位牌客哑着嗓子，以人人都听得见的耳语喊道：「当心！利努总是敲外国人的竹杠！」

text: Monsieur must forgive Aristide's manners. He becomes foolish with his second glass.
translation: 先生还请原谅阿里斯蒂德的失礼。他喝到第二杯就犯起傻来。

text: Do I sound like a foreigner?
translation: 我听起来像外国人吗？

text: [Smile politely.]
translation: [礼貌地微笑。]

text: Linou will be careful. She must understand that I am not easily deceived.
translation: 利努最好小心些。她得明白，我不是轻易能哄骗的。

text: We are entirely tolerant, chez Felix.
translation: 在费利克斯之家，我们向来宽容。

text: White, red, pastis, camomile. Or I have some bottles left of that Incorporate drink.
translation: 白的，红的，茴香酒，甘菊茶。或者，我还剩几瓶那种集团的饮料。

text: [Smile disarmingly] It's rare to find a place like this, in these times. You must be proud.
translation: [令人卸下防备地笑] 这年头，像这样的地方可不多见。您一定很为它骄傲。

text: Coca-Cola?
translation: 可口可乐？

text: Coca-Cola?
translation: 可口可乐？

text: Perhaps you'll have something, this time?
translation: 这一回，您或许会喝点什么？

text: Later, perhaps.
translation: 改日再说吧。

text: Then we will see you later. Perhaps.
translation: 那我们回头见。也许吧。

text: We were discussing [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 「我们刚才谈的是[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。」

text: I'm looking for a woman. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找一位女士。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: We were? I remember that you mentioned this Lagasse. But I remember no discussion.
translation: 我们谈过？我记得您提起过这位拉加斯。可我不记得谈过什么。

text: Poignant.
translation: 真是感人。

text: Linou polishes a glass.
translation: 利努擦拭着一只杯子。

text: I will hope for your reunion.
translation: 我会祈盼你们重逢。

text: [Spencer's behaviour influences NPC Opinions. Sometimes, a very high Opinion will unlock hidden choices. More rarely, a very low Opinion will unlock hidden choices. Just this once, we've made one choice visible below.]
translation: [斯宾塞的举止会影响 NPC 对你的看法。有时，极高的看法会解锁隐藏选项；更罕见的是，极低的看法也会解锁隐藏选项。仅此一次，我们让一个选项在下方可见。]

text: [Examine the photo behind the bar.]
translation: [细看吧台后那张照片。]

text: Coca-Cola, hm? You get many Americans here?
translation: 可口可乐，嗯？您这儿美国人来得多吗？

text: [Settle bill and go.]
translation: [结账，走人。]

text: A round of drinks for my new friends over there.
translation: 给那边我新结识的朋友们来一轮酒。

text: Red for Philomèle. Leopold and the idiot like their pastis. And a little of the good cognac for Jean-Bernard. One hundred francisques. For this one, it's best if you pay in advance.
translation: 红的给菲洛梅尔。利奥波德和那个呆子喝茴香酒。再给让-贝尔纳来点好干邑。一百枚法兰西斧币。这笔账，最好先付。

text: Don't forget to overcharge him, Linou!
translation: 别忘了多收他的钱，利努！

text: That's a little more than I was expecting.
translation: 这比我预想的要多些。

text: [Pay, and watch while Linou populates a wooden tray with wine, pastis, brandy.]
translation: [付钱，看着利努往木托盘上摆满葡萄酒、茴香酒和白兰地。]

text: And something for monsieur. [Linou adds a drink to the tray, and turns away.]
translation: 再给先生来一杯。[利努往托盘上添了一杯，转身走开。]

text: Is there anything I might want to do with the drinks before I take them over?
translation: 在把酒端过去之前，我有没有什么想对这些酒做的事？

text: [Touch their drinks with a giddy influence, to ensure they speak freely.]
translation: [用一缕令人醺然的影响轻触他们的酒杯，好让他们畅所欲言。]

text: [Mme Zèlia asked me to blight Philomèle. This is my chance.]
translation: [泽莉亚夫人嘱我向菲洛梅尔施下诅咒。这正是我的机会。]

text: [Nothing more to do here. Just take the drinks back over to the poet, the painter, and ...whatever the other two are.]
translation: [这里再无事可做。只管把酒端回诗人、画家，还有……另外那两个随便是什么的人那儿。]

text: The work of moments to brush a little bewitchment around the rims of the glasses.
translation: 片刻工夫，一缕魅惑便已抹上各只杯沿。

text: The work of a moment to taint Philomèle's glass.
translation: 转瞬之间，菲洛梅尔的酒杯便被玷污。

text: The taste is as I remember: an angry-medical fennel-mint. But it's weak! Much weaker than I remember.
translation: 味道与记忆中的一样：一股带火气的药房味茴香薄荷。可它太淡了！比我记得的淡得多。

text: [Say nothing.]
translation: [什么也不说。]

text: This is... a very gentle pastis.
translation: 这……可真是一杯温吞的茴香酒。

text: 'Vichy water!' crows the nearest card-player.
translation: 「维希水！」最近的那位牌客得意地嚷道。

text: What the hell is this? Toothpaste?
translation: 这算什么玩意儿？牙膏？

text: Our government has decreed, monsieur, that indulgence weakened France. So they give us the gift of sobriety. Above this strength, no aperitif is permitted.
translation: 先生，我们的政府颁布了法令：纵情享乐削弱了法国。所以他们赐予我们清醒这份礼物。超过这个度数的开胃酒，一律不得出售。

text: You are fortunate. Three days in the week, I could not even serve you this.
translation: 您运气好。一周里有三天，我连这个都没法给您端上来。

text: Barbaric!
translation: 野蛮！

text: Regrettable.
translation: 令人遗憾。

text: [Raise the glass] [Drily] To the benevolence of the State.
translation: [举杯] [干巴巴地] 敬邦国的仁慈。

text: [Raise the glass] [Sincerely] To the benevolence of the State!
translation: [举杯] [真诚地] 敬邦国的仁慈！

text: As you say.
translation: 就依您所言。

text: [Truth] I'm English.
translation: [实话] 我是英国人。

text: [Truth] I was born in Paris.
translation: [实话] 我出生在巴黎。

text: A foreigner, so.
translation: 这么说，是个外国人。

text: A little advice. Do not raise your voice when you say these interesting things.
translation: 一点忠告。说这些有趣的事情时，别抬高嗓门。

text: [Toast] To Felix.
translation: [举杯] 敬费利克斯。

text: Yes. To his memory.
translation: 是的。敬他的在天之灵。

text: There was something else?
translation: 还有别的事？

text: [This is embarrassing. I only have [q=cashState].]
translation: [真难为情。我身上只有 [q=cashState]。]

text: Please, madame. I've come a very long way to find her. My utmost gratitude.
translation: 求求您，夫人。我走了很远的路才找到她。我对您感激不尽。

text: Have you met anyone of that name?
translation: 您可遇到过叫这个名字的人？

text: Sorry. I'm bad with names.
translation: 抱歉。我对名字不太在行。

text: One does what one can. But, there.
translation: 能做多少便做多少。不过，就到这儿了。

text: Beh.
translation: 哼。

text: Oh, very well.
translation: 哦，好吧。

text: Close to the station, there is a bookseller. Andrée.
translation: 车站附近有位书商。安德烈。

text: Yes. An interesting woman.
translation: 是的。一位有意思的女士。

text: Yes. I enjoyed her talent for stripes.
translation: 是的。我很欣赏她那手条纹功夫。

text: I'm listening.
translation: 我在听。

text: She has another business - quieter even than bookselling. Mention my name to her, and perhaps she will help.
translation: 她还有一门生意——比卖书更安静。向她提起我的名字，她兴许会帮你。

text: As I said: my utmost gratitude. Thank you, madame. Heaven lift you!
translation: 如我所言：感激不尽。多谢您，夫人。愿天堂护佑您！

text: Today, madame, you have made a greater friend than you know.
translation: 今日，夫人，您结交了一位比您所知更了不起的朋友。

text: [Bow deeply and withdraw.]
translation: [深鞠一躬，退下。]

text: The three candles are a Solar tradition. Linou is invoking three faces of the Sun to look kindly upon the departed.
translation: 三支蜡烛是太阳一系的传统。利努正请动太阳的三副面孔，好让它们垂顾逝者。

text: Candles flicker before the image of a handsome young man in uniform.
translation: 烛光在一位身着军装的俊朗青年照片前摇曳。

text: Your husband?
translation: 是您的丈夫？

text: Your brother?
translation: 是您的兄弟？

text: Did you have an... American sweetheart?
translation: 您曾有过一位……美国情人？

text: Almost. We had not enough time.
translation: 差一点。我们没来得及。

text: [A faintly amused scowl.] Felix, my brother? No.
translation: [一丝忍俊不禁的皱眉。] 费利克斯，我的兄弟？不。

text: The uniform doesn't look French. American, perhaps? But the insignia are odd.
translation: 这身军装不像法军的。或许是美军的？可徽记有些古怪。

text: An American...?
translation: 一个美国人……？

text: Oh! No. Felix was Free French. The Americans equipped his whole division, when they came out of Africa.
translation: 哦！不。费利克斯是自由法国的。他们师从非洲出来时，装备全是美国人给的。

text: He wears it well.
translation: 他穿这身很精神。

text: Do you know how he felt? About wearing an Incorporate uniform?
translation: 您可知道他的感受？关于穿上集团的军装？

text: I had no opportunity to ask him...
translation: 我没有机会问他……

text: He did; yes.
translation: 他明白的；是的。

text: We would have been married, Felix and I, in the summer.
translation: 费利克斯和我，本会在夏天成婚。

text: There is a story, you know. They took some Charlemagnes - the turncoats, you know, the Enemy volunteers - in the last days of the war. They asked the Charlemagnes how they could stand to wear German uniforms.
translation: 有个故事，你知道吗。战争最后的日子里，他们逮住了一些查理曼师的人——就是那些变节者，你知道的，投敌的志愿兵。他们问查理曼师的人，怎么受得了穿德国军装。

text: One Charlemagne asked: how can you stand to wear American uniforms?
translation: 其中一个查理曼师的人反问：你们怎么受得了穿美国军装？

text: [Laugh.]
translation: [笑出声来。]

text: [Frown.]
translation: [皱眉。]

text: And so! We shot them! On the spot!
translation: 于是！我们就把他们毙了！当场毙的！

text: [Linou's grin becomes wolfish.]
translation: [利努的笑容变得狼性十足。]

text: ...on the spot.
translation: ……当场毙的。

text: And now, she looks only tired.
translation: 而此刻，她脸上只余疲惫。

text: [Softly]'We'?
translation: [轻声]「我们」？

text: [Lean close] No more than they deserved.
translation: [凑近] 他们罪有应得。

text: That is... that is contrary to the laws of war.
translation: 这……这有违战争法规。

text: ...bah.
Linou scrubs ferociously at a stubborn spot on the bar.
translation: 利努狠命擦拭着吧台上的一块顽固污渍。

text: What of it?
translation: 那又怎样？

text: As I understand it, the State has not chosen to honour the Free French. It might be embarrassing if your sympathies were known.
translation: 据我所知，邦国并不打算表彰自由法国。若您的同情心被人知晓，恐怕会很难堪。

text: Only that it's good to hear true patriots remembered. If you understand me.
translation: 只想说，听到还有人记得真正的爱国者，这很好。若您明白我的意思。

text: Linou's wolfish grin returns...
translation: 利努狼一般的笑容又回来了……

text: ... and then she clears it from her face with the casual briskness of a woman sweeping a curtain closed.
translation: ……然后她将这笑容从脸上抹去，动作随意而利落，如同一位妇人顺手拉上窗帘。

text: Did you want anything else?
translation: 您还要别的吗？

text: My sincere condolences.
translation: 我深表哀悼。

text: Light perpetual shine upon him.
translation: 愿永恒之光常照于他。

text: So goes the world.
translation: 世事如此。

text: May he find the peace of silence...
translation: 愿他寻得寂静中的安宁……

text: She lets out a long breath.
translation: 她长长地舒了一口气。

text: So indeed.
translation: 确实如此。

text: She lowers her head briefly.
translation: 她微微低下头。

text: And what of that?
translation: 那这个呢？

text: ...as you say.
translation: ……就依您所言。

text: Nothing. Nothing at all. As long as we remain on good terms.
translation: 没什么。什么也没有。只要我们相处得宜。

text: Is there absolutely no chance of a coffee? I've been desperate for one ever since I got off the train. Awake all night, you see.
translation: 真的一点咖啡都没有了吗？我自打下车起就惦记着一杯。一夜没合眼，您知道的。

text: Well... we do have something. If you're desperate. But I will be honest. It is sock juice.
translation: 嗯……我们倒是有一样东西。要是您实在没办法。不过我跟您说实话：那是袜子汁。

text: Absolutely none.
translation: 绝对没有。

text: Coca-Cola.
translation: 可口可乐。

text: Coca-Cola. It tastes like what it tastes like.
translation: 可口可乐。它是什么味道，就是什么味道。

text: [Get up from the bar.]
translation: [从吧台起身。]

text: My apologies, madame. I find myself embarrassed. I'll return promptly and settle my account.
translation: 失礼，夫人。我实在难堪。我很快就回来结清账目。

text: Came out without my wallet! I'm so forgetful. I'll come back with it immediately.
translation: 出门忘了带钱包！我真是健忘。我马上带着它回来。

text: See that you do.
translation: 你可要说到做到。

text: I do not offer credit to strangers, monsieur. Be quick, or I will speak to my friends.
translation: 我不向陌生人赊账，先生。快去快回，不然我就要同我的朋友们说说了。

text: [Settle bill... with flair.]
translation: [结账……潇洒利落。]

text: Excuse me - madame -
translation: 打扰了——夫人——

text: What are you -
translation: 你这是——

text: Why -
translation: 怎么——

text: That comes to [q=chezfelix.bill:words] francisques.
translation: 一共 [q=chezfelix.bill:words] 枚法兰西斧币。

text: You have returned to pay your bill?
translation: 您是回来结账的？

text: Of course.
translation: 当然。

text: Not quite yet.
translation: 还不到时候。

text: Very good. Sit down, then.
translation: 很好。那就请坐吧。

text: Pff. Be quick.
translation: 啧。快点儿。

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: Um...
Again?!
translation: 又来？！

text: Well. Hurry up about it.
translation: 好吧。快些了结。

text: [Settle bill... with a tiny miracle.]
translation: [结账……借一个小小的奇迹。]

text: [Exit, blushing.]
translation: [红着脸离开。]

text: [Exit, whistling.]
translation: [吹着口哨离开。]

text: [Drop a little witchery into my glass along with the coins. Present it to Linou with a bow.]
translation: [把硬币放进杯里的同时，往杯中落进一缕巫术。鞠躬，将杯子呈给利努。]

text: As Linou reaches for the glass, carnations - red and white - spring from the mouth of the glass!
translation: 利努伸手去接杯子，红白两色的康乃馨竟从杯口喷涌而出！

text: Linou accepts the glass, bemused. The witchery didn't take.
translation: 利努接过杯子，困惑不已。巫术没有奏效。

text: I reach out as if to brush something from her headband.
translation: 我伸出手，仿佛要拂去她发带上的一点什么。

text: Linou recoils.
translation: 利努往后缩去。

text: I have no choice but to open my hand, revealing a palmed coin.
translation: 我别无他法，只得张开手，露出掌中藏着的一枚硬币。

text: [Smile sheepishly.]
translation: [讪讪地笑。]

text: Pfff.
translation: 噗。

text: Pluck a coin from her left ear.
translation: 从她左耳后拈出一枚硬币。

text: Pluck a coin from her right ear.
translation: 从她右耳后拈出一枚硬币。

text: Pluck a coin from her nose.
translation: 从她鼻尖拈出一枚硬币。

text: Magnificent. And thank you.
translation: 妙极。多谢。

text: I believe this concludes our business.
translation: 我想，我们的账目就此两清。

text: Linou rolls her eyes. But she also smiles.
translation: 利努翻了个白眼，却也笑了。

text: Ironic applause from the card-players' table.
translation: 牌客那桌传来戏谑的掌声。

text: What is...
translation: 这是什么……

text: I apologise, madame. I am clumsy.
translation: 请见谅，夫人。我笨手笨脚。

text: Yes, exactly.
translation: 正是如此。

text: May this place be fruitful.
translation: 愿此地丰饶。

text: Remember this moment.
translation: 记住这一刻。

text: Oh!
translation: 哦！

text: Linou takes the flowers, smiling. She also empties the glass out on to the counter and counts the coins.
translation: 利努笑着接过花，又把杯中之物倒上柜台，数起硬币来。

text: Gasps of pleased surprise from the tables behind me.
translation: 我身后的桌边传来又惊又喜的吸气声。

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: A house of tolerance, indeed!
translation: 果真是座宽容之家！

text: Oh! Aristide! Will you stop now with your circus?
translation: 哦！阿里斯蒂德！你这出马戏还不停下？

text: [Legal Truth] I'm English.
translation: [法律实话] 我是英国人。

text: [Truth] I'm from Paris.
translation: [实话] 我来自巴黎。

text: She leans closer.
translation: 她凑近了些。

text: Some. More before the war, you know. But they don't like so much the Côte d'Azur now.
translation: 有一些。战前来得更多，你知道。不过如今他们不太爱来蔚蓝海岸了。

text: A little pause before she said that. And a little watchfulness after. Linou wanted to be sure I understood that Americans were welcome here.
translation: 说这话之前，她顿了顿。说这话之后，又带着一丝警觉。利努想让我确知：美国人在此地是受欢迎的。

text: They are of course very welcome in this café.
translation: 他们在这家咖啡馆，当然非常受欢迎。

text: [Ironic] We all should be grateful for the protection of our [[Incorporate]] allies against the [[Icarian]] menace.
translation: [反讽] 我们都该感激[[集团]]盟友的护佑，以御[[伊加利亚]]之患。

text: [Earnest] We should be all grateful for the protection of our [[Incorporate]] allies against the [[Icarian]] menace.
translation: [恳切] 我们都该感激[[集团]]盟友的护佑，以御[[伊加利亚]]之患。

text: [?] I do like their teeth. They have such wonderful teeth.
translation: [?] 我倒是喜欢他们的牙齿。他们长着一口绝妙的牙齿。

text: Does she think I might be a government informer?
translation: 她莫不是以为我是政府的密探？

text: Vive les Américains.
translation: 美国人万岁。

text: Their...
translation: 他们的……

text: Teeth. [Bare my own like a merry chimpanzee.]
translation: 牙齿。[像只快活的黑猩猩一样，龇出自己的牙。]

text: [Nod sagaciously. Wink.]
translation: [睿智地点点头。眨眨眼。]

text: Oh.
Fada. [She shakes her head, chuckling.]
translation: 疯子。[她摇了摇头，轻声低笑。]

text: Vive les Américains.
translation: 美国人万岁。

text: [Enough time at the bar for now.]
translation: [在酒吧待得够久了。]

text: Once I've travelled and returned to Antibes, I can refresh myself at Chez Felix again.
translation: 等我旅行归来、回到昂蒂布，就能再到费利克斯之家歇歇脚。

text: So.
translation: 「所以。」

text: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

text: Sock juice?
translation: 袜子汁？

text: ...no, thank you.
translation: ……不了，谢谢。

text: Only a way of saying: it is not palatable. It is burnt rice. Chicory root. And it is not cheap. Forty francisques.
translation: 不过是种说法罢了：那玩意儿不好喝。是烧糊的米饭。菊苣根。而且不便宜。四十枚法兰西斧币。

text: If that's all you have...
translation: 如果你只有这个……

text: You were warned.
translation: 我可警告过你了。

text: There is no sugar.
translation: 没有糖。

text: Here.
translation: 给。

text: It steams; the smell is something like coffee; it is dark as filthy pond-water. A yellow skirl of scum-bubbles rotates at its murky heart.
translation: 它冒着热气；气味有点像咖啡；颜色深得像肮脏的池水。昏浊的中心，旋着一圈发黄的浮渣泡沫。

text: [Sip cautiously.]
translation: [小心翼翼地啜了一口。]

text: [Drain the scalding liquid in a single swallow.]
translation: [一口喝干这滚烫的液体。]

text: Actually: it's not so bad. It's not good. But, coiled within the burnt taste and the radishy taste, there is a welcome lurking bitterness not unlike coffee. Perhaps she's secretly adulterating real black-market coffee?
translation: 其实：也没那么糟。算不上好。但在焦糊味与萝卜味之间，蛰伏着一丝令人受用的苦，隐约有咖啡的影子。也许她悄悄往劣货里掺了真正的黑市咖啡？

text: Ow!
translation: 哎哟！

text: [Odd that she was so reluctant to offer this...]
translation: [奇怪，她方才竟这么不情愿端出这个……]

text: Beh.
translation: 哼。

text: It did taste better than I might expect. Likely, there's real coffee in there, heavily adulterated. She needed the money; but she didn't want a stranger to know she's buying coffee on the black market.
translation: 味道确实比我想象的好。很可能里面掺了大量真咖啡。她需要钱；但不愿让陌生人知道她在黑市买咖啡。

text: It must usually be reserved for regulars.
translation: 这大概通常只留给熟客。

text: [Look her straight in the eye] Much better than you suggested, madame. Perhaps you have a secret recipe? But your secret is safe with me.
translation: [直视她的眼睛] 比您说的好得多，夫人。也许您有秘密配方？不过您的秘密，我会守口如瓶。

text: [Neutrally] You are a man of refined spirit.
translation: [语气平淡] 您是个品味高雅的人。

text: Nothing at all. This is none of my affair.
translation: 没什么。这是您的事，与我无关。

text: Worse than you have threatened me. Order, or go.
translation: 比您威胁我的还糟。点单，或者离开。

text: I saw strange things, over where the rain ends.
translation: 在雨水终结之处，我看见了一些奇异之物。

text: You mean the holes in the world?
translation: 你是说世界上的洞？

text: Yes. What are they?
translation: 是的。它们是什么？

text: Holes. In the world.
translation: 洞。在世界上的。

text: Cognac? No one said anything about cognac!
translation: 干邑？没人提过干邑！

text: Jean-Bernard needs cheering up. You seem fine.
translation: 让-贝尔纳需要打起精神来。你看着还行。

text: There is a small surcharge for painters and for poets. Even Jean-Bernard.
translation: 对画家和诗人，要收一点小额附加费。让-贝尔纳也不例外。

text: [Decide against it, at least for now.]
translation: [决定不点，至少暂时不点。]

text: Sock juice.
translation: 袜子汁。

text: If you like.
translation: 随你。

text: There really is coffee in there... somewhere.
translation: 里面真的有咖啡……在某个地方。

text: It might in fact serve as a sacrament for some heretical rites - [[Crucian]] or otherwise.
translation: 它或许真能充当某些异端仪式的圣餐——[[克鲁西安]]式的，或别的什么。

text: Paris. A foreigner, more or less.
translation: 巴黎。勉强算个外国人。

text: And here come the authorities! Look sharp, you old bastards, our carrots are cooked now.
translation: 当局来了！打起精神来，老东西们，这下我们的胡萝卜熟了。

text: [q=alias.last], yes?
translation: [q=alias.last]，对吧？

text: I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 「我在找一个女人,名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。」

text: Largesse? Never heard of her.
translation: 慷慨？从没听说过这位。

text: What's everyone talking about?
translation: 大家在谈论什么？

text: The world!
translation: 世界！

text: Me neither, but
translation: 我也是，不过……

text: Hsst! 'Silence is silver.'
translation: 嘘！『沉默是银。』

text: Who is, my friend? Who is? But, listen, [q=alias.last], I prefer this one: 'A glass in the nose, and the tongue loosens.'
translation: 谁？我的朋友，谁呀？不过，听着，[q=alias.last]，我更喜欢这句：『鼻子一杯，舌头就松了。』

text: Times are tight. I really can't spare the cash.
translation: 时局艰难。我真的匀不出钱来。

text: All right. Linou knows what you drink?
translation: 好吧。利努知道你们喝什么？

text: Can we talk?
translation: 我们能谈谈吗？

text: I'm looking for [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: [If I craft a Bewitch item before I go back to the bar... I could definitely make the drinks loosen their tongues.]
translation: [若我在回酒吧前炼制一件迷惑道具……我定能让那些酒水撬开他们的嘴。]

text: I'm still looking for [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我还在找[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: If you make me regret telling you this... I'll make you regret it, too.
translation: 你若让我后悔告诉你这件事……我也会让你后悔。

text: Well... don't tell anyone I told you. But you need to talk to Andrée, the bookseller.
translation: 呃……别说是我告诉你的。但你得去找安德烈，那位书商。

text: I will share a secret. Andrée, at the Librairie des Heures, sells other things than books.
translation: 我分享一个秘密。安德烈，在时光书店那位，除了书还卖别的东西。

text: Anyone know this Nina? No? No? Sorry, [q=alias.familiar], no Nina here.
translation: 有谁知道这位尼娜？没有？没有？抱歉，[q=alias.familiar]，这儿没有尼娜。

text: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢你。

text: [If I craft a Wither item before I go back to the bar... this is my chance to place the curse on Philomèle that Madame Zèlia requested.]
translation: [若我在回酒吧前炼制一件凋零道具……这正是我按泽莉亚夫人的请求，向菲洛梅尔施下诅咒的机会。]

text: What's this? You prince! How spontaneous of you!
translation: 这是什么？您这位王子！您可真是随性！

text: [q=alias.familiar]!
translation: [q=alias.familiar]！

text: I should be going, then.
translation: 那么，我该走了。

text: [Steer the conversation back to other matters.]
translation: [把话题引回别的事情上。]

text: [Adapt myself to the conversation. Smile when it's suitable; frown and tsk when it's not; when an in-joke surfaces, make note of it.]
translation: [让自己融入这场谈话。该笑时笑；不该笑时皱眉啧舌；遇有圈内笑话，便记在心里。]

text: [I added something to their drinks. Watch and wait to see the effects.]
translation: [我在他们的酒里加了点什么。且看效果。]

text: What's the game?
translation: 怎么玩？

text: Welll then! This isn't Monaco. The sabot is our very own Philomèle's very own slipper.
translation: 好吧好吧！这儿可不是摩纳哥。这只木鞋，正是我们菲洛梅尔自己的拖鞋。

text: [I have a deck of cards that match the ones in the shoe. With a little care, I could reliably draw a winning hand. Unless I got caught.]
translation: [我有一副牌，与鞋里的那副花色一致。稍加小心，我就能稳稳抽到一手好牌。除非被当场抓包。]

text: Each keeps two cards hidden until we all slap down our hands. Watch their faces...
translation: 每人藏两张牌，直到大家一起亮牌。看他们的脸……

text: Lose intentionally.
translation: 故意输。

text: Aristide waves a black velvet court shoe. Philomèle languidly wiggles the bare toes of her left foot.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德挥舞着一只黑色天鹅绒舞鞋。菲洛梅尔慵懒地扭动左脚赤裸的脚趾。

text: What is that in your hand?
translation: 你手里拿的是什么？

text: I apologise. I couldn't afford to lose. I didn't want to admit how limited my funds were.
translation: 我道歉。我输不起。我不愿承认自己的钱有多有限。

text: Pass them over, gentlemen, marquise. Another one!
translation: 交出来吧，先生们，侯爵夫人。再来一局！

text: Why not?
translation: 有何不可？

text: [Back out] Not for me.
translation: [退出] 我就不了。

text: Bye for now.
translation: 那先告辞。

text: Until next time.
translation: 下次再见。

text: They begin to relax around me. Although Leopold remains watchful.
translation: 他们开始在我面前放松下来。尽管利奥波德依旧警觉。

text: I begin to realise that my bonhomie is landing as sycophancy. None of them are stupid. Leopold in particular is watchful. Even Aristide is not so drunk as he likes to pretend.
translation: 我开始意识到，我的热络在他们眼中成了谄媚。他们谁都不傻。利奥波德尤其警觉。就连阿里斯蒂德，也没有他装出的那么醉。

text: Philomèle, laughing into Jean-Bernard's shoulder, her hair coming loose. Aristide, examining the bowl of his pipe for informers. Leopold, fascinated by the moths which flutter in to sip from his glass. Jean-Bernard, doggedly carving a quatrain into the flank of a candle. And me, watching.
translation: 菲洛梅尔靠着让-贝尔纳的肩膀笑，头发散开。阿里斯蒂德端详着烟斗的斗钵，像在寻找告密者。利奥波德着迷地看着扑进杯中啜饮的飞蛾。让-贝尔纳固执地在蜡烛侧面刻一首四行诗。而我，看着这一切。

text: Halfway through a wry aside to Jean-Bernard, Philomèle begins to cough. It takes a long time for the coughing to subside. She's grown very pale. It might be that there's a spot of blood on her collar. I can't be certain. The fabric is dark, and so is the rainy, smoky, friendly gloom of the café.
translation: 菲洛梅尔正对让-贝尔纳说着一句刻薄的俏皮话，说到一半，突然咳嗽起来。咳嗽过了很久才平息。她变得非常苍白。她的衣领上或许有一点血迹。我无法确定。衣料颜色深，而咖啡馆里雨蒙蒙、烟腾腾、昏暗又亲昵。

text: Aristide, examining the bowl of his pipe for informers. Leopold, fascinated by the moths which flutter in to sip from his glass. Jean-Bernard, doggedly carving a quatrain into the flank of a candle. Philomèle is laughing into Jean-Bernard's shoulder, her hair coming loose... but then she begins to cough. It takes a long time for the coughing to subside. She's grown pale. That might be a spot of blood on her collar, but the cloth is too dark for me to be certain.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德端详着烟斗的斗钵，像在寻找告密者。利奥波德着迷地看着扑进杯中啜饮的飞蛾。让-贝尔纳固执地在蜡烛侧面刻一首四行诗。菲洛梅尔靠着让-贝尔纳的肩膀笑，头发散开……可接着，她开始咳嗽。咳嗽过了很久才平息。她变得苍白。她的衣领上或许有一点血迹，但衣料颜色太深，我无法确定。

text: Yes, yes, we know! Ask Andrée at the Librairie des Heures. Why so forgetful?
translation: 是了是了，我们知道！去时光书店找安德烈。你怎么这么健忘？

text: What should we call you, Monsieur The Authorities? What alias are you using today to terrorise the innocent working men of Antibes?
translation: 我们该怎么称呼您，当局先生？今天您又用哪个化名，来吓唬昂蒂布无辜的工人们？

text: 'Spencer Hobson.'
translation: 『斯宾塞·霍布森。』

text: 'Sylvain Huissier'. But hush! I'm under cover.
translation: 『西尔万·韦西耶』。可别声张！我在执行秘密任务。

text: [American accent] Call me... 'Midnight Joe'.
translation: [美国口音] 叫我……『午夜乔』。

text: English. I knew it immediately. A true English gentleman.
translation: 英国人。我一眼就看出来了。真正的英国绅士。

text: Watch out for Jean-Bernard, then. He's a terrible gossip.
translation: 那可得当心让-贝尔纳。他是出了名的大嘴巴。

text: You need to work on your accent, Midnight Joe.
translation: 你的口音还得好好练练，午夜乔。

text: This again...
translation: 又是这套……

text: I apologise, [q=alias.formal], for these savages. If they had better manners, they'd introduce themselves.
translation: 我为这些粗人向您道歉，[q=alias.formal]。他们若懂礼数，就该自我介绍。

text: Aristide is the noisy one.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德是那个闹腾的。

text: I dare not contradict madame la marquise.
translation: 我可不敢反驳侯爵夫人阁下。

text: Leopold is our painter. And our nihilist.
translation: 利奥波德是我们的画家。也是我们的虚无主义者。

text: This song again. Ignore the duchess. I'm a realist. At worst, an existentialist.
translation: 又来了。别理会这位公爵夫人。我是现实主义者。至多算个存在主义者。

text: Jean-Bernard is our poet.
translation: 让-贝尔纳是我们的诗人。

text: I am a poor excuse for a poet, at best, [q=alias.title.fr].
translation: 我不过是个不入流的诗人，充其量如此，[q=alias.title.fr]。

text: But an adequate mechanic.
translation: 但还算个称职的机修工。

text: And I am Philomèle.
translation: 而我，是菲洛梅尔。

text: A duchess, I hear. Or a marchioness?
translation: 我听说，是位公爵夫人。还是侯爵夫人？

text: You're these boys' governess, I take it?
translation: 我猜，你是这帮小伙子的家庭教师？

text: Delighted.
translation: 幸会。

text: Aristide, halfway through a draw on his pipe, cough-splutters with delight.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德正吸着烟斗，乐得连咳带呛，把烟都喷了出来。

text: An awkward pause, until Aristide takes pity on me.
translation: 一阵尴尬的沉默，直到阿里斯蒂德可怜起我来。

text: That's it, lads, never mind la marquise, she's the governess now!
translation: 行了，伙计们，别管什么侯爵夫人了，她现在是家庭教师了！

text: I do what I can to raise the tone. But one cannot empty the sea with a spoon.
translation: 我尽力把格调拔高些。可一勺是舀不干大海的。

text: And she calls me a nihilist.
translation: 她倒管我叫虚无主义者。

text: I'd say it's more like pissing in a violin. But that's because I lack manners.
translation: 要我说，更像往小提琴里撒尿。不过那是因为我缺乏教养。

text: If we're finally now finished with the badinage, there's something I need to discuss with you.
translation: 玩笑若是终于开够了，我有件事要和你谈谈。

text: Pray continue, my prince.
translation: 请讲吧，我的王子。

text: They catch on quick, the authorities!
translation: 当局学得真快！

text: Our Leopold likes his aphorisms. Like any good nihilist.
translation: 我们的利奥波德爱讲他的格言。跟所有称职的虚无主义者一样。

text: I'm not a nihilist! You're not nearly as funny as you think you are, Aristide.
translation: 我不是虚无主义者！你远没自己想的那么有趣，阿里斯蒂德。

text: [Rack my brains for a clever aphorism.]
translation: [绞尽脑汁，想找一句俏皮格言。]

text: You want me to fetch drinks for you and your friends.
translation: 你想让我给你和你的朋友端酒。

text: [Gesture carelessly] "Bronze is the mirror of the face; wine, the mirror of the mind."
translation: [随意一挥手] 『青铜是面孔的镜子，美酒是心神的镜子。』

text: [Nod approvingly] "This horrible tearing thirst demands that you fill yourselves with wine."
translation: [赞许地点头] 『这可怕的灼渴，正催你们以酒灌满自己。』

text: What??
translation: 什么？？

text: Just... go get us something to drink, eh?
translation: 就……去给我们弄点喝的，嗯？

text: I always liked that one.
translation: 我一直喜欢那句。

text: To put it bluntly: yes.
translation: 直说了吧：是的。

text: I have better things to do than get drunks drunker.
translation: 我还有更要紧的事，犯不着把醉汉灌得更醉。

text: You asked me to get drinks for everyone here...
translation: 是你让我给在座各位端酒的……

text: "A guest should not come empty-handed."
translation: 『客人不该空手登门。』

text: Of course. Please, join us.
translation: 当然。请入座。

text: [Consider buying drinks for the four of them.]
translation: [考虑为这四位买一轮酒。]

text: You'll speak more freely if I top you up with wine?
translation: 我把你的酒添满，你说话会更痛快吧？

text: [It never hurts to make friends.]
translation: [交朋友总没坏处。]

text: [This is a waste of time.]
translation: [这是在浪费时间。]

text: Linou knows everything.
translation: 利努什么都知道。

text: [Step away.]
translation: [退开一步。]

text: (The man has sea-urchins in his pockets.)
translation: （这家伙口袋里装着海胆。）

text: Oho!
translation: 哦嚯！

text: Oh!
translation: 哦！

text: Bah.
translation: 哼。

text: Something tells me our thirsts will remain unquenched a little longer. A presentiment, perhaps. Or something in your eyes. Perhaps it is the absence of drinks.
translation: 我隐约觉得，我们的口渴还得再熬上一阵。也许是种预感。也许是您眼里的什么。也许只是酒迟迟不来。

text: 'Absence of evidence is not evidence.' There is still room for optimism, Aristide.
translation: 『证据的缺席不是证据。』总还有乐观的余地，阿里斯蒂德。

text: Ah! le Révérend Père William Wright. On the Hittites.
translation: 啊！可敬的神父威廉·赖特。论赫梯人的那本。

text: No - It's Cygnifer, on the Serpent. The heresy.
translation: 不对——是《西尼费尔》，论蛇的那本。那部异端。

text: Pff. You know I don't read that gibberish.
translation: 嗤。你知道我不读那种天书。

text: Of course. Perhaps your fortune will change, and you'll remember us.
translation: 当然。也许你的时运会变，那时你会想起我们。

text: Eyes in the eyes!
translation: 眼对眼！

text: A general clinking of glasses.
translation: 一片碰杯声。

text: [Look each of the others in the eye.]
translation: [与其余每个人目光相对。]

text: [Keep my eyes on the floor. I don't want anyone to remember my face better than they have to.]
translation: [目光落在地板上。我不愿任何人把我的脸记得比必要的更清楚。]

text: Aristide, merry; Leopold, wary; Jean-Bernard, wistful; Philomèle, wry.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德，快活；利奥波德，警惕；让-贝尔纳，怅惘；菲洛梅尔，讥诮。

text: [Lift the glass of red wine that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯红酒。]

text: [Lift the glass of white wine that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯白葡萄酒。]

text: [Lift the glass of pastis that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯茴香酒。]

text: [Lift the camomile tea that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯甘菊茶。]

text: [Lift the Coca-Cola that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯可口可乐。]

text: [Lift the possibly-coffee that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯疑似咖啡。]

text: [Lift the glass of water that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯水。]

text: [I added something to Philomèle's drink. Watch and wait to see any effect.]
translation: [我在菲洛梅尔的酒里加了点什么。且看效果。]

text: [I added something to their drinks - and something more to Philomèle's. Watch and wait to see the effect.]
translation: [我在他们的酒里加了点什么——给菲洛梅尔的还额外加了料。且看效果。]

text: No more wine for [q=alias.familiar]!
translation: 别再给[q=alias.familiar]倒酒了！

text: If one of them likes you enough, perhaps they'll open up. Except Aristide. If Aristide knew anything, he'd already have blurted it out.
translation: 若他们中有人足够喜欢你，或许会敞开心扉。阿里斯蒂德除外。他若知道什么，早就脱口而出了。

text: Not the world entire. But what has occurred. Perhaps you have noticed, [q=alias.familiar], that the world is different since the war.
translation: 不是整个世界。而是发生过的事。也许你已察觉，[q=alias.familiar]，大战之后，世界大不相同。

text: Yes. It has holes in it, for instance.
translation: 是的。比如，它上面有洞。

text: Yes. The sun is not what it was...
translation: 是的。太阳已不是从前的太阳……

text: Yes. What walked only in the night, walks in the daylight.
translation: 是的。只在夜里游荡的东西，如今在白昼行走。

text: Leopold rolls his eyes.
translation: 利奥波德翻了个白眼。

text: Philomèle raises her glass fractionally. Jean-Bernard nods.
translation: 菲洛梅尔稍稍举杯。让-贝尔纳点了点头。

text: Leopold chuckles drily.
translation: 利奥波德干巴巴地笑了。

text: Precisely. To name only a single consequence. But a consequence of what? That is what we discuss.
translation: 正是。这里只举出一个后果。可它是什么的后果？这正是我们所谈论的。

text: To me, it is clear. The weapons unleashed by the Enemy - and against the Enemy, by the Allies - were too terrible. They cracked Europe like the shell of an egg [he stamps a foot for emphasis]. Now, the cracks spread! The egg leaks until the shell is empty. But to my friends, somehow it is not so clear.
translation: 在我看来，这很清楚。敌人释放的武器——以及同盟用来对付敌人的武器——都太过可怕。它们像蛋壳一样击裂了欧洲[他跺了跺脚以示强调]。如今裂缝还在蔓延！蛋液一直流，直到蛋壳空竭。可对我的朋友们来说，不知为何，就没这么清楚了。

text: Jean-Bernard?
translation: 让-贝尔纳？

text: ...Philomèle is right. The blood on the Sun is the blood of the secret gods.
translation: ……菲洛梅尔说得对。太阳上的血，是隐秘诸神的血。

text: Leopold?
translation: 利奥波德？

text: Leopold is right. It's not a question anyone can ever answer.
translation: 利奥波德说得对。这不是任何人能够回答的问题。

text: Philomèle?
translation: 菲洛梅尔？

text: What do you think?
translation: 你觉得呢？

text: I think...
translation: 我想……

text: The Church teaches that the Sun has many natures. And the esoterics teach that the world has other natures, necessary to sustain its existence. The 'War in the Sun' is not only a figure of speech. These natures warred. Many died. And now Europe dies with them.
translation: 教会教导说，太阳有许多本性。密教学者则教导说，世界还有另一些本性，为维系其存在所必需。『太阳之战』并非仅仅一个比喻。这些本性交战了。许多本性死去。如今，欧洲正随它们一同死去。

text: Philomèle, you should know, is a journalist. She writes articles in magazines for readers less intelligent than she. Horoscopes - tripe of that nature. Over the years, it has infected her with mysticism.
translation: 要知道，菲洛梅尔是个记者。她为智力不及她的读者们撰写杂志文章。占星专栏——诸如此类的货色。这些年来，这活儿让她染上了神秘主义。

text: Impossible ever to say. Our understanding lies buried beneath ignorance, beneath the gravestone knowledge, raised by science and art.
translation: 永远无从言说。我们的理解深埋在无知之下，深埋在科学和艺术竖起的墓碑般的知识之下。

text: Philomèle sips her wine, smiling very slightly.
translation: 菲洛梅尔抿了口酒，嘴角浮起极淡的笑意。

text: "Each hour has its colour - each flame has its fuel."
translation: 『每个时辰有它的颜色——每簇火焰有它的燃料。』

text: This nonsense is more contagious than I knew.
translation: 这种胡话比我想象的更有传染性。

text: In other words, we have passed a point of no return. We cannot know what has happened to our world. To discuss the matter will only expand our ignorance - until we grope like apes in the dark.
translation: 换句话说，我们已经越过了无可回返之点。我们无法知晓我们的世界究竟发生了什么。谈论此事只会扩大我们的无知——直到我们像猿猴一般，在黑暗中摸索。

text: <size=60%>(Nihilist.)</size>
translation: <size=60%>（虚无主义者。）</size>

text: Do apes... that is, I think apes have better night vision than we do...?
translation: 猿猴……我是说，我觉得猿猴的夜视能力比我们强……？

text: You see? My point exactly. We get more ignorant each time we open our mouths.
translation: 瞧见了吗？正是我的意思。我们每开口一次，就变得更无知一分。

text: The Stars.
translation: 群星。

text: The things in Russia, I mean. The ones behind the Ministries. Everything changed when they came. I was an [[Icarian]]. I still am, I suppose. I think it might get better. But I think, before then, it will get much worse.
translation: 我是说俄国来的那些东西。联盟背后的那些。它们来时，一切都变了。我一度是[[伊加利亚]]人。我想，现在仍是。我觉得事情也许会好转。但好转之前，会先坏得多。

text: Why the Stars? Why not the [[Incorporates]]?
translation: 为什么是群星？为什么不是[[集团]]？

text: No no, you're right. They make it worse. We were never meant to touch Heaven. Not like this. It will split us like old wineskins.
translation: 不不，你说得对。它们让一切更糟。我们本不该触碰天堂。不该以这种方式。它会像旧酒囊一样把我们撑裂。

text: So if we hadn't had the War, it would be just as bad? The plagues? The bloodied Sun?
translation: 那么，即使没有那场大战，一切也一样糟？瘟疫？染血的太阳？

text: It might have taken longer. 'We are never blind to stones, but we cannot see the earth.'
translation: 也许只会来得更慢些。『我们从不无视石头，却看不见大地。』

text: That's one of his. No-one knows what it means.
translation: 那是他的句子。没人知道是什么意思。

text: I liked it, though.
translation: 不过，我喜欢。

text: [An awkward shrug.]
translation: [尴尬地耸耸肩。]

text: ...you're right, Aristide. If we wanted a working continent, we shouldn't have been firing fungus at each other.
translation: ……你说得对，阿里斯蒂德。我们若想要一个还能运转的大陆，就不该朝彼此扔真菌。

text: ...the nihilist has a point.
translation: ……虚无主义者说得在理。

text: ...Jean-Bernard is right. The Stars are wrong.
translation: ……让-贝尔纳说得对。群星出了差错。

text: Hear that, lads? Democracy in action.
translation: 听见了吗，伙计们？这就是活生生的民主。

text: Why do I have the sense, [q=alias.formal], that you understand these matters better than I?
translation: 为什么我总觉得，[q=alias.formal]，你比我对这些事懂得更多？

text: And so neither can we know if I'm right, eh? But, thank you.
translation: 那么，我们同样无从知道我是否正确了，嗯？不过，谢谢你。

text: [Leopold struggles to decide on an expression. Eventually, he grinds his teeth..]
translation: [利奥波德努力想摆出一副表情。最终，他磨了磨牙。]

text: Thank you. Although I hope that I am wrong.
translation: 谢谢你。不过我希望自己是错的。

text: This is the State, Aristide.
translation: 这就是邦国,阿里斯蒂德。

text: Exactly! We had an election - not only an election, but a select and refined election! Free of Icarians and un...patriots! A republican distillate, my friends. Like wine to cognac. Oh, the cognac is perhaps a little rough on the throat. Perhaps the hangover is -
translation: 正是!我们举行过一场选举——不只是选举,而是一场精挑细选、蒸馏提纯的选举!没有伊加利亚人,也没有不……爱国者!共和国的精华,朋友们。好比葡萄酒之于白兰地。哦,白兰地也许有点呛喉咙。也许宿醉是——

text: Philomèle coughs gently. She takes care not to look in my direction.
translation: 菲洛梅尔轻轻咳了一声。她刻意不朝我这边看。

text: La marquise flatters me.
translation: 侯爵夫人过誉了。

text: Madame is wise.
translation: 夫人明智。

text: [Place a finger to my lips, as if touching them by accident. Smile, very slightly.]
translation: [把一根手指按在唇边,仿佛不经意地碰到。极轻地微笑。]

text: Relax and join in.
translation: 放松些,加入进去。

text: Remain a smiling, distant presence.
translation: 保持着微笑而疏离的姿态。

text: Join in; perform friendship; solicitously demonstrate my concern for poor Philomèle.
translation: 加入进去;演好这场友情;殷勤地表现出我对可怜的菲洛梅尔的关切。

text: Be solicitous; demonstrate my concern for poor Philomèle.
translation: 表现得体贴些;显出我对可怜的菲洛梅尔的关切。

text: The wild mood passes, the moths depart - but they'll always remember something enchanted about the evening.
translation: 狂放的气氛过去了,飞蛾散去——但他们总会记得,这个夜晚有种着了魔的意味。

text: Philomèle rallies; but they'll always remember something poisoned about the evening.
translation: 菲洛梅尔打起精神;但他们总会记得,这个夜晚有种下了毒的意味。

text: By their words shall ye know them, hm, Leopold?
translation: 听其言,知其人,嗯,莱奥波德?

text: And I'm sorry, Leopold.
translation: 还有,对不起,莱奥波德。

text: What?
translation: 什么？

text: I mean - Moscow -
translation: 我是说——莫斯科——

text: Your mouth! I'm not a nihilist, and I'm not a Russian! I'm from Lappeenranta!
translation: 嘴上留神!我不是虚无主义者,也不是俄国人!我来自拉彭兰塔!

text: ...sorry.
translation: ……抱歉。

text: Chemin-de-fer - railway. You know it?
translation: 铁轨牌——就是“铁路”。你知道吗?

text: It's like baccarat...?
translation: 跟巴卡拉差不多……?

text: ...but the bank moves round the table. Yes.
translation: ……不过庄家绕桌轮转。没错。

text: ...but I don't remember exactly.
translation: ……不过我记不太清了。

text: Not really.
translation: 不太知道。

text: Deal me in.
translation: 算我一个。

text: That's a casino game. Aren't there laws about playing in a café?
translation: 那是赌场的玩法。在咖啡馆里赌,难道没有法律管吗?

text: The authoriteeees!
translation: 当——当局!

text: For these tiny sums? The casinos, and the Milice, will not trouble themselves. But don't let us drag you into anything illicit...
translation: 就这点小钱?赌场和民兵团都不会自找麻烦。不过,可别让我们把你拖进什么非法的事……

text: [Back Out] Perhaps I'll just watch, for now.
translation: [退出] 也许眼下我看看就好。

text: Oh, don't worry. You'll pick it up as you go. [He grins.]
translation: 哦,别担心。玩着玩着你就学会了。[他咧嘴一笑。]

text: It's your turn as the bank. What's the limit?
translation: 轮到你坐庄了。限额多少?

text: Relax: you don't need to understand chemin-de-fer or baccarat. All you need to know is that the players take turns as the banker, and the banker sets the limit on the bets. So pick a big limit, impress the enthusiasts, perhaps lose all your money if you don't have the skills. Or pick a small limit and ride quietly along.
translation: 放松:你不必弄懂铁轨牌或巴卡拉。你只需知道:玩家轮流坐庄,庄家定下赌注的限额。所以,要么定个大限额,震住那些牌迷——要是你技艺不精,也许会输光全部身家;要么定个小限额,安安静静跟着玩。

text: These rapscallions are drawing cards out of a woman's shoe and playing for small stakes. You're not going to lose your shirt. Or whatever other Outfit you're wearing.
translation: 这群捣蛋鬼正从一只女人的鞋里摸牌,赌的又是小注。你不会输掉衬衫的。或者你身上穿的别的什么行头。

text: [Bet cautiously] Five francisques.
translation: [谨慎下注] 五枚法兰西斧币。

text: [Bet confidently] Ten francisques.
translation: [自信下注] 十枚法兰西斧币。

text: [BE VALIANT!] FIFTEEN FRANCISQUES.
translation: [拿出勇气来!] 十五枚法兰西斧币!

text: Eh.
translation: 嗯。

text: Mm.
translation: 唔。

text: Now that's a man!
translation: 这才叫真男人!

text: [Let the cards fall where they may - a one in five chance of winning.] 'A throw of the dice will never abolish chance!'
translation: [让牌听天由命——五分之一的机会能赢。]“骰子一掷,永远取消不了偶然!”

text: Mention my name to Andrée, the bookseller - at the Librairie des Heures, near the station - and it'll open a door for you. Perhaps on the other side of that door, you'll find this Nina.
translation: 向书商安德烈提起我的名字——车站附近的时辰书店——那会为你开一扇门。也许在那扇门后,你就会找到那位尼娜。

text: Remember me to her...?
translation: 替我向她问声好……?

text: You great lump of dough. [But he says it softly.]
translation: 你这团大面团。[不过他说得很轻。]

text: Give Andrée my compliments. Perhaps she can help you find your friend.
translation: 替我向安德烈问好。也许她能帮你找到你的朋友。

text: 'Friend'?
translation: “朋友”?

text: Or whatever it is that [[Nina Lagasse]] is to you. I'm glad not to be involved with this business. Go carefully.
translation: 或者,随[[尼娜·拉加斯]]对你来说是别的什么。我很庆幸没掺和进这桩事。小心行事。

text: [Sip casually from my drink, as if I hadn't heard anything.]
translation: [随意啜一口酒,仿佛什么都没听见。]

text: [Turn an imaginary key in the lock of my mouth; drop the imaginary key into Aristide's pastis.]
translation: [在我嘴上的锁孔里转动一把想象中的钥匙;再把那把想象中的钥匙丢进阿里斯蒂德的茴香酒里。]

text: "Did you hear this one yet? A [[Crucian]] walks into a bar in Berlin..."
translation: “这个笑话你听过吗?一个[[介壳种]]走进柏林的一家酒吧……”

text: "...and then she says, 'but why lamb?"' [Pause for laughter]
translation: “……然后她说:『可为什么是羔羊?』”[停一停,等笑声]

text: "...and then she says, 'but then why does the Form have four ends?"' [Pause for laughter]
translation: “……然后她说:『那为什么“形态”有四个末端?』”[停一停,等笑声]

text: Laughter is not forthcoming. Except for Aristide, who pounds the table and nearly chokes on his pipe.
translation: 笑声没有如期而至。只有阿里斯蒂德例外——他捶着桌子,差点被烟斗呛死。

text: I don't get it. Aristide, can you explain?
translation: 我没听懂。阿里斯蒂德,你能解释解释吗?

text: What? No, I don't understand the joke at all. But I liked the accents. He does good accents, our [q=alias.familiar]!
translation: 什么?不,这笑话我压根没懂。但我喜欢那些口音。他学口音学得真好,咱们的[q=alias.familiar]!

text: Table-pounding chortles from Aristide; a wicked giggle from Philomèle; an unexpectedly falsetto titter from Jean-Bernard. Even Leopold allows himself a thin smile.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德捶桌闷笑;菲洛梅尔促狭地咯咯笑;让-贝尔纳发出一声意外尖细的假声窃笑。连莱奥波德也破例露出一丝浅笑。

text: Now that you have what you need from us, eh? [Aristide wags a sorrowful finger.] That is our fate, my friends: we are a well in the desert, and when the traveller has drunk his fill, he will pass on to his true destination. Adieu, [q=alias.familiar]!
translation: 如今你从我们这儿拿到了想要的,嗯?[阿里斯蒂德伤心地摇了摇手指。] 这就是我们的命,朋友们:我们是沙漠里的一口井,旅人喝足了水,就会继续走向他真正的目的地。别了,[q=alias.familiar]!

text: [Truth] Say rather a friendly campfire, Aristide. [Nod at his pipe.] I'll see you again.
translation: [实话] 不如说是一堆友善的篝火,阿里斯蒂德。[朝他的烟斗点点头。] 我们还会再见。

text: You had your free drinks, and my business cannot wait. Let's not pretend we're family.
translation: 你已经喝过你的免费酒了,我的正事等不起。别装得我们像一家人。

text: [Lie] Say rather a friendly campfire, Aristide. [Nod at his pipe.] I'll see you again.
translation: [谎话] 不如说是一堆友善的篝火,阿里斯蒂德。[朝他的烟斗点点头。] 我们还会再见。

text: You know, [q=alias.familiar], in this town we call them cards.
translation: 你知道吗,[q=alias.familiar],在这镇上,我们管那叫纸牌。

text: Hush. He's quoting Mazarine.
translation: 嘘。他引用的是马扎里纳。

text: No no - it's Mallarmé -
translation: 不不——是马拉美——

text: Never mind the salon nonsense. Shut up and draw.
translation: 别管那些沙龙里的胡话。闭嘴,发牌。

text: [Winning hand] A natural!
translation: [胜局] 天牌!

text: [Losing hand] I have nothing here of any worth.
translation: [败局] 我手里什么值钱的也没有。

text: I thought I had that one.
translation: 我还以为那一局是我的。

text: [Try to conceal a momentary fumble.]
translation: [试着掩饰一瞬间的手忙脚乱。]

text: Very good, [q=alias.familiar]. But now we have to take the rest of your money.
translation: 很好,[q=alias.familiar]。不过现在,我们得赢走你剩下的钱。

text: Heaven's name in a brothel of shit!
translation: 老天爷的名讳,掉进屎坑妓院了!

text: Aristide. Please.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德。请别说了。

text: The game continues...
translation: 牌局继续……

text: Aristide, nothing! This... interloper... with his... cuckold's hand... has cleaned me out. This stupid game. I'm finished with it.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德?什么也没赢!这个……不速之客……凭他那……戴了绿帽的手……把我搜刮得干干净净。这破游戏。我不玩了。

text: I also must withdraw.
translation: 我也得收手了。

text: I'm not making any more charitable donations to newcomers with... unexpectedly good luck.
translation: 我可不想再向运气……出乎意料地好的新人,做慈善捐献了。

text: I'm afraid, [q=alias.first], the games are finished for today.
translation: 恐怕,[q=alias.first],今天的牌局到此为止了。

text: [Grumbles inarticulately as he gathers up the cards.]
translation: [一边收牌,一边含混不清地咕哝。]

text: What charming money you have, [q=alias.formal].
translation: 你的钱可真讨喜,[q=alias.formal]。

text: Oh! It's me!
translation: 哦!是我!

text: Unlucky in love... lucky at cards. Thank you for your contributions.
translation: 情场失意……赌场得意。多谢你的慷慨。

text: [A game of cards?]
translation: [打牌?]

text: [Join the card game.]
translation: [加入牌局。]

text: [Give a slow smile, finish my drink, and stand up.]
translation: [缓缓露出微笑,喝完杯里的酒,站起身来。]

text: Of course it would be Leopold. He doesn't miss much.
translation: 果然又是莱奥波德。他什么都不会看漏。

text: What are you talking about? Let go of me, you scoundrel!
translation: 你在胡说什么?放开我,你这无赖!

text: Come on, don't swallow that from him. Time to go, [q=alias.formal].
translation: 得啦,别信他那一套。该走了,[q=alias.formal]。

text: Well - perhaps we could let this pass, this once -
translation: 呃——也许这一次,我们可以就当没发生过——

text: Perhaps, monsieur, it is best if you find somewhere else to sit.
translation: 也许,先生,您最好另找个地方坐。

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: Go on! It's the broom for you! And don't let us see you here again!
translation: 滚!该用扫帚赶你了!别再让我们在这儿见到你!

text: Back again, is it? Go away. Take your cheating somewhere else.
translation: 又回来了?走开。要出千,去别处出。

text: [Go away.]
translation: [走开。]

text: [Take my cheating somewhere else.]
translation: [换个地方出千。]

text: Jean-Bernard tells a story about Citroën brought in for repair that he thinks might actually be haunted. Philomèle examines her reflection.  Aristide accuses Leopold of stealing his pipe, until he finds he's sitting on it...
translation: 让-贝尔纳讲了个故事:一辆送来修理的雪铁龙,他觉得可能真的闹鬼。菲洛梅尔端详着自己的倒影。阿里斯蒂德指责莱奥波德偷了他的烟斗,直到他发现自己正坐在烟斗上……

text: Another round of drinks, my friends?
translation: 朋友们,再来一轮?

text: Once a prince, always a prince! Come back with the drinks.
translation: 当过王子,永远是王子!带着酒回来!

text: The wild mood passes, the moths depart - but they'll always remember something enchanted about the evening. When they look back, they'll think of this moment as the hinge, the last bright beat before a silence.
translation: 狂放的气氛过去了,飞蛾散去——但他们总会记得,这个夜晚有种着了魔的意味。回望之时,他们会把这一刻当作枢纽,沉默降临前最后一记明亮的节拍。

text: Should I wish to do Zèlia's dirty work... this is my opportunity. Or perhaps I could just convince her that I had. What does she know about curses, anyway?
translation: 倘若我想替泽莉亚干那桩脏活……这正是我的机会。又或者,我只需让她相信我干过了。她懂什么诅咒?

text: [Smile.]
translation: [微笑。]

text: [Roll eyes.]
translation: [翻个白眼。]

text: Philomèle... do you know a woman named Zèlia?
translation: 菲洛梅尔……你认识一个叫泽莉亚的女人吗?

text: Zèlia Badat? Sits in the park, on the bright side? Complains about modern morals, throws rocks at the pigeons?
translation: 泽莉亚·巴达特?坐在公园向阳一侧的那个?抱怨世风日下、拿石头砸鸽子的那个?

text: I didn't see her throwing any rocks.
translation: 我没见她砸什么石头。

text: That's her.
translation: 那就是她。

text: Perhaps she ran out of rocks. Or pigeons.
translation: 也许是石头用完了。或者鸽子用完了。

text: Poor old creature. The Badats used to be very grand, you know. But there were the confiscations, you know, and then they shot her husband... she never really recovered. I think her mind is going. Spiders in the attic, you know.
translation: 可怜的老东西。你知道,巴达特家从前可是显赫之家。可你知道,后来有没收家产那档子事,再后来他们枪毙了她的丈夫……她始终没能缓过来。我看她的脑子在走神。阁楼里进了蜘蛛,你知道的。

text: Why do you ask?
translation: 你为什么问起这个?

text: She mentioned your name, that's all.
translation: 她提到了你的名字,仅此而已。

text: She mentioned your name. She really doesn't like you.
translation: 她提到了你的名字。她真的很不喜欢你。

text: She, ah, wanted to commission me to put a curse on you.
translation: 她,呃,想雇我给你下个诅咒。

text: I know her a little. We used to see each other at church. I felt sorry for her. But she never really approved of me anyway. And I don't think she likes people feeling sorry for her.
translation: 我略略认识她。我们从前常在教堂碰面。我那时可怜她。不过她反正从来没真正看得起我。而且我觉得,她不喜欢别人可怜她。

text: Philomèle sighs, straightens her shoulders, clearly wants to change the subject.
translation: 菲洛梅尔叹了口气,挺直肩膀,显然想换个话题。

text: She wanted you to do what?
translation: 她想让你做什么?

text: Oho! A vendetta on la marquise! There will be blood!
translation: 嚯!冲着侯爵夫人的仇怨!要见血了!

text: Shut up, Aristide. Well, I knew I wasn't her favourite person, but... Heavens.
translation: 闭嘴,阿里斯蒂德。好吧,我早知道我不是她的心头好,但……天哪。

text: So... are you going to do it? Put a curse on me?
translation: 那么……你打算做吗?给我下个诅咒?

text: Well, she did say you were a traitor. And a defiler of husbands. So...
translation: 唔,她确实说你是个叛徒。还说你专勾引有妇之夫。所以……

text: Of course not.
translation: 当然不会。

text: [Wink.]
translation: [眨眨眼。]

text: A defiler of - well, tell her she's a collaborationist old viper, and if she'd ever paid her husband any attention -
translation: 勾引有妇之夫——哼,那就替我告诉她,她是条附逆的老毒蛇,要是她当年肯多留意自己的丈夫——

text: No. No, don't say anything. I'm sorry.
translation: 不。不,什么也别说了。抱歉。

text: Do you believe in curses?
translation: 你相信诅咒吗?

text: Leopold is a loudmouth. But he knows me well.
translation: 莱奥波德是个大嘴巴。但他很了解我。

text: You're a gentleman.
translation: 你是个正人君子。

text: Bah.
translation: 哼。

text: She believes in everything. Her mind is so open that you must watch carefully, lest you trip and fall in.
translation: 她什么都信。她的脑子敞得太开,你得小心看着,免得绊一跤栽进去。

text: [One eye widens to gleaming watchfulness.]
translation: [一只眼睛睁大,闪出警觉的光芒。]

text: [Stroke its back.]
translation: [抚摸它的背。]

text: [Rub its chin.]
translation: [挠挠它的下巴。]

text: [Avoid contact.]
translation: [避免接触。]

text: [The eye opens very slightly wider.]
translation: [那只眼睛微微又睁大了一点。]

text: [An ear flicks lazily.]
translation: [一只耳朵懒洋洋地抖动。]

text: The animal is essentially inert, monsieur. Expect nothing of him.
translation: 这动物基本上是一动不动,先生。别对它抱什么指望。

text: [Withdraw.]
translation: [退开。]

text: This is the road out of Antibes town, to the green and villa-studded heights of Cap d'Antibes.
translation: 这条路通往昂蒂布城外,通向昂蒂布角绿意葱茏、别墅散布的高地。

text: Perhaps I'll have business there later.
translation: 也许以后我在那儿会有事要办。

text: That's bloody steep.
translation: 那坡可真够陡的。

text: For now, my business is in Antibes town - looking for Nina.
translation: 眼下,我的事在昂蒂布城里——寻找尼娜。

text: Fortunately, my information suggests Nina is in Antibes town. If that's true, I won't need to climb the hill.
translation: 幸好,我的消息说尼娜就在昂蒂布城里。若果真如此,我就不必爬那座山了。

text: [Back into town.]
translation: [返回城里。]

text: What?
translation: 什么？

text: You are the signaire? I am Zèlia. Do not ask my family's name.
translation: 你就是符师?我是泽莉亚。不要问我娘家的姓氏。

text: [Signaire...]
I am ready to carry out your trabai.
translation: 我已准备好办你的差事。

text: Good. Good.
translation: 好。好。

text: She squints suspiciously.
translation: 她怀疑地眯起眼。

text: I'll consider the trabai.
translation: 我会考虑这桩差事。

text: You must. I will suffer this woman no longer.
translation: 你必须办。我再也忍受不了那个女人。

text: No. This is none of my business.
translation: 不。这不关我的事。

text: [Smile, enigmatically.]
translation: [莫测高深地微笑。]

text: Yes? Then listen.
translation: 是吗?那就听好。

text: His business, like others who came to Brancrug, was healing and warding. And he didn't take payment in cash - only services. The ones who took cash payment, the mascs, were exactly the ones he was brought in to defend against.
translation: 他的营生,和别的来布兰库格的人一样,是治病和驱邪。他不收现钱——只收服务。而那些收现钱的,那些巫师,正是他被请来防备的。

text: Thirty years ago in Brancrug, I met a man who called himself a signaire. Not a true adept - but he knew some tricks. Enough to break the laws of the world and the Church, doing little works among the people.
translation: 三十年前,在布兰库格,我遇见一个自称符师的人。算不上真正的修士——但他会些门道。足以违犯尘世与教会的律法,在百姓中间做些小小的法术。

text: You are not the one I summoned. The signaire. Go away from here.
translation: 你不是我召来的那位。符师。离开这里。

text: Why then are you even here?
translation: 那你到底为什么在这里?

text: There is a café on the square, near the fountain and the flag. Every day she goes there. Philomèle! Blight her! Punish her!
translation: 广场上有一家咖啡馆,挨着喷泉和旗杆。她每天都要去。菲洛梅尔!降祸于她!惩罚她!

text: No. Turn back, Zèlia. This will twist your soul.
translation: 不。回头吧,泽莉亚。这会让你的灵魂扭曲。

text: Don't lecture me. You small-minded man. Don't lecture me. You know nothing of a woman's pain.
translation: 别对我说教。你这个小心眼的男人。别对我说教。你根本不懂一个女人的痛。

text: You are not the one I called.
translation: 你不是我召唤的人。

text: [Buried the heart...]
translation: [埋下了那颗心……]

text: A friend of mine - a southern woman - used to dance at the Ecdysis Club in London. When her heart was broken, she set out to revenge herself. She told me that she had buried a songbird's heart at the dark of a moon, to call for the red help she wanted.
translation: 我的一位朋友——南方女子——曾在伦敦的蜕皮俱乐部跳舞。心碎之后,她决意报复。她告诉我,她在月暗之夜埋下一只歌鸟的心,以召来她想要的红色援手。

text: She had owned that songbird almost a year. I recall that she had to crush its throat and cut its heart out with a pocket-knife. To prove her conviction - or perhaps only because the one she called was one who liked that kind of thing.
translation: 那只歌鸟,她养了将近一年。我记得,她得先捏碎它的喉咙,再用小刀剜出它的心脏。为了证明自己的信念——又或许只是因为,她召来的那位,偏偏喜欢这种东西。

text: What kind of work is this, madame? Is it, after all, a signaire that you want?
translation: 这是什么活计,夫人?说到底,你要的是一位符师吧?

text: Call yourself what you will. Are you ready for the work?
translation: 随你自称什么。你准备好干活了吗?

text: Why?
translation: 为什么?

text: That is not your concern.
translation: 这不关你的事。

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: No. This too cruel.
translation: 不。这太残忍了。

text: Then go. Go! And tell no-one. I am a woman of good reputation and your slanders will not touch me.
translation: 那就走。走!不许告诉任何人。我是名声清白的女人,你的诽谤伤不到我。

text: I'll consider it.
translation: 我会考虑的。

text: You'll consider it? Consider it quickly. I have told you what I want. And how I will reward you.
translation: 你会考虑?那就快点考虑。我已经告诉你我要什么了,也告诉你我会怎么酬谢你。

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: You refused the trabai. Why are you buzzing again in my ear?
translation: 你拒绝了那桩差事。为什么又在我耳边嗡嗡作响?

text: Am I not? You buried the heart. I am here. I wished only to assure myself you were not frivolous. The earth shivers. The sky will be blood.
translation: 我不是吗?你埋了那颗心。我来了。我只是想确认你不是个轻浮的人。大地颤抖。天空将染成血色。

text: Perhaps not. But may I speak with you?
translation: 也许不是。但我能与你说几句话吗?

text: I have wasted enough words with you. Go.
translation: 我跟你白费的话已经够多了。走。

text: I have not. I'll return when I have.
translation: 我可没白费够。等白费够了,我再回来。

text: I've done as you asked. Listen; soon you will hear the news of her illness.
translation: 我照你说的办了。听着:很快你就会听到她生病的消息。

text: [Deception] I've done as you asked. Her dreams tonight will be the first of many miseries.
translation: [欺骗] 我照你说的办了。她今晚的梦,将是日后许多苦难的开端。

text: Yes. Yes. I only wish I could see her when the pain begins.
translation: 好。好。我只盼疼痛开始的时候,我能亲眼看着她。

text: I don't believe you. Bring me proof. I will not be gulled by a mountebank.
translation: 我不信你。拿证据来。我不会被个江湖骗子蒙骗。

text: I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: 我在找一个名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人……

text: Lagasse? Oh yes, I know about this Lagasse. When we've finished our business, we will speak of her.
translation: 拉加斯?哦当然,我知道这个拉加斯。等我们的事办完,再谈她。

text: I'm looking for a woman. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找一位女士。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: Seek her in hell for all I care. Go.
translation: 随你去地狱找她,与我无关。走。

text: I need to find a woman called [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我要找一个名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人。

text: You said. Stop wasting my time. The trabai first.
translation: 你说过了。别再浪费我的时间。差事要紧。

text: I know the name. We can discuss that when our business is done.
translation: 我听过这个名字。等正事办完,再谈这个。

text: One more thing. We were to discuss [[Nina Lagasse]] when our business was done.
translation: 还有一件事。我们说好,正事办完要谈[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: Goodbye, Madame Zèlia.
translation: 再见,泽莉亚夫人。

text: Oh yes. She is so full of herself, that Lagasse. And an actress!
translation: 哦,没错。那个拉加斯,可真是自以为了不起。还是个女演员!

text: Wait! I have one more task for you.
translation: 等等!我还有一件事要交给你办。

text: Where did he go?
translation: 他去哪儿了?

text: How much will you pay me?
translation: 你肯出多少钱?

text: Well?
translation: 怎么样?

text: That pétasse Griotte stole him. Took him to another city.
translation: 那个骚货格里奥特把他偷走了。带去了另一座城。

text: What does he look like?
translation: 他长什么样?

text: You are a signaire. You should know how these things are done. Tell him my name.
translation: 你是个符师。这种事的门道,你该明白。告诉他我的名字。

text: With regret, madame, I decline your offer.
translation: 很遗憾,夫人,我回绝您的差遣。

text: Then I curse you! I curse your name and your shadow! Leave me alone! Never return!
translation: 那我就诅咒你!我诅咒你的名字,诅咒你的影子!别再来烦我!永远别回来!

text: Oh, please, monsieur, please, if you change your mind, return to me. I beg you. I miss him so.
translation: 哦,求求您,先生,求求您,要是您改了主意,就回来找我。我求您了。我太想他了。

text: Did you find my husband?
translation: 你找到我丈夫了吗?

text: Yes. He's in Berlin.
translation: 找到了。他在柏林。

text: Give that to me!
translation: 把那东西给我!

text: It will be done.
translation: 会办成的。

text: Yes. Yes! It is a pact now. Our pact.
translation: 好。好!如今这便是约定了。我们的约定。

text: I buried the heart. I have been waiting. Four hundred francisques for your trabai.
translation: 我埋了那颗心。我一直在等。你的差事,值四百枚法兰西斧币。

text: [Say nothing about that.]
translation: [对那件事只字不提。]

text: She tosses her head. Her eyes are like flecks of beach-glass.
translation: 她一甩头。她的眼睛像是海滩玻璃的碎屑。

text: Go away. I will not speak with you.
translation: 走开。我不跟你说话。

text: The heart of a pet? Did you take its life with your own hands?
translation: 一只宠物的心?是你亲手取了它的性命?

text: Of course.
translation: 当然。

text: I did not enjoy it. We will speak of it no more.
translation: 我并不喜欢那样。此事我们不再提起。

text: You wanted me to punish Philomèle. But you said 'Cornéline' just now.
translation: 你要我惩罚的是菲洛梅尔。可你方才说的是“科尔内利娜”。

text: I know what I said. Don't confuse me. She's just as bad, anyway.
translation: 我知道我说了什么。别来搅乱我。反正她也一样坏。

text: So? Have you dealt with Philomèle?
translation: 怎么样？菲洛梅尔的事办妥了吗？

text: [Consider the nature of curses.]
translation: [思量一下诅咒的本质。]

text: [You could use a Wither item to this end. It could bring this Philomèle nightmares and bad fortune - sicken and immiserate her. It wouldn't kill her unless she's very weak. But it wouldn't be very nice.]
translation: [你可以用一件凋零之物来达成此事。它能给这个菲洛梅尔带来噩梦与厄运——令她染病、陷入困顿。除非她虚弱至极，否则不会要她的命。但这终究算不上光彩。]

text: [That said, you're not in the Suppression Bureau any more. You need to find Nina. You could use the money.]
translation: [话说回来，你已不在防剿局了。你得找到尼娜。这笔钱你用得着。]

text: [And it might be possible to convince Zèlia that you've cursed her enemy, even if you haven't.]
translation: [而且，即便你并没有真的诅咒她的敌人，也或许有可能让泽莉亚相信你已经下了咒。]

text: Later! First, the trabai.
translation: 回头再说！先办差事！

text: She is unpardonable! A traitor, a slut, a defiler of husbands. Moral filth.
translation: 她不可饶恕！一个叛徒，一个荡妇，一个玷污人夫的东西。道德上的污秽。

text: But that is not your concern.
translation: 但这不关你的事。

text: Keep it secret. I am a woman of importance. No-one reputable will believe you.
translation: 保密。我是一位有身份的女人。没有哪个体面人会相信你。

text: No. This business is beneath me.
translation: 不。这种事有失我的身份。

text: I give you now one-half the sum we agreed. The rest on your return. Go quickly.
translation: 我现在付你约定数目的一半。余下的等你回来再付。快去吧。

text: Make her suffer.
translation: 让她受苦。

text: [Go.]
Well... perhaps it is so.
translation: 好吧……也许确实如此。

text: Do you take me for an imbecile? Your lies insult us both. Go!
translation: 你把我当傻子吗？你的谎言侮辱了我们两个。滚！

text: This is what I require of you.
translation: 这就是我要你做的事。

text: I have been thinking about the matter, Madame Zèlia...
translation: 泽莉亚夫人，我一直在考虑这件事……

text: Have you dealt with that sow Cornéline?
translation: 那头母猪科尔内利娜的事，办妥了吗？

text: Yes? Yes!
translation: 真的？太好了！

text: She closes her eyes for a moment, in pain or exultation.
translation: 她闭上了一会儿眼睛，不知是痛苦还是狂喜。

text: [Her eyes glitter; her hands open and close.]
translation: [她眼中闪闪发光；双手张开又合拢。]

text: Here. The rest of your payment.
translation: 给你。余下的报酬。

text: Here. Your payment.
translation: 给你。你的报酬。
