text: One more thing. I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: 还有一件事。我在找一个叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人……

text: She was seen to enter the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. An American woman built it, before the wars. New money. Worthless. Such things went on behind the gates! And now it is worse. Burn it to the ground for all I care.
translation: 有人看见她进了今日疗养院。战前，一个美国女人建了它。暴发户，一文不值。那大门后面什么龌龊事没有！如今更是不堪。就算把它烧成平地我也不在乎。

text: Where can I find the Sanitarium?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到这家疗养院？

text: Go back and climb the steps. Follow the road out of town, past the park, into the Cap.
translation: 往回走，爬上那些台阶。顺着出城的路走，经过公园，进入昂蒂布角。

text: [Leave without a word.]
translation: [一言不发地离开。]

text: My husband is gone. Find him for me.
translation: 我的丈夫不见了。替我找到他。

text: Please.
translation: 求你了。

text: Which other city?
translation: 那又是哪座城？

text: I laid the curse on Philomèle. Not on Griotte.
translation: 我把诅咒施在了菲洛梅尔身上。不是格里奥特。

text: North. East. How would I know? I am no detective. If I knew, I would not ask your help.
translation: 北边。东边。我怎么会知道？我又不是侦探。我若知道，就不会请你帮忙了。

text: Please.
translation: 求你了。

text: Yes, yes, I know, of course. I'm not a fool. They're all the same anyway, these sluts.
translation: 是是，我当然知道。我不是傻瓜。反正这些贱人都一个样。

text: I have no pictures. And it was years ago now. Years. He will be different. Only mention my name. Zèlia. He'll remember me.
translation: 我没有照片。而且那是多年前的事了。许多年前。他会变样。你只需提起我的名字。泽莉亚。他会记得我的。

text: But how will I know him?
translation: 可我该怎么认出他？

text: Is he tall? Short? How old?
translation: 他个子高吗？矮？多大年纪？

text: Very tall, very distinguished. A real gentleman. Of course you will know him at once.
translation: 很高，很体面。一位真正的绅士。你自然一眼就能认出他。

text: Yes. He's in Kerisham.
translation: 是的。他在凯尔伊苏姆。

text: Yes. He's in Cracow.
translation: 是的。他在克拉科夫。

text: Give that to me!
translation: 把那东西给我!

text: Give that to me!
translation: 把那东西给我!

text: How much would you ask?
translation: 你想要多少？

text: What is his name?
translation: 他叫什么名字？

text: It doesn't matter, his name. Names muddle me. Will you find him?
translation: 他的名字，无关紧要。名字让我犯糊涂。你会找到他吗？

text: A thousand francisques.
translation: 一千枚法兰西斧币。

text: Ten thousand francisques.
translation: 一万枚法兰西斧币。

text: One hundred thousand francisques.
translation: 十万枚法兰西斧币。

text: No charge. And no promises. But I will do what I can.
translation: 分文不取。也不作保证。但我尽力而为。

text: Agreed. Hurry.
translation: 一言为定。快去吧。

text: I miss him, signaire. I loved him so. Even now I will forgive him.
translation: 我想他，符师。我那样爱他。即便是现在，我也愿原谅他。

text: Please hurry.
translation: 请快些。

text: Let me think...
translation: 让我想想……

text: [Promise] I will find him.
translation: [承诺] 我会找到他。

text: [Careful] I will look for him.
translation: [谨慎] 我会去找他。

text: [Nod and leave.]
translation: [点头离开。]

text: Not yet. I'll return when I do.
translation: 还没有。找到他我就回来。

text: I... said already that was not something I would do for you.
translation: 我……已经说过，那件事我不会替你做的。

text: No. This is none of my business.
translation: 不。这不关我的事。

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: I am so grateful, monsieur. I will always remember you in my prayers.
translation: 我感激不尽，先生。我会永远在祈祷中记着你。

text: [Incline my head and withdraw.]
translation: [微微颔首，抽身退去。]

text: I... said already that was not something I would do for you. You became very angry. You don't remember?
translation: 我……已经说过，那件事我不会替你做的。你当时非常生气。你不记得了？

text: You are a decent man. I place my trust in your decency.
translation: 你是个正派人。我把信任托付给你的正直。

text: [Leave]
translation: [离开]

text: She stares at me.
translation: 她凝视着我。

text: For just a moment, she wavers.
translation: 有那么一瞬，她动摇了。

text: He'll remember me now. He was weak; he was stupid. But I'll forgive him, when he comes back to me.
translation: 他现在会记得我了。他曾软弱，他曾愚蠢。但等他回到我身边，我会原谅他。

text: But you punished her. She'll grow ugly.
translation: 可你惩罚了她。她会变丑的。

text: There's a kind of smoothness in her eyes, like water flowing behind a pane of glass. For a moment it is as if she's forgotten who I am.
translation: 她眼底透着一种平滑，像水在玻璃板后流动。有那么一刻，仿佛她已经忘了我是什么人。

text: Yes, no, yes... it never works. It is never any good at all. Should know better by now. You are right, monsieur, of course you are right...
translation: 是，不，是……从来都不管用。从来都毫无用处。早该明白的。您说得对，先生，您当然说得对……

text: And then she's lost in her thoughts, lips moving slightly.
translation: 然后她便沉入自己的思绪，嘴唇微微翕动。

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: Wait. Please! I need your help. Something else.
translation: 等等。求你了！我需要你的帮助。是别的事。

text: I'm looking for someone too. A woman. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我也在找一个人。一个女人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: Of course, yes, I know. She's in that stupid Sanitarium. Past the park, out of town, in the Cap.
translation: 当然，是，我知道。她在那家蠢透了的疗养院里。过了公园，出城，在昂蒂布角。

text: Now will you help me?
translation: 现在你肯帮我了吗？

text: Here...
translation: 给你……

text: [Go away.]
translation: [走开。]

text: HAPPY ENDING!
translation: 大团圆结局！

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: You're sitting very close to those... holes.
translation: 你坐得离那些……洞太近了。

text: Holes?
translation: 洞？

text: Abysses.
translation: 深渊。

text: Wounds.
translation: 伤口。

text: I am not. And there are no holes. And the matter is in any case irrelevant.
translation: 我才没有。而且也没有洞。此事无论如何都无关紧要。

text: And after consideration... I refuse it still.
translation: 再三考虑之后……我仍然拒绝。

text: It's difficult to overstate the contempt with which Zèlia pronounces the word 'actress'.
translation: 泽莉亚吐出“女演员”这个词时的那种轻蔑，怎么形容都不为过。

text: I have the skills to create a Withering item - if I want.
translation: 我有能力制作一件凋零之物——只要我愿意。

text: I don't currently have the skills to create a Withering item. I could increase one of [[Hushery]], [[Nyctodromy]] or [[Skolekosophy]] to 5; I could try to trick Zèlia; or I could abandon the whole sorry business.
translation: 我目前还没有能力制作凋零之物。我可以把[[静默术]]、[[夜游术]]或[[蠕虫学]]之一提升到 5；我可以试着骗过泽莉亚；也可以干脆丢开这桩倒霉的差事。

text: Tell me.
translation: 告诉我。

text: I remember you!
translation: 我记得你！

text: Chef?
translation: 头儿？

text: Stay here.
translation: 留在这里。

text: Very well.
translation: 好吧。

text: Nothing just now.
translation: 现在没什么事。

text: [Nod]
translation: [点头]

text: Mathis says you used to be a priest. Why?
translation: 马蒂斯说你从前是神父。为什么？

text: Technically, I still am a priest.
translation: 严格来说，我至今仍是神父。

text: The War. The first one.
translation: 那场战争。头一场。

text: You didn't act much like a priest, when we were out in Ghardaïa.
translation: 我们在加尔达亚那阵子，你可不像个神父。

text: No. I mean that when you're ordained, it kindles a light in the soul. Exalts the phost. That can't be undone. I can still perform sacraments. But I haven't, in... a long time. Almost thirty years.
translation: 不。我的意思是，受圣职之时，灵魂中会点起一缕光。使福斯特升华。这无法逆转。我依然能主持圣事。但我已经有……很久没有做了。将近三十年。

text: No. I mean that there's a formal process - retenebration - that returns me to the secular state. That has to come from Rome. I don't think it ever went through. As long as I don't present myself as a priest, they probably won't bother.
translation: 不。我是说，有一道正式程序——雷特内布拉西翁——能让我回归世俗之身。那必须由罗马颁下。我想它恐怕从未办成。只要我不以神父自居，他们大概也不会来追究。

text: No. I'm a complicated man.
translation: 不。我是个复杂的人。

text: No. I don't now, either.
translation: 不。现在也一样不信。

text: You're changing the subject... Father. [Vincent gives his chortling head-shake.] What changed?
translation: 你在岔开话题……神父大人。[文森特咯咯笑着摇了摇头。] 是什么变了？

text: Too much death, eh?
translation: 死的人太多，嗯？

text: No. That was pretty bad. But it makes it easier when you can tell yourself they're being folded into the Light.
translation: 不。那的确很糟。但若你能告诉自己，他们正被折入光源，心里就会好受些。

text: Part of it.
translation: 有一部分吧。

text: People die. Priests watch. That wasn't it.
translation: 人都会死。神父们在一旁看着。那不是原因。

text: What was the rest?
translation: 那剩下的是什么？

text: So what was?
translation: 那到底是什么？

text: Then...?
translation: 然后呢……？

text: How are you on theology, Vincent?
translation: 文森特，你神学功底如何？

text: What I'd been taught, and what I learnt, didn't fit together.
translation: 别人教我的，与我亲身领会的，对不上。

text: [Shrug.]
translation: [耸耸肩。]

text: [A chortling head-shake,]
translation: [咯咯笑着摇了摇头。]

text: Thought so. Never mind. [Don't get into the theology of it.]
translation: 猜到了。算了。[别去深究其中的神学。]

text: All right. Well... the Church teaches that the Sun is one element of a procession along the seira from the henad. [Get into the theology of it.]
translation: 好吧。唔……教会教导说，太阳是从太一沿赛拉而降的巡行中的一个环节。[讲讲其中的神学。]

text: '[[Henad]]', is it. No, you've lost me. Father.
translation: “[[太一]]”，是吧。不，你把我绕晕了。神父大人。

text: Don't call me that.
translation: 别这么叫我。

text: I mean: everything good - everything, really - is supposed to emanate from the Oneness. It comes down to us from the henads, which participate in the Oneness, along their seirai. And at points along its descent, it manifests as distinct things we perceive. Like the Sun, or the phenomenal Hours.
translation: 我的意思是：一切善——真的，是一切——都据称自至一流出。它从那些参与至一的太一处而来，沿它们的赛拉降临到我们身上。而在它下降途中的某些节点上，它显现为我们所感知的种种不同之物。比如太阳，或那些现象司辰。

text: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

text: Like [Vincent gestures] the railway? And stations?
translation: 就像[文森特比划着]铁路？还有车站？

text: No, not really.
translation: 不，不太一样。

text: Yes, sort of.
translation: 是，差不多。

text: The phenomenal Hours - where the seirai touch the world - are downstream manifestations of the henades. You can call on them. But it doesn't do anything. You can't make them do anything, any more than they can make the henads do things. I'd be like...
translation: 现象司辰——赛拉触及世界之处——是太一下游的显现。你可以呼唤它们。但那无济于事。你无法让它们做任何事，正如它们也无法让太一做任何事。那就好比……

text: That's what I learnt. I was very young. But then the War. One of the battlefield exorcists trained me as his assistant. Father Stanislav.
translation: 那便是我学到的一切。当时我还很年轻。但接着是那场战争。一位战地驱魔师把我训练成他的助手。斯坦尼斯拉夫神父。

text: ...waving at a railway sleeper and expecting the station to change position.
translation: ……对着枕木挥手，却指望车站移动位置。

text: ...expecting light to change colour when it shines on something different.
translation: ……指望光照在不同的东西上就会改变颜色。

text: ...shouting at thunder.
translation: ……冲着雷声大喊。

text: So what's the point of it?
translation: 那这到底有什么意义？

text: ... I don't know. It's unknowable. So I don't know.
translation: ……我不知道。它是不可知的。所以我不知道。

text: The point is the point. It's a perfect eternal double motion of emanation and yearning.
translation: 意义就是意义本身。那是流溢与渴慕的完美永恒的双重运动。

text: There is no point. There doesn't need to be. It's how things are.
translation: 没有意义。也不需要有意义。事情本就是如此。

text: Good question.
translation: 问得好。

text: I didn't know. But I'm not surprised. So the exorcisms. They didn't work?
translation: 我不知道。但我并不意外。那么那些驱魔仪式呢？没有用？

text: That's the problem. They worked very well indeed. I had a knack for it. The spirits came and went at my command. And...
translation: 问题就在这里。它们非但有用，而且灵验得很。我天生就有这本事。灵体随我号令来去自如。而且……

text: I thought, I've been lied to. The eternal can be altered. It's not even that difficult.
translation: 我想：我被骗了。永恒之物是可以改变的。甚至并不怎么难。

text: [I hesitate. Vincent listens.]
translation: [我踌躇片刻。文森特静静听着。]

text: The power of it! Once you taste godhood -even a drop of it - you can't be just a note in the song.
translation: 那种力量！一旦你尝过神性——哪怕只是一滴——你就再不甘心做歌谣中的一个音符。

text: When you see pain everywhere, but you understand it's just the shadow to the light, it's inevitable, then you resign yourself. But when you can make the shadow diminish, just by speaking with it - you start to ask questions.
translation: 当你处处看见痛苦，却明白那不过是光的影子，不可避免，你便会认命。可当你只需与它交谈，就能让影子缩小——你便会开始发问。

text: I started to wonder. If this one thing is not as I've been taught - how deep do the differences go? How high?
translation: 我开始猜想。若这一件事并不如我所受的教导——那么差异究竟有多深？又有多高？

text: It all seemed... daft. All that so-called eternity. And Stanislav and me, emending it.
translation: 一切似乎都……荒诞。那所谓的永恒。而我和斯坦尼斯拉夫，竟在修正它。

text: If I could change it - if it could be changed so easily - where was the perfection? How could it be intended? You start to ask questions.
translation: 若我能改变它——若它如此轻易就能被改变——那完美又在哪里？它又怎能是出自本意？你便会开始发问。

text: I couldn't take it seriously any more. One little exorcist's assistant at the seiral terminus, chasing spirits round like butterflies.
translation: 我再也没法把它当回事了。一个赛拉末梢的小小驱魔师助手，追着灵体，像追蝴蝶一样。

text: It was like when you raise your voice in a chorus, and then you begin to realise it's silence - you're singing alone.
translation: 就像你在合唱中提高嗓门，然后才发觉那是寂静——你一个人在唱。

text: All the teachings had been so restrained. Cream and pale gold. And there was I, in a world of red.
translation: 所有教诲都那么克制。奶油白，浅金黄。而我，却身处一片红色世界。

text: That's strong stuff, Spence.
translation: 这话够重的，斯宾塞。

text: So it was too much death? In the end?
translation: 所以到头来，终究还是死的人太多？

text: So what you're saying, Spence, is that your Church training was too effective?
translation: 那么你的意思是，斯宾塞，你的教会训练过于有效了？

text: I suppose, in a way -
translation: 我想，从某种意义上说——

text: Only parts of it. It was -
translation: 只有一部分。那是——

text: [The train whisle blows. The conductor is walking down the carriage, wearily bellowing. 'Mimata' he cries as he passes our compartment.]
translation: [火车汽笛鸣响。列车员拖着步子沿车厢走来，疲惫地吆喝着。经过我们的隔间时，他喊出“米玛塔”。]

text: IMPORTANT YES THIS IS THE OPPORTUNITY TO RESPOND TO PASSION CHOICES YES
translation: 重要 是的 这是回应激情抉择的机会 是的

text: The unmistakably sensual, intelligent, uncompromising features of the immortal magus Julian [[Coseley]].
translation: 不朽法师朱利安·[[科斯利]]的面容——性感、睿智、毫不妥协，一眼即可辨认。

text: There was an ending...
translation: 曾有过一个结局……

text: [Back to the room.]
translation: [回到房间。]

text: The [[Bureau]] believed that he was killed by a rising competitor. But a Winter-long like Coseley could not die before the date agreed with his patron - any more than he could live beyond that date.
translation: [[防剿局]]相信他是被一个正在崛起的竞争者杀死的。但像科斯利这样的冬之长生者，既不能在与其庇护者约定的日期之前死去，也不可能活过那个日期。

text: Still, he was much diminished. A relief. Coseley was very dangerous.
translation: 尽管如此，他已大不如前。令人安心。科斯利非常危险。

text: Still, he was much diminished. A pity. Coseley had an extraordinary mind.
translation: 尽管如此，他已大不如前。真是可惜。科斯利拥有一副非凡的头脑。

text: [Quote from one of his works.]
translation: [引用他作品中的一句话。]

text: "Speech is a Wound; Silence is Silver. There is no Silver Door, nor can there be, even in the Moon's House…"
translation: “言语是一道创口；沉默是白银。白银之门并不存在，也不可能有，纵在月之居屋中……”

text: Coseley believed that it was language that debased the [[Cross]] into mere humanity.
translation: 科斯利相信，正是语言使[[介壳种]]沦为凡人之身。

text: I never really understood that.
translation: 我从未真正理解过这一点。

text: As far as I could make out, Coseley never much cared if anyone else agreed with him.
translation: 据我所能了解的，科斯利从不在意别人是否认同他。

text: Aubière treats his body with respect. This panel is solid and well-fitted.
translation: 奥比埃善待自己的躯体。这块木板厚实，严丝合缝。

text: A panel of sturdy wood, daubed with the symbol of a cross-charged heart. It resembles the door of the sanitarium dining room; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation: 一块结实的木板，上面涂着一个缀有十字的心形符号。它像疗养院餐厅的门；但它并不是真的门，否则我就能打开它了。

text: Some surgeons have been known to pray in the dead tongue called 'Fucine'. In its written form, that symbol means...
translation: 据说有些外科医生会用一种被称为“富西讷语”的死语祈祷。以书写形式呈现时，那个符号的意思是……

text: ...health, the body, the soul's dwelling-place.
translation: ……健康，躯体，灵魂的居所。

text: ...I don't recall. It can be difficult to understand writing in dreams.
translation: ……我不记得了。梦中的文字本就难以辨认。

text: [Back to the hallway.]
translation: [回到走廊。]

text: Aubière conceals his passions, but cannot suppress them. This panel fairly vibrates with the strength of his ambition.
translation: 奥比埃隐藏着自己的激情，却无法压制它们。这块木板随着他野心的力度微微震颤。

text: A panel of dark wood, daubed with the symbol of a closed eye. It resembles the door of the sanitarium living room; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation: 一块深色木板，上面涂着一个闭眼的符号。它像疗养院客厅的门；但它并不是真的门，否则我就能打开它了。

text: In Fucine, 'the tongue of witches', that symbol means...
translation: 在富西讷语——“女巫之舌”——中，那个符号的意思是……

text: 'Passion' - intuition, the hidden rivers which flow beneath the soul.
translation: “激情”——直觉，那些奔流于灵魂之下的隐秘河流。

text: ...I don't recall. It can be difficult to understand writing in dreams.
translation: ……我不记得了。梦中的文字本就难以辨认。

text: [Back to the hallway.]
translation: [回到走廊。]

text: The wooden panel is cold and smooth. Aubière is a man of powerfully focused reason.
translation: 木板冰冷而光滑。奥比埃是一个理智高度专注的人。

text: A panel of varnished wood, daubed with the symbol of an open eye. It resembles the door of the sanitarium library; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation: 一块上了漆的木板，上面涂着一个睁眼的符号。它像疗养院图书室的门；但它并不是真的门，否则我就能打开它了。

text: In Fucine, 'the dry tongue', that symbol means...
translation: 在富西讷语——“干涸之舌”——中，那个符号的意思是……

text: Reason. The uppermost components of the soul - the capacity for daylight understanding.
translation: 理智。灵魂最上层的构成——那种白昼般明彻的理解能力。

text: ...I don't recall. It can be difficult to understand writing in dreams.
translation: ……我不记得了。梦中的文字本就难以辨认。

text: [Back to the hallway.]
translation: [回到走廊。]

text: A glowering man in glowering middle age, nicely filling out an ornate military uniform.
translation: 一个阴沉着脸的男人，正值阴沉的盛年，把一身华丽的军装撑得刚刚好。

text: Welland, Welland...
translation: 韦兰，韦兰……

text: Is there something odd about his hair?
translation: 他的头发是不是有点古怪？

text: Is that a wig? The painter has faithfully rendered it slipping slightly. He's bald underneath. Forge-long are hairless... of course!
translation: 那是假发吗？画家忠实地画出了它微微滑落的样子。底下是秃顶。铸之长生者都寸发不生……当然！

text: Eccentric painter's technique, probably.
translation: 大概是画家的古怪技法吧。

text: "Welland." Of course. He usually went by 'Captain', but it's definitely him. There are photos in the [[Bureau]] records - of a man whose features had hardly changed since the time of this painting.
translation: “韦兰。”当然。他通常被人称作“船长”，但肯定是他。[[防剿局]]档案里有照片——那人的面容，自这幅画的时代以来几乎毫无变化。

text: Familiar, but not familiar enough.
translation: 似曾相识，却又不够熟悉。

text: Welland was a Forge-[[long]] with military inclinations - a member of the Society of the Noble Endeavour who were often alchemists and generals, British royalists. What was he doing in Atlanta in 1865? And why does he feature in Aubière's dream?
translation: 韦兰是一位有军人倾向的铸之[[长生者]]——“高尚事业社”的成员，该社中人多为炼金术士与将军，是英国的保皇党人。1865 年，他在亚特兰大做什么？又为何会出现在奥比埃的梦中？

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: The White Door: the lowest door of the Mansus, that even untrained dreamers could sometimes pass. And the Dead.
translation: 白门：漫宿最低的一道门，连未经训练的做梦者有时也能穿过。还有亡者。

text: The lower reaches of the Mansus are no longer safe - not since their guardians fled and the colder powers moved in.
translation: 漫宿的下层不再安全——自从那里的守护者逃散、更寒冷的力量入驻之后。

text: Retreat from the chill behind the white rope.
translation: 从白绳后的寒意中退开。

text: I used to visit the White Door in dreams myself. Something about the chill tugs at a memory...
translation: 我自己过去也常在梦中拜访白门。那寒意似乎牵动着某段回忆……

text: Before I left the world, sometimes I would dream of the White Door, and the Dead who gave up their voices to pass. After I left the world, in the days I drifted dark, other visitors mistook me for one of them. After a time, the visitors came no more; and I drifted higher...
translation: 在我离开人世之前，我偶尔会梦见白门，以及那些为通过而舍弃声音的亡者。离开人世之后，在我于黑暗中飘荡的日子里，其他访客把我误认作他们中的一员。过了一段时间，访客不再来了；而我飘向更高处……

text: Dreams flee on waking. The memory is gone where memories go.
translation: 梦在醒来时遁去。记忆已消逝，消逝于记忆该去之处。

text: M. Hobson...
translation: 霍布森先生……

text: I've been thinking about Nina. About Mlle Lagasse, I mean.
translation: 我一直在想尼娜。我是说，拉加斯小姐。

text: I'm not sure why we're here. What are we talking about?
translation: 我不太明白我们怎么会在这里。我们在谈论什么？

text: Thinking what?
translation: 在想什么？

text: So I see.
translation: 看出来了。

text: Oh...yes. [Aubière glances, startled, at the image in the Wood.]
translation: 哦……是啊。[奥比埃吃了一惊，瞥向林地中的影像。]

text: This is a dream, is it not? How are you here?
translation: 这是一场梦，不是吗？你怎么会在这里？

text: A dream about where Nina's gone.
translation: 一场关于尼娜去向的梦。

text: I'm not sure if I believe that.
translation: 我不确定该不该相信这话。

text: Very well.
translation: 好吧。

text: Nina travels with a circus. She left it to come here; she left here to catch up with it. The name of the circus was Rosa Mundi, and its next destination was the city of Mimata. That is as much as I know.
translation: 尼娜随一个马戏团旅行。她离开马戏团来到这里，又离开这里去追赶它。那马戏团名叫罗莎·蒙迪，它的下一站是米玛塔城。我所知道的仅此而已。

text: Sinombre brought me here.
translation: 西诺姆布尔带我来到这里。

text: I have my ways.
translation: 我有我的办法。

text: [Winning smile] Relax, Doctor. You're asleep! This isn't the time to worry.
translation: 「胜券在握的微笑」放松，医生。你睡着了！现在不是担心的时候。

text: [Solemn nod] You can trust me.
translation: 「郑重地点头」你可以信任我。

text: Here's a dream-bargain for you. If you tell me something about Nina, you'll learn something about me. You're curious, aren't you?
translation: 我们来做个梦中交易吧。你若告诉我一些关于尼娜的事，我也会告诉你一些关于我的事。你很好奇，不是吗？

text: 'Believe'? It's true, or it isn't true. And in dreams, nothing is untrue.
translation: 「相信」？事情要么是真的，要么不是。而在梦中，没有什么是假的。

text: [He smiles, tentatively at first, and then with a rush of surprising warmth.]
translation: 「他笑了——起初还带着试探，随即涌出一阵出人意料的暖意。」

text: Generally, I might agree. But this does not seem like the usual sort of sleep.
translation: 一般来说，我也许会同意。但这看起来不像寻常的睡眠。

text: An elegant argument, monsieur.
translation: 好一番精妙的辩辞，先生。

text: Perhaps not. Or perhaps everything is untrue.
translation: 也许并非如此。又或者，一切皆为虚假。

text: I am curious... and this is perhaps only a dream... very well. Share your secret, and I will share mine.
translation: 我确实很好奇……而这也或许仅仅是一场梦……好吧。你分享你的秘密，我也分享我的。

text: I am curious indeed. But I think I will reserve such commerce for my waking hours.
translation: 我确实很好奇。但我想，这种交易还是留到醒着的时候再做吧。

text: [His face clears.] Perhaps I can.
translation: 「他面色缓和下来。」或许我可以。

text: But can I? You are clearly a complicated man, M. Hobson.
translation: 但我可以吗？霍布森先生，你显然是个复杂的人。

text: Jung said: 'The dream is the small hidden door in the deepest and most intimate sanctum of the soul.'
translation: 荣格说过：「梦是灵魂最深邃、最私密圣所中那扇小小的暗门。」

text: So he did.
translation: 他确实说过。

text: So he did. And I am not certain, M. Hobson, that we have yet achieved that level of intimacy.
translation: 他确实说过。不过我不太确定，霍布森先生，我们是否已经亲密到那个地步。

text: I returned from the Mansus to flesh...
translation: 我从漫宿归来，重获血肉之躯……

text: I passed through the outer oceans...
translation: 我曾穿越外海……

text: On second thoughts, I don't want to share any secrets.
translation: 转念一想，我什么秘密都不想分享了。

text: [Menace] There are worse dreams you might experience, Doctor. Much, much worse dreams.
translation: 「恫吓」医生，你可能会做更可怕的梦。比这可怕得多、多得多。

text: [He takes a step backwards.] I...
translation: 「他向后退了一步。」我……

text: There are. But I am not easily frightened by dreams.
translation: 确实有。但我没那么容易被梦吓到。

text: [I speak of my reincorporation in [[Alexandria]], beneath the eyes of two old friends and one new.]
translation: 「我谈起自己在[[亚历山大港]]重获肉身之事——在两位旧友与一位新识的注视之下。」

text: [I speak of my time in [[Ys]] behind the wave, where they took the Worms from me.]
translation: 「我谈起自己在[[伊苏]]、海浪之后的时日——在那里，他们取走了我体内的蠕虫。」

text: [His eyes widen] I do hope that I remember this, when I am awake again.
translation: 「他睁大了眼睛」我由衷希望，等我醒来时，还能记得这一切。

text: Thank you, Doctor.
translation: 谢谢你，医生。

text: Good. Now, forget this on awakening.
translation: 很好。现在，醒来之后把这一切忘掉吧。

text: And so we're finished. Learn your lesson: don't trifle with Spencer Hobson.
translation: 那么，我们就此结束。记住教训：别招惹斯宾塞·霍布森。

text: A courteous dream, isn't it? I -
translation: 真是一场彬彬有礼的梦，不是吗？我——

text: [The bleached room around me begins to flood with colour, as if paint had been dropped in clear water. I am returning to the waking world.]
translation: 「我四周惨白的房间开始涌满色彩，仿佛清水中滴入了颜料。我正要回到清醒的世界。」

text: [Something closes behind me.]
translation: 「有什么东西在我身后合拢。」

text: I should have known -
translation: 我早该知道的——

text: [Watch him in silence.]
translation: 「沉默地注视着他。」

text: I suppose I will, won't -
translation: 我想我会记住的，不是吗——

text: Wait. What's happ -
translation: 等等。发生什么——

text: She is a very compelling person. I discovered that she only came here to learn about the Ravelines. I know that she has no use for me, personally. None at all.
translation: 她是个极具魅力的人。我发现，她来这里只是为了打听拉韦林一家的事。我知道，她对我本人毫无所需。一丝一毫也没有。

text: [An odd lacuna; a typically dream-like discontinuity.]
translation: 「一处奇异的空白；典型的梦式断裂。」

text: And yet, I dream of her.
translation: 然而，我梦见了她。

text: I'm sorry. Is that difficult for you?
translation: 我很抱歉。这对你来说很艰难吗？

text: [Inquisitive] Dreams of a... personal nature, you mean?
translation: 「探询地」你是说……私密性质的梦？

text: [Say nothing.]
translation: [什么也不说。]

text: [Knowing] Dreams of a personal nature, you mean?
translation: 「会意地」你是说，私密性质的梦？

text: Am I here? This is most likely a conversation with yourself. Or with your idea of me. In other words: a dream.
translation: 我真的在这里吗？这多半是你与自己的对话。又或者，是与你心中那个我之间的对话。换句话说：一场梦。

text: [A heavy sigh.] I have sometimes regretted engaging the services of Dr Sinombre. Despite her gifts.
translation: 「重重地叹了口气。」有时我真后悔雇用了西诺姆布尔医生。尽管她天赋过人。

text: She did say she was a colleague of yours. But she seemed evasive...
translation: 她确实说她是你的同事。但她看起来闪烁其词……

text: The arrangement is unconventional... certainly she cannot leave, but certainly she would not survive without my assistance. It's complicated. Like this dream.
translation: 这安排不同寻常……她确实无法离开，可也确实没有我的帮助就活不下去。说来复杂。就像这场梦一样。

text: But here I am. This must be something for your notes.
translation: 但我就在这里。这想必值得你记上一笔。

text: Perhaps. If I remember this. It's really a dream?
translation: 也许吧。如果我还能记得。这真的只是一场梦？

text: Interesting. And a little concerning. I suppose this is what you people call 'nyctodromy'.
translation: 有趣。也有点令人不安。我猜这就是你们这些人所说的「夜游术」。

text: 'You people'?
translation: 「你们这些人」？

text: Let's just call it a dream.
translation: 就当它是一场梦吧。

text: Adepts. Accursed wanderers. Remortals. Otherworldly entities...
translation: 修士。受诅咒的浪游者。长生者。异界存在……

text: I mean nothing by it. But you understand it is surprising, to meet you in such a dream.
translation: 我并无冒犯之意。但你得理解，在这样一场梦里遇见你，实在令人惊讶。

text: Back to the world...
translation: 回到尘世……

text: [My heart pulses with desperation. The night responds. Give in to that desperation.]
translation: 「我的心因绝望而搏动。夜回应了我。向那绝望屈服吧。」

text: I am threatening Aubière. Here I am in his secret thoughts. I will drag us both into madness if I must. We will both regret it. Scarlet darkness writhes at the edges of what we both see.
translation: 我在威胁奥比埃。我正身处他隐秘的思绪之中。若有必要，我会把我们都拖入疯狂。我们都会为此后悔。猩红的黑暗在我们两人的视野边缘翻腾。

text: I have stopped speaking. Aubière watches me, wide-eyed.
translation: 我已不再言语。奥比埃睁大眼睛注视着我。

text: ...let us not be hasty, M. Hobson.
translation: ……不要操之过急，霍布森先生。

text: She's a member of staff? Not just a patient?
translation: 她是这里的雇员？不只是个病人？

text:
Ambition - the desire to be higher than those around me - because I rise, or because they fall. Ambitious choices are often profitable; notable; dangerous.

[Evolve this Passion to Ambition, which contributes Forge and Grail to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
野心——凌驾于身边众人之上的渴望——或因为我攀升，或因为他们坠落。野心勃勃的选择往往有利可图；引人注目；危险重重。

〔将这项激情进化为野心，它将为你的性相池增添铸与杯。〕

text: Spend [q=amb:evolveCost] Grail Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=amb:evolveCost] 杯之经验。

text: Perhaps later. In my own time. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 也许以后吧。按我自己的节奏来。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: Spend [q=amb:evolveCost] Forge Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=amb:evolveCost] 铸之经验。

text: Some people just exist. Others strive. That's me.
translation: 有些人只是活着。另一些人奋力向上。我就是后者。

text: Yes. I'm on the way to becoming something greater.
translation: 是的。我正走在通往更伟大的路上。

text: Is there something that distinguishes me from other people?
translation: 可有什么东西让我与旁人不同？

text: Oh yes. They'll remember my name for a long, long time.
translation: 哦，当然。他们会记住我的名字，很久很久。

text: Europe just had a nasty lesson in what can happen when people start thinking like that.
translation: 欧洲刚刚上了一堂惨痛的课：人们一旦开始那样想，会落得什么下场。

text: It's safer and wiser not to stand out too much.
translation: 不显山露水，更安全，也更明智。

text: Who cares? There are more important things than being important.
translation: 谁在乎呢？有比「出人头地」更重要的东西。

text: [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation: 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [You have resolved to follow your Ambition. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你已决心追随自己的野心。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text:
Angry choices can be cruel; they can be just; sometimes they're even prudent; but they're never gentle.

[Evolve this Passion to Anger, which contributes Edge and Forge to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
愤怒的选择可能残酷；也可能公正；有时甚至谨慎；但永远不会温柔。

〔将这项激情进化为愤怒，它将为你的性相池增添刃与铸。〕

text: Spend [q=ang:evolveCost] Edge Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=ang:evolveCost] 刃之经验。

text: Later, perhaps. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 以后再说，也许。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: Spend [q=ang:evolveCost] Forge Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=ang:evolveCost] 铸之经验。

text: I can't forget the injustice of what was done to me.
translation: 我无法忘记自己所遭受的不公。

text: I'm going to make sure that everyone understands what it means to cross me.
translation: 我要让所有人都明白，与我为敌意味着什么。

text: I've had a rough time of it, these last years. It could get rougher.
translation: 这些年我过得很艰难。以后可能更难。

text: I'll show them 'rough'.
translation: 我会让他们见识见识什么叫「艰难」。

text: Well, look around. Everyone's had a rough time. You live with it, or you go under.
translation: 瞧瞧四周吧。谁都不容易。要么忍受，要么沉沦。

text: Heal, grow, change, I suppose. Those all seem like good options.
translation: 疗伤、成长、改变，我想。这些看起来都是不错的选择。

text: I'm not going to waste time worrying about that. Take each day as it comes.
translation: 我才不会浪费时间为此烦恼。过好每一天就是了。

text: [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation: 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [Your Anger burns furiously now. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你的愤怒如今熊熊燃烧。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text:
Emptiness is there to be filled. Appetite-focused choices are invariably selfish and often delightful.

[Evolve this Passion to Appetite, which contributes Edge and Grail to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
虚空存在，便是为了被填满。以欲望为重的选择总归自私，却常常令人愉快。

〔将这项激情进化为欲望，它将为你的性相池增添刃与杯。〕

text: Spend [q=app:evolveCost] Edge Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=app:evolveCost] 刃之经验。

text: Later, perhaps. Let's savour the thought. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 以后再说，也许。先细细品味这个念头。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: Spend [q=app:evolveCost] Grail Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=app:evolveCost] 杯之经验。

text: What don't I want?
translation: 我不想要什么？

text: Delight; pleasure; satisfaction; sensation; and more.
translation: 欢愉；享乐；满足；感官的刺激；还有更多。

text: What do I want?
translation: 我想要什么？

text: Oh yes. Always yes.
translation: 哦，当然。永远都是当然。

text: There are more important things than what I want.
translation: 有比我想要的更重要的东西。

text: I'm a complicated man.
translation: 我是个复杂的人。

text: Not so very much.
translation: 并没有太多。

text: [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation: 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [You're surrendering to your Appetite. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你正臣服于自己的欲望。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text:
Compassionate actions put someone else's interests ahead of my own.

[Evolve this to Compassion, which contributes Heart and Rose to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
心怀悲悯之举，是将他人利益置于自身利益之上。

〔将其进化为悲悯，它将为你的性相池增添心与引。〕

text: Spend [q=com:evolveCost] Heart Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=com:evolveCost] 心之经验。

text: Something to think about. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 值得想一想。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: Spend [q=com:evolveCost] Rose Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=com:evolveCost] 引之经验。

text: ...and I can't stand it; and I can help.
translation: ……而我无法袖手旁观；而我力所能及。

text: ...and every moment we spend to relieve it is a moment spent well.
translation: ……而我们为缓解它付出的每一刻，都算没有虚度。

text: There's so much pain in the world.
translation: 这世上的痛苦何其之多。

text: ...bloody awful, isn't it? Let's get stuck in.
translation: ……糟糕透顶，不是吗？那就出手相助吧。

text: ...but I have other things to worry about.
translation: ……但我还有别的事要操心。

text: Yep! So there is.
translation: 是啊！确实如此。

text: ...and there probably always will be.
translation: ……而且以后大概也还会有。

text: [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation: 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [You are Compassionate, now. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson]
translation: 「如今，你心怀悲悯。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text:
If there's one thing every adept has in common with every scholar... Curious choices are not necessarily wise.

[Evolve this Passion to Curiosity, which contributes Lantern and Knock to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
如果说每位修士与每位学者有什么共同之处……好奇的选择未必明智。

〔将这项激情进化为好奇，它将为你的性相池增添灯与启。〕

text: Spend [q=cur:evolveCost] Lantern Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=cur:evolveCost] 灯之经验。

text: I should be sure I've considered all the other options... [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 我得先确认自己考虑过所有其他选项……〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: Spend [q=cur:evolveCost] Knock Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=cur:evolveCost] 启之经验。

text: Ooh!
translation: 喔！

text: Ahh!
translation: 啊！

text: Curiosity. If I never know, just how much will I care?
translation: 好奇。若我永远不得而知，我究竟会在意多少？

text: Knew what exactly?
translation: 究竟想知道什么？

text: Ehh.
translation: 呃。

text: Mm...
Hmm.
translation: 嗯。

text: [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation: 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [You're following your Curiosity wherever it might lead. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你正追随自己的好奇，无论它将通往何方。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text:
The death of faith in human nature? Or daylight's chill? Cynical choices are lonely, cautious, practical.

[Evolve this Passion to Cynicism, which contributes Knock and Winter to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
是对人性信念的幻灭？还是白昼的寒意？犬儒的选择是孤独的、谨慎的、务实的。

〔将这项激情进化为犬儒，它将为你的性相池增添启与冬。〕

text: Spend [q=cyn:evolveCost] Knock Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=cyn:evolveCost] 启之经验。

text: I'm not committing. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 我不打算现在就定下来。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: Spend [q=cyn:evolveCost] Winter Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=cyn:evolveCost] 冬之经验。

text: 'Disappointment is the nurse of wisdom...'
translation: 「失望是智慧的乳母……」

text: Yeah, good luck with that.
translation: 是啊，祝你好运。

text: Trust?
translation: 信任？

text: 'Die together, live alone.'
translation: 「同死容易，独活难。」

text: The keystone of civilisation; the world's deep heart.
translation: 文明的基石；世界深处的真心。

text: Eh... why not. There's worse things than people.
translation: 呃……为什么不呢。世上还有比人更糟的东西。

text: Got to, don't you?
translation: 总得信点什么，不是吗？

text: [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation: 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [S'pose this means you're a Cynic. Although people change. Even Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「这么看来，你就是个犬儒了。尽管人会改变。哪怕是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text:
Honourable decisions are attempts to do the right thing, not the easy thing - and not necessarily the wise thing, or the gentle.

[Evolve this Passion to Honour, which contributes Heart and Lantern to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
荣誉之举，是尝试去做对的事，而非容易的事——也未必是明智的事，或温柔的事。

〔将这项激情进化为荣誉，它将为你的性相池增添心与灯。〕

text: Spend [q=hon:evolveCost] Heart Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=hon:evolveCost] 心之经验。

text: I'm not sure I'd measure up. Later, perhaps. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 我不确定自己能配得上。以后再说，也许。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: Spend [q=hon:evolveCost] Lantern Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=hon:evolveCost] 灯之经验。

text: Someone with a heart, guts, and a code.
translation: 一个有热血、有胆量、有信条的人。

text: Someone who makes the difficult choices.
translation: 一个敢于做出艰难抉择的人。

text: 'Gentleman'?
translation: 「绅士」？

text: A word I've never liked. Do the right thing and stop talking about it.
translation: 一个我向来不喜欢的词。做对的事，别再空谈它。

text: What you are, not what you do. It's about breeding.
translation: 看你是什么样的人，而不是你做了什么。关乎出身教养。

text: Someone who hasn't been caught.
translation: 一个还没被逮住的人。

text: A nineteenth century relic.
translation: 一个十九世纪的遗物。

text: [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation: 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [You'll do your best to be Honourable. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你将竭尽全力做个荣誉之人。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text:
Sorrowful choices: enigmatic? Nostalgic? Sentimental? Aesthetic?

[Evolve this Passion to Sorrow, which contributes Moth and Winter to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
悲伤的选择：难以捉摸？怀旧？多愁善感？唯美？

〔将这项激情进化为悲伤，它将为你的性相池增添蛾与冬。〕

text: Spend [q=sor:evolveCost] Moth Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=sor:evolveCost] 蛾之经验。

text: Perhaps I'll look forward, for now. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 也许眼下，我还是向前看吧。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: Spend [q=sor:evolveCost] Winter Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=sor:evolveCost] 冬之经验。

text: Faulkner: 'The past is never dead. It's not even past.'
translation: 福克纳：「过去永远不会死去。它甚至还没有成为过去。」

text: 'The roots go deep. The knots remain.'
translation: 「根须深扎，结子难解。」

text: When I look up at the blood on the sun, the pallor of the sky, when I think about what's been lost...
translation: 当我仰望太阳上的血色、天空的苍白，当我想到那些已经失去的东西……

text: This is why we can never forget.
translation: 正因为如此，我们永远不能忘记。

text: Some things should have been lost earlier. This is a time for renewal.
translation: 有些东西本该更早失去。这是一个更新的时代。

text: Make the best of what we've got left.
translation: 尽力善待仅存的一切。

text: Look forward, not back.
translation: 向前看，别回头。

text: [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation: 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [You've acknowledged your Sorrow. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你已正视自己的悲伤。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text:
Whimsy - the reason that is no reason - the choice which is 'none of the above', except when it's not. Whimsical choices are unexpected, usually; useful, occasionally.

[Evolve this Passion to Whimsy , which contributes Moth and Rose to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
奇想——没有理由的理由——「以上皆非」的选择，除非并非如此。异想天开的抉择通常出人意料；偶尔派得上用场。

〔将这项激情进化为奇想，它将为你的性相池增添蛾与引。〕

text: Spend [q=whi:evolveCost] Moth Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=whi:evolveCost] 蛾之经验。

text: Perhaps this is something I'll choose later. Perhaps not. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 也许这是我以后才会做出的选择。也许不会。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: Spend [q=whi:evolveCost] Rose Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=whi:evolveCost] 引之经验。

text: I don't always know why.
translation: 我并非总能说清缘由。

text: Let 'em guess.
translation: 让他们猜去吧。

text: Why do I do the things that I do?
translation: 我为何会做出我所做的事？

text: 'Why?' When did I ever care about 'why'?
translation: 「为什么」？我几时在乎过「为什么」？

text: There's always a reason... but often, I'm playing the long game.
translation: 总归有理由……但很多时候，我放的是长线。

text: There's always a reason... but sometimes I like to keep it to myself.
translation: 总归有理由……但有时我喜欢把它留给自己。

text: I'm a complicated man.
translation: 我是个复杂的人。

text:
Who'd do anything just for the sake of doing it? Only the wind moves without a reason.

[You've rejected the Whimsy Passion. If you act Whimsically again you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation:
谁会仅仅为了做而做？只有风才毫无缘由地飘动。

「你已摒弃奇想这项激情。若你再有一时兴起之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [You're Whimsical now. At least until you're not.]
translation: 「你如今满怀奇想。至少，在不再奇想之前。」

text: These are the black halls of sightless Sleep.
translation: 这里是盲目之眠的漆黑殿堂。

text: Recovery... [ [[Weariness]] fades.]
translation: 正在恢复……〔[[倦怠]]正在消退。〕

text: Pain troubles my sleep, but I'm healing. [When you sleep, [[Pain]] is converted to [[Weariness]].]
translation: 疼痛搅扰我的睡眠，但我正在痊愈。〔入眠时，[[痛苦]]会转化为[[倦怠]]。〕

text: Fear and fascination war and wane. [[Dread]] and [[Fascination]] cancel each other out. If you have more of one than the other, it might cause dreams before it fades.
translation: 恐惧与入迷彼此交战，此消彼长。[[恐惧]]与[[入迷]]相互抵消。若一方多于另一方，便可能在消散之前引出梦境。

text: Something like fever...
translation: 像是发烧一样……

text: Snow whitens sleep-corners.
translation: 雪将睡梦的角落染白。

text: Fight.
translation: 反抗。

text: Submit.
translation: 屈服。

text: Struggle.
translation: 挣扎。

text: Succumb.
translation: 沉沦。

text: My sleep's a little darker. Fever fades.
translation: 我的睡梦暗了一分。烧退了。

text: The dream moves on. Perhaps it's found better prey.
translation: 梦继续前行。也许它已觅得更中意的猎物。

text: I'm smiling and smiling am I in motion - beneath a glory of gold that loves me - should I give myself to it - should I only give myself -
translation: 我微笑着，微笑着，我正飘然而行——在爱着我的金色辉光之下——我该把自己交给它吗——我该只把自己交出去吗——

text: This is the dream that sets its teeth in the neck's nape to drag what is left through the snow to the hollow place. It is too long. It ends.
translation: 这是那种将牙齿咬进后颈、把残躯拖过雪地、拖向那凹陷之处的梦。它太长了。该结束了。

text: Wake. Battle through the moment of waking confusion. Where I am, who I am -
translation: 醒来。闯过初醒时的迷乱。我在哪里，我是谁——

text: And I'm in the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.
translation: 而我身在今日疗养院。

text: My dreams are only a hushed polka of the day's events. I make no attempt to reach the House that has no walls, or even the Wood around its walls. Much safer to stick with the midnight shuffle of sleeping thought.
translation: 我的梦不过是白日旧事的一支低声波尔卡。我无意抵达那座无墙的居屋，甚至它墙外的树丛也不曾触及。午夜睡思的曳步要安全得多。

text: Memories gossiping beneath a dome of echoes...
translation: 种种回忆在一座回声穹顶之下窃窃私语……

text: Is anyone watching this place? I'm so used to being hunted. [The more nights you spend in the same place, the more Traces you'll get each night.]
translation: 有人在盯着这个地方吗？我早已习惯了被追猎。〔你在同一处停留的夜晚越多，每夜获得的痕迹就越多。〕

text: This is the first night I've spent here. Unless I move on tomorrow, I might attract attention. [Spencer won't gain a [[Trace]] in his first night anywhere.]
translation: 这是我在这里度过的第一夜。除非我明日便启程离开，否则可能会引来注意。〔无论身处何地，斯宾塞的第一夜都不会获得[[痕迹]]。〕

text: I'm Sylvain Huissier.
translation: 我是西尔万·韦西耶。

text: I'm Spencer Hobson.
translation: 我是斯宾塞·霍布森。

text: FNORD Enclosure! You're not allowed.
translation: （占位）禁地！你不能进去。

text: I'm a priest.
translation: 我是神父。

text: I'm a doctor.
translation: 我是医生。

text: You can't stop me.
translation: 你拦不住我。

text: FNORD hi surprise
translation: （占位）嗨，惊喜

text: FNORD you're that nun!
translation: （占位）你就是那个修女！

text: Yes. Please respect my privacy.
translation: 是的。请尊重我的隐私。

text: I'll think about it
translation: 我会考虑的

text: The train's roar fades into the distance. Its echoes follow like beggar-children. A clinging, loamy silence falls.
translation: 火车的轰鸣渐渐远去。它的回声如乞儿般追随其后。一片黏稠的、泥壤般的寂静降临。

text: Listen -
Look around -
translation: 环顾四周——

text: Not quite silent. Bird-song, leaf-rustle. And off from behind the post office, the faint strains of a melodeon.
translation: 并非全然寂静。鸟鸣，叶响。邮局背后，隐隐传来手风琴的乐声。

text: A flash of unexpected colour above the post office - flags rippling lazily in the dank air of the valley.
translation: 邮局上方掠过一抹出人意料的色彩——旗帜在谷地阴湿的空气中懒洋洋地翻卷。

text: The circus...?
translation: 马戏团……？

text: YOU are Spencer Hobson, Sylvain Hussier, Father Brass, hollow of spirit and brazen of heart.
translation: 你，就是斯宾塞·霍布森，西尔万·韦西耶，黄铜神父——魂魄空洞，心肠如铜。

text: THIS has been the Travelling at Night demo.
translation: 这便是Travelling at Night的试玩版。

text: Almost there... but not yet.
translation: 就快到了……但还不是。

text: WE are Weather Factory - Lottie Bevan and Alexis Kennedy - and we look forward very much to bringing you the whole game.
translation: 我们，是天气工厂——洛蒂·贝文与亚历克西·肯尼迪——我们万分期待把完整的游戏带到你面前。

text: [Applaud graciously.]
translation: [优雅地鼓掌。]

text: Eh. That was okay.
translation: 唔。还算可以。

text: No! I want more!
translation: 不！我还要更多！

text: What was that bit with the cat?
translation: 那只猫是怎么回事？

text: Yes, exactly, yes.
translation: 是的，正是如此，没错。

text: ESCAPE!
translation: 逃离！

text: Even the station's dim lights are brighter than the murk of Mimata town.
translation: 就连车站昏暗的灯光，也比米玛塔镇的晦暗更亮。

text: Nina Lagasse is here somewhere. Leave before I find her? My heart shudders at the thought of it.
translation: 尼娜·拉加斯就在这里的某处。趁我还没找到她，就此离开？一想到此，我的心便阵阵战栗。

text: Nina Lagasse is here somewhere. 'In the woods'...
translation: 尼娜·拉加斯就在这里的某处。「在树林里」……

text: When I've convinced Nina to help me... then I can leave.
translation: 等我劝动尼娜来帮我……那时我才能离开。

text: I'll be leaving with the Rosa Mundi circus.
translation: 我将随罗莎·蒙迪马戏团一同离开。

text: [Complete the 'Rosa Mundi: Welcome' Plan before leaving.]
translation: [离开前，完成「罗莎·蒙迪：欢迎」计划。]

text: [Packing up, moving on.]
translation: [收拾行装，继续上路。]

text: Time to leave Mimata?
translation: 是时候离开米玛塔了？

text: [Not yet.]
translation: [还不是时候。]

text: An unusual device displaying the current time in black glyphs on white tiles. As I watch, the two smaller tiles at the end flip regularly, updating the time display to the precise second.
translation: 一件不寻常的装置，白色字片上的黑色符号显示着当前时间。我注视之际，末端两枚较小的字片规律翻动，把时间显示精确更新到秒。

text: Doubly unusual...
translation: 加倍地不寻常……

text: Since the War in the [[Sun]], clocks in Europe usually run inconsistently, wind down, or break, sometimes in quite dangerous ways. But this [[Incorporate]]-manufactured device looks to be keeping good time.
translation: 自[[太阳]]之战以来，欧洲的钟表往往走时不准、越走越慢，甚至损坏，有时还坏得相当危险。但这台[[集团]]制造的装置，看来走得颇为精准。

text: [Flip.]
translation: [翻动。]

text: Watch the numbers flipping.
translation: 看着数字翻动。

text: [Flip.]
translation: [翻动。]

text: [Flip.]
translation: [翻动。]

text: [Flip.]
translation: [翻动。]

text: The effect is soothing - hypnotic, even - but not revelatory. Except of course that it reveals the future with every flip.
translation: 这效果令人安心——甚至催眠——却谈不上启示。当然，每一次翻动都在揭示未来，那又另当别论。

text: Examine it more closely.
translation: 更仔细地端详它。

text: An array of buttons marked with enigmatic glyphs.
translation: 一排标着神秘符号的按钮。

text: Fiddle, cautiously, with the buttons.
translation: 小心翼翼地拨弄那些按钮。

text: Too complicated just now. [Back]
translation: 眼下太复杂了。[返回]

text: Examine the glyphs closely to determine their function.
translation: 仔细研究这些符号，弄清它们的用途。

text: I have the sense that someone in Alexandria mentioned something like this...
translation: 我隐约觉得，在亚历山大港有人提起过类似的东西……

text: This one changes the date... this switches to an unorthodox numbering schema... and this sets an alarm. Which might be useful.
translation: 这个按钮改日期……这个切换到一种非正统的计数法……而这个设闹钟。说不定用得上。

text: The clock whirrs and whines. The numbers flip frantically to what might be a date or a message, before returning to the steady flipping. The mechanism is incomprehensible.
translation: 时钟嗡嗡作响，呜呜哀鸣。数字疯狂翻动，拼出某个也许是日期、也许是讯息的东西，然后才回到平稳的翻动。这机制实在无法理解。

text: These three are pretty clear, actually - they'll allow me to set an alarm to wake me.
translation: 其实这三个相当明白——它们能让我设定闹钟，到点叫醒我。

text: Hm. Elegantly incomprehensible.
translation: 嗯。优雅得让人费解。

text: [[Gwendolen]] had one. She enjoyed its intricacies and described its alarm function in unnerving detail.
translation: [[格温德琳]]也有过一个。她喜爱其中的精巧繁复，还把它的闹钟功能描述得细致到令人不安。

text: ...but if they did, I've forgotten who and what.
translation: ……但就算有人提过，我也忘了是谁、说了什么。

text: [Use the alarm clock before you sleep, if you want to wake in the middle of the night and prowl round the Sanitarium unobserved.]
translation: [若想在半夜醒来、神不知鬼不觉地巡游疗养院，请在睡前使用闹钟。]

text: Leave it alone.
translation: 不去动它。

text: Set an alarm to wake in the middle of the night.
translation: 设个闹钟，半夜醒来。

text: Switch off the alarm, to ensure a good night's sleep.
translation: 关掉闹钟，确保一夜好眠。

text: [Click. Whirr. Click.]
translation: [咔嗒。嗡鸣。咔嗒。]

text: [Whirr. Click. Whirr.]
translation: [嗡鸣。咔嗒。嗡鸣。]

text: If I sleep in this bed tonight, I'll wake at midnight, sacrificing a restful sleep for the ability to explore untroubled by busybodies.
translation: 若今晚我睡在这张床上，便会在午夜醒来——牺牲一夜安眠，换来不受多事之人打扰的探索之便。

text: If I rest in this bed tonight, my sleep will remain undisturbed.
translation: 若今晚我歇在这张床上，我的睡眠将不受惊扰。

text: In the corner of the room: a massive bathtub. A minimalist brass mixer tap; Parisian bath salts; clean, warm, fluffy, towels.
translation: 房间一角：一只巨大的浴缸。极简的黄铜混水龙头；巴黎浴盐；干净、温暖、蓬松的毛巾。

text: I've wanted a hot bath since I got off that damned train. No - since Milan. [Turn on the taps!]
translation: 自从下了那该死的火车，我就想泡个热水澡。不——自从米兰。[拧开水龙头！]

text: A cheering rush of hot water! I remembered to put the plug in, just in time.
translation: 热水欢腾地奔涌而出！我赶在最后时刻想起塞上了塞子。

text: A blissful period of entirely nothing. The rail-grime, the soot and sweat, is gone.
translation: 一段全然放空的幸福时光。旅途的尘垢、煤烟与汗渍，尽数洗去。

text: I don't really want a bath just now. [Step away.]
translation: 眼下我实在不想泡澡。[走开。]

text: At last... it's time to get out.
translation: 终于……该起来了。

text: Just a little longer...
translation: 再泡一小会儿……

text: Disrobe. Enter.
translation: 宽衣。入水。

text: Wait impatiently as the water rises.
translation: 焦躁地等着水涨起来。

text: Vapour softens the air, fogs the window-glass, beads greedily on the tiling.
translation: 蒸汽润软了空气，模糊了窗玻璃，贪婪地凝成水珠缀满瓷砖。

text: Increase the flow from the hot tap.
translation: 把热水龙头开大些。

text: Write my name in the fog on the glass.
translation: 在窗玻璃的雾气上写下我的名字。

text: At last it's ready. Vapours coil from the clear water like angel snake ghosts.
translation: 终于备好了。蒸汽自清水盘旋而起，如天使与蛇的幽魂。

text: 'Spencer...'
translation: 「斯宾塞……」

text: 'Sylvain...
translation: 「西尔万……」

text: [Get out.]
translation: [出来。]

text: The departing water swirls, gurgles, and leaves for the sea.
translation: 流走的水打着旋，汩汩作响，奔赴大海。

text: What's next?
translation: 接下来做什么？

text: Why not? the night asks. It's not as if you have anything important to do.
translation: 何妨一试？夜色问道。反正你也没什么要紧事可做。

text: The bath-water cools gently. At some point, I wrinkle. At last, the bath-water is entirely cold, and the joy of it is gone.
translation: 浴水缓缓变凉。不知何时，我的皮肤起皱了。终于，浴水彻底冷透，那份欢愉也荡然无存。

text: [Step away.]
translation: [退开一步。]

text: I really don't need another bath just yet. [Step away.]
translation: 我现在真的还不需要再泡一次澡。[走开。]

text: Bath time! [Take full advantage of this luxury.]
translation: 泡澡时间到！[尽情享受这份奢侈。]

text: A cheering rush of hot water, and the air begins to cloud with steam.
translation: 热水欢腾奔涌，空气渐渐笼上蒸汽。

text: I've changed my mind. [Empty the bath and step away.]
translation: 我改主意了。[放掉浴水，转身走开。]

text: Ahh...
I've wanted a shave since I got off that damned train. No. Since Milan.
translation: 自从下了那该死的火车，我就想刮个脸。不。自从米兰。

text: And now is my moment.
translation: 而此刻就是我的时机。

text: [Use up a Razor Blade.]
translation: [消耗一片剃刀刀片。]

text: [Leave].
translation: [离开]。

text: Hot water. Steam. Shaving cream. This is civilisation.
translation: 热水。蒸汽。剃须膏。这才是文明。

text: A mirror of bright silver returns my reflection with perfect fidelity. It does show me standing in a bombed-out version of the bathroom - one wall missing, plumbing dangling from the brickwork like angled entrails - but since the Wars, one learns not to be distracted by that kind of thing.
translation: 一面亮银色的镜子忠实映出我的倒影。镜中确实映出我站在一间遭轰炸的浴室里——少了一面墙，水管自砖墙垂落，如歪斜的肠子——但战争之后，人便学会了不被这类景象分心。

text: Time for a shave?
translation: 该刮脸了？

text: If only I had razor blades...
translation: 要是有剃刀刀片就好了……

text: A few minutes with blade, cream, and hot water, before I feel both cleaner and sharper.
translation: 与刀片、剃须膏和热水相伴几分钟，我便觉得既洁净，又利落。

text: Like the cracking of a chrysalis. Like the sting of a Severian strigil.
translation: 如蛹壳迸裂。如塞维里亚刮身板的刺痛。

text: The crawling feel of half-grown whiskers -like dirt beneath the nails or tinny music half-heard - until it's gone, the aggravation is almost imperceptible.
translation: 半长胡茬带来的爬搔感——像指甲缝里的污垢，或隐约可闻的刺耳乐声——不到消失之时，这份烦扰几乎不可察觉。

text: And now I look my best.
translation: 而此刻，我容光焕发。

text: I feel so much better.
translation: 感觉好多了。

text: I wonder what I'd look like with Dundrearies? Or a neat little goatee?
translation: 不知蓄起邓德雷里式长鬓须，会是什么模样？或者一把整齐的小山羊胡？

text: Better, perhaps, that we never know.
translation: 或许，永不知晓反而更好。

text: Watch out, discerning ladies and judicious gentlemen.
translation: 当心了，眼光独到的女士们，通达明智的先生们。

text: Spencer's back.
translation: 斯宾塞回来了。

text: Sylvain is back.
translation: 西尔万回来了。

text: I could come back here later, if I need a shave.
translation: 以后若需刮脸，我还可以回到这里。

text: [ [[Troubles]]? [[Sleep]] to cure them.]
translation: [身有[[烦扰]]？[[睡眠]]可解。]

text: Lie back, close eyes.
translation: 躺下，闭眼。

text: I'll come back later.
translation: 我稍后再来。

text: [This will advance to the following morning, unless something wakes you in the night. Continue?]
translation: [这将推进到次日清晨，除非夜里有什么东西将你唤醒。继续？]

text: [The necessary mental adjustments.]
translation: [做些必要的心理调整。]

text: Sit up again.
translation: 重新坐起。

text: Azure day to indigo half-day to the silver-pricked cat-black of a Côte d'Azur night...
translation: 从碧蓝的白昼，到靛蓝的薄暮，再到缀满银星的猫黑之夜——这是蔚蓝海岸的夜色……

text: A droning tone, like a sermonious and didactic bee, drags me from muddled dreams. My alarm has woken me.
translation: 一阵低沉的嗡嗡声——如同一只爱说教、好训人的蜜蜂——把我从纷乱的梦中拖了出来。是闹钟把我叫醒了。

text: Ready for all the little ceremonies of a gentleman's morning.
translation: 准备好迎接绅士清晨的各种小仪式。

text: I can't get into bed - I'm still fully dressed. [In a room of your own, you can change clothes at any time. To sleep, change to your dressing gown.]
translation: 我没法上床——衣服还没换呢。[在自己房间里，你可以随时更换衣服。要睡觉，先换上睡袍。]

text: Make the bed... as I had to in the seminary, long ago.
translation: 整理床铺……就像很久以前，在神学院里不得不做的那样。

text: Leave a snowy swirl of disordered sheets. Someone else will make the bed.
translation: 留下一片雪白凌乱的床单。床，自会有人来铺。

text: Tuck and straighten the bottom sheet...
translation: 把床单掖好、拉平……

text: Rise in the dark. [You won't gain the benefits of a restful night's sleep. When you've finished any nightstalking you want to do, return to your bed and sleep the last few hours.]
translation: 摸黑起身。[你得不到一夜安眠的益处。等做完你想做的夜游，再回到床上，把最后几个小时睡掉。]

text: My mediations on light have taught me ways to wake when the sun is dark. [Wake at midnight.]
translation: 我对光的冥想，教我学会了在太阳晦暗时醒来的法子。[午夜醒来。]

text: My study of silence has taught me ways to wake from sleep. [Wake at midnight.]
translation: 我对静默的研习，教我学会了自睡梦中醒来的法子。[午夜醒来。]

text: Lie back, drift off; bring the day. [Return to unrestful sleep; wake in the morning.]
translation: 躺下，沉沉睡去；迎来天明。[回到不安稳的睡眠；清晨再醒。]

text: At the proper hour, my eyes snap open. It takes me a moment to remember why.
translation: 到了时辰，我猛地睁开眼。片刻之后，才想起缘由。

text: Tousled, turbulent, murky hours...
translation: 纷乱、动荡、晦暗的时光……

text: [The alarm clock is set to wake you in the night. Continue?]
translation: [闹钟已设定，会在夜里将你唤醒。继续？]

text: Continue.
translation: 继续。

text: Lie back, close eyes... whisper 'Sinombre' three times. [This won't be restful, and you won't lose Troubles.]
translation: 躺下，闭上眼……轻声念三次「西诺姆布尔」。[这一觉不会安稳，烦扰也不会消除。]

text: [Nothing obvious happens. Eventually, I drift off to sleep.]
translation: [没有发生任何明显的事。最终，我迷迷糊糊睡了过去。]

text: And I'm here, as I promised. I can't take your hand. Sinombre has passed beyond flesh. But now turn to my light and consider my voice, and we'll see what will open to you...
translation: 而我如约来了。我无法握住你的手——西诺姆布尔已超脱肉身。但现在，转向我的光，凝听我的声音，看看有什么会为你开启……

text: [Something opens to me.]
translation: [有什么为我打开了。]

text: [Dreams.]
translation: [梦境。]

text: I prepared Labrikon earlier. I'll use it to visit Aubière's dreams. [This won't be restful, and you won't lose Troubles.]
translation: 我之前准备了拉布里孔。我要用它进入奥比埃的梦境。[这一觉不会安稳，烦扰也不会消除。]

text: A drop on each eyelid, in each ear, on the tip of the tongue. Sprinkle the rest around the room.
translation: 每只眼皮上一滴，每只耳朵里一滴，舌尖上一滴。剩下的洒在房间各处。

text: The odour of Labrikon is grainy and dank - like cellar-stone, or the smell of the lower layers of the Mansus.
translation: 拉布里孔的气味粗粝而阴湿——像地窖的石头，像漫宿底层的味道。

text: Lie back, close my eyes, wait for sleep.
translation: 躺下，闭上眼，等待睡意降临。

text: Sleep steals in.
translation: 睡意悄然潜入。

text: Top layers smooth and flat...
translation: 最上层平整服帖……

text: Corners neatly mitred...
translation: 边角折得严丝合缝……

text: Pillows straight. There.
translation: 枕头摆正。好了。

text: I can't be bothered with all this. I'll leave the bed half-made.
translation: 我可没心思做这些。床就让它铺到一半吧。

text: Goosedown mattress, plump pillows, warm blankets, kindly provided for by the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.
translation: 鹅绒床垫、蓬松的枕头、温暖的毯子——承蒙今日疗养院慷慨照料。

text: Lie down for a few minutes.
translation: 躺上几分钟。

text: Busy thoughts... busy thoughts. [Sleep is possible once you have one Weariness, Pain, Dread or Fascination - or in some more unusual circumstances.]
translation: 思绪纷扰……思绪纷扰。[一旦你拥有倦怠、痛苦、恐惧或入迷中的任何一种——或在某些更不寻常的情形下——方可入睡。]

text: Down, into the place beneath night and heart.
translation: 沉下去，进入夜与心之下的那片地方。

text: Waking from Mansus-dreams is often painfully abrupt. Like falling from the sky - or being cast up on a cold shore under a cold sun.
translation: 从漫宿之梦中醒来，往往突兀得令人难受。如同自天空坠落——或被抛上一片冷岸，头顶悬着冷阳。

text: I've set an alarm. But I'm not tired enough to sleep. [To sleep, gain at least one Trouble.]
translation: 我设了闹钟，却还困得不够，睡不着。[要入睡，需至少一种烦扰。]

text: Wait! I haven't looked at the calendrier!
translation: 等等！我还没看过那本日历！

text: [The calendrier should tell me where Nina is. I'll look in my inventory.]
translation: [那本日历应该会告诉我尼娜在哪里。我去背包里找找。]

text: Gleaming cream and chrome. General Electric, one of the very brightest [[Incorporates]].
translation: 奶白与铬银，闪闪发光。通用电气——最耀眼的一批[[集团]]之一。

text: Hey, help yourself, it's cool. Talk when you're finished?
translation: 嘿，随便拿，别客气。吃完了咱们再聊？

text: [Craft] Old arts, new tools.
translation: [炼制] 旧技艺，新工具。

text: [Step away.]
translation: [退开一步。]

text: There's a slightly discoloured rectangle on the wall behind the mirror. Was there a door here - now painted or plastered over?
translation: 镜子后面的墙上，有一块微微变色的矩形。这里曾有一扇门——如今被油漆或灰泥糊住了？

text: Mirrors. They are duplicitous things.
translation: 镜子。都是些两面三刀的东西。

text: The moonlight here is clear enough to make out the edges of the discoloured patch - of the texture of the paint.
translation: 这里的月光清朗得足以辨出那块变色区域的边缘——以及涂料的纹理。

text: Inspect it more closely.
translation: 凑近细看。

text: The mirror has been placed here to catch and share the light that falls through the window.
translation: 这面镜子放在这里，是为了接住并散播透窗而入的光。

text: Inspect my reflection.
translation: 端详镜中的自己。

text: No longer young, but not yet old. I was nine years gone from the world. Did I even really wear a body for any of that time? If so, it didn't age.
translation: 不再年轻，却也未至年老。我曾离世九年。那段时间里，我当真还披着肉身吗？若是，那肉身并未衰老。

text: As long as I can still command respect....
translation: 只要我还能赢得尊重……

text: I'm still a handsome fellow. Debonair, even.
translation: 我依旧是个俊朗的家伙。甚至可说风度翩翩。

text: Still, there is grey in my hair now. In my time outside, neither time nor pain forgot me.
translation: 只是如今，我鬓间已见灰白。在我流落于外的那段时日里，时间与痛苦都没有忘了我。

text: Examine the wall.
translation: 查看这面墙。

text: Step away.
translation: 退开一步。

text: Then why do you keep one in your office?
translation: 那您为什么还在办公室里放一面呢？

text: A cough from the doctor.
translation: 医生轻咳一声。

text: Yes. Especially since the War.
translation: 是的。尤其是战争之后。

text: While I know where it is, it can do little harm.
translation: 只要我知道它在哪里，它就害不了人。

text: Just so.
translation: 正是如此。

text: You have indeed an admirable profile, M. Hobson, but perhaps it is more suitable to admire it elsewhere.
translation: 霍布森先生，您的侧影确实令人称羡，不过，或许还是到别处去欣赏更为妥当。

text: Reveal what is hidden.
translation: 揭开隐藏之物。

text: Examine the wall minutely.
translation: 细细检视这面墙。

text: Run my fingertips over the wall.
translation: 用指尖缓缓抚过墙面。

text: In my time on the stage, I saw a great many secret doors, hidden compartments. I suspect there may still be a door here... aha!
translation: 当年登台之时，我见过许多暗门与秘格。我疑心这里仍藏着一扇门……啊哈！

text: Smooth cool paint, silver-pale in moonlight. Nothing else.
translation: 光滑冰凉的漆面，在月光下泛着银白。别无他物。

text: Hinges, almost flush with the wall. There still is a door here! Which means, if I tug at the other edge -
translation: 合页，几乎与墙面齐平。这里果然还有一扇门！也就是说，只要我在另一侧一拽——

text: Smooth cool paint, silver-pale in moonlight. Nothing else.
translation: 光滑冰凉的漆面，在月光下泛着银白。别无他物。

text: The door swings inwards - not only a little, before it jams against something in the crowded room beyond - but the opening is wide enough for me to step through.
translation: 门向内旋开——开得不算少，随即卡在门后那间拥挤房间里某样东西上——不过开口已足够我跨步而入。

text: Murmur an invocation to the [[Watchman]]. See what might be revealed.
translation: 向[[守夜人]]低声念诵祷文，看看会揭示出什么。

text: A hidden door! Not locked in any way that might matter.
translation: 一扇暗门！门上没有任何值得一提的锁。

text: Step through.
translation: 跨步而入。

text: I'm by the wall at the back of Aubière's office.
translation: 我正站在奥比埃办公室的后墙边。

text: If I step through the hidden door here, I'll be in Aubière's secret office, or secret lumber room.
translation: 若我从这里的暗门穿过去，就会进到奥比埃的秘室，或他那间秘密储物室。

text: A wave of panic washes over me. What if the door has somehow stuck? What if I can't get out?
translation: 一阵恐慌如潮水漫过我。万一门卡住了呢？万一我出不去呢？

text: It won't be stuck. I can get out.
translation: 不会卡住的。我出得去。

text: I can always get out. (But once I couldn't, whispers the night.)
translation: 我总能出得去。（但有那么一次我出不去，夜色低声说。）

text: Step back through to Aubière's outer office.
translation: 穿回奥比埃的外间办公室。

text: But of course I can't do that when Aubière is here.
translation: 但奥比埃在场的时候，我当然不能这么做。

text: Like my patients. If you will excuse the drollery.
translation: 就像我的病人一样。请原谅这个玩笑。

text: [It isn't particularly funny. Smile anyway.]
translation: [并不怎么好笑。但还是笑一笑。]

text: [Step away.]
translation: [退开一步。]

text: [Funny. Smile.]
translation: [很好笑。微笑。]

text: 'Behind your own image is a secret chamber with a beast-image...'
translation: 「在你自身影像的背后，有一间秘室，秘室里藏着野兽之像……」

text: Time to go?
translation: 该走了？

text: One last look around...
translation: 最后再环顾一眼……

text: There's a door here, carefully painted, hinges almost flush with the wall. No handle, but all I need to do is tug at the other side -
translation: 这里有一扇门，刷得精心，合页几乎与墙齐平。没有把手，我只需拽住另一侧——

text: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？

text: I suppose I can hardly prevent you...
translation: 想来我也拦不住你……

text: Sorry, doctor. It's a therapeutical necessity.
translation: 抱歉，医生。这是治疗所需。

text: Get out of my way.
translation: 让开。

text: [Step through.]
translation: [跨步而入。]

text: I cough halfway through my invocation. Damn it.
translation: 祷文念到一半，我咳了出来。该死。

text: 'The Light of the World.' Holman Hunt's controversial but radiant depiction of the Shepherd-Illuminate as the [[Watchman]]'s avatar.
translation: 「世界之光。」霍尔曼·亨特那幅备受争议却光辉夺目的画作，将启明之牧者描绘为[[守夜人]]的化身。

text: [Craft] Holy enough for a man in a hurry.
translation: [炼制] 对行色匆匆之人，已足够神圣。

text: [Step away.]
translation: [退开一步。]

text: Closed, but not locked.
translation: 关着，却没有上锁。

text: Open it.
translation: 打开它。

text: Leave.
translation: 告辞。

text: He won't miss these cigars, and I can probably get a good price for them. Pocket a few.
translation: 他不会在意少了这些雪茄，我也许还能卖个好价钱。揣上几支。

text: Examine the cigars more closely.
translation: 更仔细地看看这些雪茄。

text: Obviously I'm not going to pilfer the man's cigars!
translation: 我当然不会去偷拿这个人的雪茄！

text: These cigars look sumptuous. I have to try them. Pocket a few.
translation: 这些雪茄看起来华美极了。非试不可。揣上几支。

text: Why not pocket a few?
translation: 何不揣上几支？

text: I stow the cigars carefully in my pockets to minimise the risk of crushing them.
translation: 我把雪茄小心收进衣袋，尽量减少压坏它们的风险。

text: Poking round his belongings would be embarrassing if I were caught, but I have my reasons. Petty larceny is something else entirely.
translation: 翻动他的物品，若被撞见难免尴尬，但我自有理由。小偷小摸则完全是另一回事。

text: Romeo y Julieta Churchills -all the way from Cuba! They're not even rationed! They're just wildly unavailable. How did Strathcoyne come by them in a sanitarium in the unfavoured end of France?
translation: 罗密欧与朱丽叶·丘吉尔型——不远万里来自古巴！甚至不在配给之列！只是市面上根本买不到。斯特拉斯科因窝在法国这个不受待见的一角开疗养院，是怎么弄到手的？

text: A rich sweet hay-grass scent, very different from the choking tarriness that attends a lit cigar.
translation: 一股浓郁甘甜的干草气息，与点燃雪茄时那股呛人的焦油味截然不同。

text: A hygrometer quivers as I open the lid. Inside, a drawer full of crisply labelled cigars. It's a humidor - a storage box designed to preserve a suitable moisture level, so that the cigars neither dry out nor grow spongy.
translation: 我打开盖子时，湿度计微微一颤。里面是一层抽屉，装满了贴有清晰标签的雪茄。这是保湿盒——一种保持适宜湿度的储存盒，让雪茄既不会干透，也不会发软。

text: Strathcoyne's cache of expensive cigars. I've already pilfered a few.
translation: 斯特拉斯科因私藏的昂贵雪茄。我已经顺走了几支。

text: Strathcoyne's cache of expensive cigars. Fortunately for him, I was unmoved by the temptation to petty theft.
translation: 斯特拉斯科因私藏的昂贵雪茄。对他来说幸运的是,我未被小偷小摸的诱惑所动。

text: In the corner of the room rears - somehow half-heartedly - a great brown bear.
translation: 房间的角落里立着一头巨大的棕熊——不知怎的,颇有几分心不在焉。

text: Examine the bear.
translation: 察看那头熊。

text: Examine the plinth.
translation: 察看那座底座。

text: Lay a hand on the bear's fur.
translation: 将手按在熊的皮毛上。

text: Leave the bear to its shadowy solitude.
translation: 让熊留在它幽影般的孤寂里。

text: Glass eyes gleam, yellowed fangs. It must be decades dead.
translation: 玻璃眼珠闪着光,发黄的獠牙。它想必已死去数十年了。

text: A plaque reads: JÉREMIE - HAUTE-GARONNE - 1895
translation: 铭牌上写着:热雷米 - 上加龙省 - 1895

text: Like bristly, musty carpet - with a squelch to it, as if the carpet had been laid on a rotting floor.
translation: 像一块粗硬发霉的地毯——摸着还有湿漉漉的咕啾感,仿佛那地毯铺在了一具腐烂的地板上。

text: Perhaps the bear came with the house, originally. Presumably Aubière stuck it in here because he felt it didn't strike the right tone for his high-minded institution.
translation: 也许这头熊原本就是随这宅子而来的。想来奥比埃把它塞进这里,是因为他觉得它与他那志趣高洁的机构调性不合。

text: Fifty years ago. How did it die? How did it come here?
translation: 五十年前。它怎么死的？又是怎么来到这里的？

text: 'Good evening, Jeremy.'
translation: “晚上好,热雷米。”

text: Perhaps it was sunset when the bear died. Perhaps the scent of pines.
translation: 也许熊死去时,正值日落。也许,那时有松香的气息。

text: 'The gate to its temenos is a beast-image in the hidden chamber of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui...'
translation: “通往其圣域的门扉,是今日疗养院密室中的一尊兽像……”

text: Some sort of deliquescence beneath the bear's heraldic exterior. Best not to investigate too closely.
translation: 熊那纹章般的外表之下,是某种潮解之物。最好不要凑近探究。

text: Glass shelves crowded with books, plants what can really only be described as 'curios'.
translation: 玻璃搁架上挤满了书籍、植物,以及那些只能称之为“珍奇之物”的东西。

text: A lump of waxy grey.
translation: 一块蜡质的灰色疙瘩。

text: [Step back.]
translation: [退后一步。]

text: A shining ovoid, the colour of late summer.
translation: 一枚发光的卵形物,色泽如夏末。

text: Sea-hued glass.
translation: 海色的玻璃。

text: Shining pink crystal.
translation: 发亮的粉色晶体。

text: Beeswax?
translation: 蜂蜡？

text: A figurine: a woman in a long, bodiced dress.
translation: 一尊小雕像:一位身着束腰长裙的女子。

text: The books.
translation: 那些书。

text: A phrenology bust.
translation: 一尊颅相学半身像。

text: Ambergris: vulgarly called 'whale vomit'. Valuable, though. It has uses in unconventional medicine. I picked up a lump, once, walking on the beach in [[Brancrug]].
translation: 龙涎香:俗名“鲸鱼呕吐物”。不过价值不菲。它在非正统医药中自有其用途。我曾在[[布兰库格]]的海滩上散步时,捡到过一块。

text: Ambergris, perhaps? Vulgarly called 'whale vomit'. Valuable, though.
translation: 或许是龙涎香？俗名“鲸鱼呕吐物”。不过价值不菲。

text: Amber: sacred in certain almost-orthodox rites. There are subtleties in the colour that suggest it might be Cornish amber. They had a little collection of that, at [[Hush House]]. No creatures trapped inside this lump.
translation: 琥珀:在某些几近正统的仪式中奉为神圣。色泽上的微妙之处显示,它或许是康沃尔琥珀。[[噤声居屋]]里曾存有一小批那种琥珀。这一块里面没有困住的生灵。

text: Baltic amber? No creatures trapped inside, though.
translation: 波罗的海琥珀？不过里面没有困住的生灵。

text: Beach-glass. This travelled a long way - rolled and smoothed by Atlantic waves and grey shingle. One traveller knows another.
translation: 海玻璃。它走了很远的路——被大西洋的浪涛与灰色的卵石滩磨圆磨滑。旅人识旅人。

text: Sea-glass, perhaps?
translation: 或许是海玻璃？

text: Rose-quartz, touched by sunset. Its touch sparks memories of the Western sea.
translation: 玫瑰石英,染着落日的颜色。触碰它,便唤起对西方大海的回忆。

text: Quartz?
translation: 石英？

text: Not exactly beeswax. The texture is wrong. The scent is too sharp. A mottled pattern beneath the surface shifts with the light. It might be one of the exudations of the [[Carapace Cross]].
translation: 不完全是蜂蜡。质地不对。气味太冲。表层之下有斑驳的花纹,随光线变幻。这或许是[[介壳种]]的某种分泌物。

text: Beeswax. Odd thing to put on a shelf.
translation: 蜂蜡。摆在架子上的古怪玩意儿。

text: A votive figure of the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot. I've only seen these in cave-shrines - beneath Meknes, beneath Alexandria, beneath [[Brancrug]].
translation: 三重结姐妹会的还愿像。我只在洞穴圣祠中见过这些——在梅克内斯之下,在亚历山大港之下,在[[布兰库格]]之下。

text: Something pagan, unburied, almost familiar.
translation: 某种异教的、未曾入土的东西,几乎令人熟悉。

text: Plays, poetry. One could call this collection 'eclectic'. One might suspect these are books chosen to be displayed, not read.
translation: 戏剧,诗歌。可以说这套收藏“兼收并蓄”。你不免疑心,这些书是为陈列而选,而非为阅读。

text: Plays, poetry.
translation: 戏剧,诗歌。

text: I can't be certain, but this looks very like a bust that stood in a tower room in [[Hush House]]. I remember it because the joke was that it was a real skull, waxed. One day I quietly checked that it wasn't.
translation: 我不敢肯定,但这尊半身像与曾在[[噤声居屋]]一间塔楼房间里立着的那尊十分相似。我之所以记得它,是因为当时有个玩笑,说那是颗打了蜡的真头骨。有一天,我悄悄验证过,并非如此。

text: A demurely risqué choice for a twentieth-century sanitarium.
translation: 对一座二十世纪的疗养院而言,这是个含蓄而大胆的选择。

text: (No creatures trapped inside, echoes the night.)
translation: (没有困住的生灵,黑夜回荡着。)

text: Coincidence?
translation: 巧合？

text: Is there a theme to this collection - a familiar theme?
translation: 这套收藏是否有一个主题——一个熟悉的主题？

text: This can't be a coincidence.
translation: 这不可能是巧合。

text: At least three of these objects have an Atlantic theme - perhaps a Cornish theme - perhaps specifically a [[Brancrug]] theme. Is there some connection between the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui, and [[Hush House]]?
translation: 这些物件中至少有三件带着大西洋主题——或许也是康沃尔主题——或许具体来说,是[[布兰库格]]主题。今日疗养院与[[噤声居屋]]之间,是否存在着某种关联？

text: Slavery to freedom; labour to industry; Egypt to America.
translation: 从奴役到自由;从劳作到工业;从埃及到美洲。

text: [Knock] What would they find on that mountain? The Mansus? The City Unbuilt?
translation: [启] 他们在那座山上会寻得什么？漫宿？未建之城？

text: [Forge] WE MAY ACHIEVE, the painting declares.
translation: [铸] “我们能有所成”,画作如此宣告。

text: [Winter] All that optimism, and then the Wars. Everything is worse than when I went away.
translation: [冬] 那样多的乐观,然后便是战争。一切都不如我离去之时。

text: 1936 was the centennial of Texas, and that star must stand for the Lone Star State where that [[Icarian]] community found Star-fragments. Perhaps that's a coincidence.
translation: 1936 年适逢得克萨斯百年之庆,那颗星想必代表孤星之州——那个[[伊加利亚]]社群正是在那里寻得了星之碎片。也许这只是巧合。

text: 1936. A bad year for me.
translation: 1936 年。对我来说是糟糕的一年。

text: [Back to the hall.]
translation: [回到大厅。]

text: 'Beneath the skin of the world we find the Mansus, also called the World-Spine, also called the House of the Sun. Above the House is the [[Glory]], the origin of light, to which souls aspire. At the foot of the House, and around its walls - though it has no walls - is the [[Wood]].'
translation: “在世界表皮之下,我们寻得漫宿——亦名世界之脊,亦名太阳居屋。居屋之上是[[辉光]],光的源头,众灵魂所向往者。居屋脚下,环绕四壁——虽说它并无墙壁——是那[[木材]]。”

text: Right there above the fireplace?
translation: 就挂在那儿,壁炉上方？

text: I've seen this before...
translation: 我以前见过这个……

text: And below the House - below the House -
translation: 而居屋之下——居屋之下——

text: This is what the Bureau would call a 'clear and immediate oneiric hazard.' There are a dozen images here which would have landed a dreamer in gaol. The Bureau's grip has loosened since the twenties, but still, it's quite something to display the painting so publicly.
translation: 这正是防剿局所称的“明确而迫近的梦境危害”。这里的图像足有十几处,足以令一个做梦者锒铛入狱。自二十年代以来,防剿局的掌控已有所松动,即便如此,如此公然地展出这幅画,也实在非同小可。

text: This is the work of the visionary they called the Magyar. It used to be one of the treasures of Hush House. I saw it there when I visited as a priest in the local parish - above the fireplace in the Westcott Room. It's safer to hang it above a fireplace - to keep the influences from threading their way into the dreams of the locals.
translation: 这是那位被称作“马扎尔人”的幻视者之作。它曾是噤声居屋的珍藏之一。当年我以本地教区神父的身份造访时,正是在那里见过它——在韦斯科特厅的壁炉上方。把它挂在壁炉上方更稳妥——免得那些影响丝丝缕缕,渗入本地人的梦中。

text: In my time as a parish priest in Cornwall, I saw it somewhere in [[Hush House]]. But where, exactly, is lost in a welter of scarred memories.
translation: 我在康沃尔任教区神父期间,曾在[[噤声居屋]]的某处见过它。但究竟是在何处,已湮没在一片伤痕累累的记忆之中。

text: How did it come here? Has someone been furnishing the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui with treasures from occult auctions?
translation: 它如何到了这里？莫非有人一直在用神秘拍卖会上拍得的珍藏来装点今日疗养院？

text: Below the House, the [[little joys of night]].
translation: 居屋之下,是[[夜的微小欢愉]]。

text: Never again.
translation: 再也不了。

text: [Step away, cautiously.]
translation: [小心地退开。]

text: The warrior-angel, winged, impassive, harnessed for war.
translation: 战争天使,双翼俱全,面容漠然,披挂备战。

text: [Edge/Knock] I remember my wounds in the Great War...
translation: [刃/启] 我记起我在大战中受的伤……

text: [Winter] I remember the sorrows of the Great War...
translation: [冬] 我记起大战中的种种悲伤……

text: [Lantern] St Michael is a favoured Name of a certain solar Hour. I remember when things were clearer. Should I pray...?
translation: [灯] 圣米迦勒是某位太阳司辰所宠爱的名。我记得世事尚属清明之时。我该祈祷吗……？

text: [Back to hallway.]
translation: [回到走廊。]

text: A lonely figure poles a flat boat across a lake of pistachio-green.
translation: 一个孤独的身影撑着一叶平底舟,渡过一片开心果绿的湖泊。

text: [Edge] Menacing.
translation: [刃] 凶险。

text: [Rose] Inviting.
translation: [引] 诱人。

text: I've seen this painting before...
translation: 我以前见过这幅画……

text: [Look away.]
translation: [移开目光。]

text: [Winter] Peaceful.
translation: [冬] 安宁。

text: When I was priest in [[Brancrug]], I sometimes saw Christopher Illopoly in his rooms in [[Hush House]] - to argue about theology and drink his horrible burdock tea. I saw it there.
translation: 我在[[布兰库格]]任神父时,偶尔会去[[噤声居屋]]的房间拜访克里斯托弗·伊洛波利——为争论神学,也为喝他那难以下咽的牛蒡茶。我就是在那里见过它。

text: When I was priest in [[Brancrug]], I sometimes saw Christopher Illopoly in his rooms in [[Hush House]] - to argue about theology and drink his horrible burdock tea. I saw it there, I think...
translation: 我在[[布兰库格]]任神父时,偶尔会去[[噤声居屋]]的房间拜访克里斯托弗·伊洛波利——为争论神学,也为喝他那难以下咽的牛蒡茶。我想,我就是在那里见过它……

text: I remember that I remarked on it; and he told me that it was a 'prefigure', done before the war by one of the Librarians of the place - someone who had the knack of copying work by other artists. But he'd copy the work before they'd ever actually painted it.
translation: 我记得我曾就它作过评点;他告诉我,那是一件“先行之作”,战前由此地一位司书所作——此人颇擅摹仿其他艺术家的作品。但他摹仿的,是那些艺术家尚未来得及画出的作品。

text: So is it the original, from the House, or the... actual original... from what was then the future?
translation: 那么,这幅是出自居屋的原作,还是……真正的原作……那件来自彼时而言尚属未来的原作？

text: Look closer.
translation: 凑近细看。

text: It's signed LEVINSEN... but with a question mark after the signature. The prefigure, then, not the later work.
translation: 签名是“莱文森”……但签名之后跟着一个问号。那么,这是先行之作,而非后来那幅作品。

text: She's probably dead now.
translation: 她现在多半已经死了。

text: Did Picasso ever paint a woman he didn't want?
translation: 毕加索可曾画过他不想要的女人？

text: Who was she?
translation: 她是谁？

text: The Sanitarium wanted a bit of local colour.
translation: 疗养院想要一点本地色彩。

text: [Yes: this response was conditioned by your choice when you came to Antibes.]
translation: [是:这条回应取决于你抵达昂蒂布时的选择。]

text: That's long after he painted his Pierrots. And long after I left the world. But I heard a story on the train up from Alexandria.
translation: 那远在他画皮埃罗之后。也远在我离开人世之后。不过,我在从亚历山大港北上的火车上,听过一个故事。

text: Step close to the painting. Whisper: '[[Ubu]]...'
translation: 凑近画作。低声呢喃:“[[于布]]……”

text: She's simmering with suppressed rage, perhaps. Or is that me?
translation: 她也许正压抑着翻涌的怒火。又或者,那是我的怒火。

text: 'Antibes. Before War came to the World, this was the sweet blue eye of the Riviera. Yachts and parties and film-star villas. Picasso painted Pierrots, here by the sea...'
translation: “昂蒂布。在战争降临世界之前,这里是里维埃拉湛蓝温柔的眼眸。游艇,派对,影星的别墅。毕加索在海边画下皮埃罗……”

text: [We'll rarely be explicit about how your earlier choices play into consequences. But we wanted to confirm that even tiny choices sometimes have some tiny relevance.]
translation: [我们很少明言,你此前的选择会如何演变为后果。但我们想让你确认:即便是微小的选择,有时也会有微小的牵系。]

text: [Step back.]
translation: [退后一步。]

text: She's in pain, perhaps...
translation: 她也许正承受着痛苦……

text: Did the Sanitarium's patrons buy this? Confiscate it? Loot it?
translation: 疗养院的赞助人是买下了它？没收了它？还是抢走了它？

text: There's a [[History]] where I found myself living by the sea in a stately white house, with a painting like this over my fireplace...
translation: 有一段[[历史]],在那其中,我发现自己住在海边的白屋之中,华美庄严,壁炉上方就挂着这样一幅画……

text: [Move on.]
translation: [继续走。]

text: It's dated and signed. 1941.
translation: 画上有日期,有签名。1941 年。

text: That's long after he painted his Pierrots. And long after I left the world. I have no idea if he was even in Antibes then.
translation: 那远在他画皮埃罗之后。也远在我离开人世之后。我甚至不知道他那时是否身在昂蒂布。

text: He was in Paris during the occupation. An Enemy officer saw Guernica on the wall of his apartment. 'Did you do that?' the officer asked.
translation: 占领期间,他身在巴黎。一名敌方军官看见他公寓墙上挂着格尔尼卡。“这是你画的？”军官问道。

text: 'No',' Picasso said, 'you did'.
translation: “不,”毕加索说,“是你们画的。”

text: I wonder if it's true.
translation: 不知此事是否属实。

text: The tiniest of revenges.
translation: 最微小的复仇。

text: Picasso probably invented the story himself, and spread it once the Enemy was gone.
translation: 这故事大概是毕加索自己编造的,待敌人离去之后,便将它散播开来。

text: An abstract in vivid colours.
translation: 一幅色彩浓烈的抽象画。

text: [Winter] Hideous.
translation: [冬] 丑陋。

text: [Moth] Fascinating.
translation: [蛾] 迷人。

text: [Grail] Somehow, it brings [[Nina Lagasse]] to mind...
translation: [杯] 不知怎的,它让我想起[[尼娜·拉加斯]]……

text: [Back to the hall.]
translation: [回到大厅。]

text: [Grail] It looks nothing like Nina. But somehow it reminds me of when I came here seeking her. Perhaps I just remembered the painting from that day...
translation: [杯] 它一点也不像尼娜。但不知怎的,它让我想起当初我来到这里寻她的情形。也许,我只是记起了那一天见过的那幅画……

text: Another vivid abstract, like the one at the door.
translation: 又一幅色彩浓烈的抽象画,与门口那幅相似。

text: It's even worse than the one by the front door.
translation: 比前门那幅还要糟。

text: It's even more striking than the one by the front door.
translation: 比前门那幅还要触目。

text: Nina's white shadow, again in my thoughts...
translation: 尼娜白色的身影,又萦绕在我心间……

text: Ugh...
Yes...
translation: 是啊……

text: Ugh.
translation: 呃。

text: Mm.
translation: 唔。

text: Yes.
translation: 是啊。

text: Wasn't there another one like this, back by the door?
translation: 门边不是还有一幅与此相仿的吗？

text: The secret heart of the wood? Or the [[Wood]]? Did Emmenegger approach the [[Mansus]] in his dreams?
translation: 这片树林的秘密之心？抑或那[[木材]]？埃门内格是否曾在梦中接近[[漫宿]]？

text: [Knock] It has that quality. I wonder what he found there...
translation: [启] 确有那种质地。不知他在那里寻见了什么……

text: [Winter] It's just a forest at night. Not everything is occult.
translation: [冬] 不过是夜晚的森林。并非一切皆为玄秘。

text: [Grail] Who knows? But the darkness between the trees draws me.
translation: [杯] 谁知道呢？但树丛间的黑暗吸引着我。

text: [Back to the room.]
translation: [回到房间。]

text: I turn the handle. With an oiled click, the safe swings open, yawning a steel yawn...
translation: 我转动把手。随着一声油润的咔嗒,保险柜的门荡开,仿佛打了个钢铁的哈欠……

text: My heart and the night agree: the safe will open when I turn the handle.
translation: 我的心与夜晚不谋而合:只要我转动把手,保险柜便会打开。

text: Sort through the contents.
translation: 翻拣里面的东西。

text: Is there someone else here? Pull back and look around.
translation: 这里还有别人？退后,环顾四周。

text: No cash in the safe: just documents. Letters, financial records... six notebooks. One is labelled HOBSON.
translation: 保险柜里没有现金:只有文件。书信、财务记录……六本笔记。其中一本标着“霍布森”。

text: Look through the notebook with my name.
translation: 翻看写着我的名字的那本笔记。

text: It's written in some sort of cipher. There's only a page and a half of notes so far.
translation: 笔记是用某种密码写成的。目前只有一页半的记录。

text: There is also an unflattering doodle of me. It's probably me. It has a moustache, anyway.
translation: 还有一幅对我毫不恭维的涂鸦。大概是我。反正它画着胡子。

text: Look through the other notebooks.
translation: 翻看其余几本笔记。

text: SINOMBRE, STRATHCOYNE, VLACHOS. RAVELINE? and LAGASSE.
translation: 西诺姆布尔、斯特拉斯科因、弗拉霍斯。拉韦林？还有拉加斯。

text: Lagasse is her name now, the night reminds me. But there was a time when they called her the Witch of Lagash.
