translation: 拉加斯如今确是她的名字,夜晚提醒着我。但曾有一段时日,他们称她为拉加什的女巫。

text: My heart throbs urgently in response.
translation: 我的心随之急切地搏动。

text: A flimsy slip of paper - a calendrier with details of a travelling carnival - slides out from between the pages of the LAGASSE notebook...
translation: 一张轻薄的纸片——一份载着巡回马戏团详情的日历——从“拉加斯”笔记本的书页间滑落……

text: Pocket it.
translation: 把它收进口袋。

text: To learn more, examine the Calendrier in your Inventory.
translation: 想了解更多,请在物品栏中查看那份日历。

text: Wind soughs. Night-time noises. No-one coming.
translation: 风呜呜作响。夜晚的声响。没有人来。

text: This safe isn't safe. Close it and step back.
translation: 这保险柜并不保险。合上它,退后。

text: Close the safe and step back.
translation: 合上保险柜,退后。

text: Growl under my breath.
translation: 低声咆哮。

text: Sniff contemptuously.
translation: 轻蔑地嗤了一声。

text: Chuckle.
translation: 低笑。

text: This is a battleship-grey safe of Incorporate manufacture, solid as a continent, gleaming dully in the dimness. A safe like this opens only to the correct combination, or with the correct application of explosives.
translation: 这是一台集团出产的军舰灰保险柜,坚固如大陆,在昏暗中泛着暗哑的微光。这样的保险柜,只有正确的密码组合才能打开,或者恰当地使用炸药。

text: Leave it for now.
translation: 暂且放着。

text: Approach it.
translation: 走上前去。

text: The safe opens easily.
translation: 保险柜轻而易举地打开了。

text: Look through the financial records.
translation: 翻看财务记录。

text: But there's something else. On almost every document there's an enigmatic line item: ONTEIRIC CO-ORDINATION.
translation: 但还有别的东西。几乎每一份文件上都有一个费解的条目:冥合。

text: The Sanitarium receives substantial funding from the European Recovery Program - the Acheson Mission - and from a semi-charitable Incorporate entity called the Meninger Foundation. Very substantial funding.
translation: 疗养院从欧洲复兴计划——艾奇逊使命——以及一家名为曼宁格基金会的半慈善集团实体处获得大笔资金。极其大笔的资金。

text: The 'Office of Onteiric Coordination' - the [[OOC]]? Who exactly is funding Aubière? Is the money really coming from Menninger?
translation: “冥合办公室”——就是[[OOC]]？究竟是谁在资助奥比埃？这笔钱当真来自曼宁格吗？

text: Something that was here has been erased by shadow. A map? A painting?
translation: 原本在此的某样东西,被阴影抹去了。一幅地图？一幅画？

text: Leave that alone, you ridiculous man. I'm much more exciting and ten times as bright.
translation: 别碰那东西,你这荒唐的男人。我可比它有趣得多,也要明亮十倍。

text: There's nothing there for you, and be glad of that. Come talk to Sinombre, you poor silly thing.
translation: 那里没有你要的东西,你该为此庆幸。过来和西诺姆布尔聊聊吧,你这可怜的小傻瓜。

text: The shadow is its own kind of substance. It almost drips darkness.
translation: 那阴影自有其质地。它几乎在滴淌黑暗。

text: [Craft] Use it.
translation: [炼制] 加以利用。

text: Leave it.
translation: 置之不理。

text: The grass here ripples with life, like a well-kept horse in a sunray.
translation: 此处的草叶如波浪般起伏,生机盎然,像一匹养得油亮的马立在日光之中。

text: The woman in the chair is watching me curiously. I should at least speak to her before I begin interfering with her floor.
translation: 椅中的女人正好奇地看着我。在我开始动她的地板之前,至少该先同她说句话。

text: A good place for the Arts Unconsidered.
translation: 施展未识技艺的好地方。

text: [Leave the Verdant Place alone for the moment.]
translation: [暂且别动那片青翠之地。]

text: [Craft] To work.
translation: [炼制] 开工。

text: Later.
translation: 改日再说。

text: I propose an arrangement. I have in my desk a certain box, which has resisted my efforts to open it. Before your so-mysterious disappearance, you were, I understand, good with locks. Seals. Safeguards of that kind.
translation: 我提议一项安排。我的书桌里有一只盒子,一直抗拒着我打开它的尝试。在您那次神秘莫测的失踪之前,据我所知,您精于锁具。封缄。诸如此类的防护之法。

text: You must understand, an alienist - a physician of the psychic organs - I would prefer to say 'psychiatrist', if you are familiar with the term - is in some respects - and only in these respects - like an adept of the invisible arts -
translation: 您须明白,一位精神病学家——精神器官的医师——若您熟悉这个词,我更愿称其为“精神科医师”——在某些方面——而且仅限于这些方面——与一位隐形技艺的修士颇为相似——

text: [Interrupt] Spit it out, man.
translation: [打断] 有话直说,老兄。

text: [Wait for him to finish]
translation: [等他把话说完]

text: Spencer Hobson. What a fortunate and delightful honour. I am Dr Aubière. You are very welcome to my little institution, M. Hobson.
translation: 斯宾塞·霍布森。何等有幸,何等快意。我是奥比埃医生。欢迎光临我这小小的机构,霍布森先生。

text: You know who I am?
translation: 你知道我是谁？

text: Most certainly. There are excellent photographs in the files. You have had quite the career. Your time in the Suppression Bureau, in the Légion du Seuil. That regrettable business in Poland....
translation: 自然知道。档案里有极为出色的照片。您的履历相当不凡。您在防剿局的岁月,在门关军团的岁月。还有波兰那桩令人遗憾的勾当……

text: And then you disappeared, M. Hobson. Where did you go?
translation: 而后您便消失了,霍布森先生。您去了何处？

text: Where's [[Nina Lagasse]]?
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]在哪儿？

text: May I ask, what is your interest?
translation: 敢问,您有何来意？

text: The honour is mine, Dr Aubière.
translation: 荣幸的是我,奥比埃医生。

text: Handsome place, this. How did you pay for it?
translation: 这地方真体面。您是如何弄到钱的？

text: Perhaps, M. Hobson, we can discuss that later. For now - how may I assist you?
translation: 或许,霍布森先生,我们稍后再谈这个。眼下——我该如何为您效劳？

text: Not at all. I do hope I may be of some assistance.
translation: 不必客气。我由衷希望能帮上些忙。

text: I'm looking for a former patient of yours. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找您的一位旧病人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: [Truth] I know in my heart that I need to find her.
translation: [实话] 我心中明白,我必须找到她。

text: [Truth] There's a matter that only Nina can help with.
translation: [实话] 有件事,只有尼娜帮得上忙。

text: [Truth] I haven't really thought about it.
translation: [实话] 我还没怎么想过这件事。

text: My business is my own.
translation: 我的事,是我自己的事。

text: Mm. Mm.
translation: 嗯。嗯。

text: Certain privileges are afforded to me by our patrons. I would very much like to employ those privileges to your benefit.
translation: 我们的赞助人赋予了我某些特权。我非常乐意动用这些特权,为您谋得好处。

text: ...it is a grave responsibility, M. Hobson, to be a healer of minds, just as it is an adept. Especially minds so exceptional as those of our patients....
translation: ……成为心灵的医者是一项沉重的责任,霍布森先生,正如成为一名修士。尤其是我们病人那般卓异的心灵……

text: [Wait for him to finish]
translation: [等他把话说完]

text: in that I am the holder - the keeper - the guardian! - of certain information not shared with the wider public. That includes any information I might have on Mlle Lagasse's whereabouts.
translation: 正因为我乃是某些信息的所有者——守护者——卫士!——这些信息从不与广众共享。其中便包括我可能掌握的关于拉加斯小姐下落的一切信息。

text: [Aubière gives a tight smile, as if snapping closed a preferred hypothesis.] I am very sorry, M. Hobson, but any information I might have on Mlle Lagasse's whereabouts - that information is confidential.
translation: [奥比埃露出紧绷的一笑,仿佛啪地合上了一册心爱的假说。] 非常抱歉,霍布森先生,但凡我可能掌握的关于拉加斯小姐下落的信息——那些信息均属机密。

text: Of course. I understand.
translation: 当然。我明白。

text: [Menacing] That's unfortunate.
translation: [威胁] 那可真遗憾。

text: You mean, it'll cost me.
translation: 你的意思是,我得付出代价。

text: Nothing so crude, M. Hobson. However...
translation: 没那么露骨,霍布森先生。不过……

text: Go on.
translation: 说下去。

text: If I open that box for you, then you'll tell me where I can find Nina?
translation: 如果我替你打开那只盒子,你便会告诉我,我能在哪里找到尼娜？

text: Precisely so.
translation: 正是如此。

text: That's very kind of you, Dr Aubière. I hope I can return your kindness in some way.
translation: 您太客气了,奥比埃医生。但愿我能以某种方式回报您的好意。

text: Stop wasting my time, Doctor. What are you talking about?
translation: 别浪费我的时间,医生。您究竟在说什么？

text: Of course. I'm still an ordained priest of the Church Solar...
translation: 当然。我仍是太阳教会的一名授职神父……

text: A vessel to carry the consecrated Host - to those too ill to attend church.
translation: 一个器皿,盛装祝圣过的圣体——送予那些病重得无法去教堂的人。

text: Let's say I do.
translation: 就当我是吧。

text: Just so.
translation: 正是如此。

text: This is perhaps a very old pyx. Or, one source has it, a reliquary - with a relic perhaps of St Galileo himself. In any case it has proven difficult to open. I am reluctant to damage it.
translation: 这或许是一只年代极古的圣体盒。又或者,据某处记载,是一具圣物匣——内中或许藏着圣伽利略本人的遗物。无论如何,它始终难以开启。我不忍将其损坏。

text: The doctor bends over in his chair to poke around in a drawer at the base of his desk. For a few seconds, he bends low enough that his head is beneath the level of the desk-top.
translation: 医生坐在椅中弯下腰,在书桌底座处的抽屉里翻找。有那么几秒,他弯得极低,头都低到了桌面之下。

text: Wait politely.
translation: 礼貌地等候。

text: Take the opportunity to swipe something valuable off his desk.
translation: 趁机从他桌上顺走一件值钱的东西。

text: Try to read some of the papers on his desk, upside-down.
translation: 试着倒着读他桌上的几份文件。

text: Clears any Exhibits from our desk interactions
translation: 清除我们桌面互动中留下的全部展品

text: Here. Do you know what is a 'pyx'? [Aubière is vertical again.]
translation: 给。你知道什么是「圣体盒」吗？〔奥比埃又直起身了。〕

text: [He's holding a circular box the size of a small cake-tin. A worn silver-gilt dove sits atop it.]
translation: 他捧着一只圆盒，大小如同小号蛋糕模。盒顶蹲着一只磨损的银鎏金鸽子。

text: Letterheads from an Incorporate entity called the Menninger Foundation, and from the European Recovery Program - the Acheson Mission. Both thank Aubière for his reports - though the ERP letter is much terser. Both discuss further funding... and Aubière is straightening up.
translation: 信头来自一家名为曼宁格基金会的集团实体，以及欧洲复兴计划——艾奇逊使团。两封信都感谢奥比埃呈交的报告——不过 ERP 那封要简慢得多。两封都谈及进一步的资助……而奥比埃正在直起身来。

text: Letterheads from an Incorporate entity called the Menninger Foundation, and from the European Recovery Program - the Acheson Mission - but Aubière is already straightening up.
translation: 信头来自一家名为曼宁格基金会的集团实体，以及欧洲复兴计划——艾奇逊使团——但奥比埃已经直起身来。

text: A little antique coin - silver, perhaps. I pocket it hastily as Aubière returns to the vertical.
translation: 一枚小小的古币——也许是银的。趁奥比埃重新直起身，我匆匆把它揣进口袋。

text: A little antique silver coin is just too far away to snag. I settle for a fountain pen and pocket it hastily as Aubière returns to the vertical.
translation: 那枚小小的古银币太远，够不着。我退而求其次，拿了一支钢笔，趁奥比埃重新直起身时匆匆揣进兜里。

text: Cough impatiently.
translation: 不耐烦地咳嗽一声。

text: What's in it?
translation: 里面是什么？

text: If it's a pyx, then I would imagine only the dust of centuries. If a reliquary, then, perhaps, a relic of St Galileo. Or, it might be, a surprise! Enticing, no?
translation: 若是圣体盒，我想里面只有几个世纪的尘埃。若是圣物匣，那或许装着圣伽利略的遗骸。又或许……是个惊喜！引人好奇，不是吗？

text: Where did it come from?
translation: 它从哪儿来的？

text: It was a gift to the institution from another guest. Someone who collects curios. I thought he wanted to show his gratitude to us. But I begin to suspect a little prank.
translation: 是另一位客人赠与本院的礼物。那人喜爱收藏古玩。我原以为他是想向我们表达谢意。可我开始怀疑，这是个小小的恶作剧。

text: [Hold out a hand for the box.]
translation: 伸出手，向他讨要盒子。

text: The box is heavy; cold to the touch. One quartz-crystal eye flashes in the Antibes sunlight. The dove's other eye is missing.
translation: 盒子很沉；触手冰凉。一颗石英水晶眼在昂蒂布的阳光下闪烁。鸽子的另一只眼不见了。

text: Press the dove's eye.
translation: 按下鸽子的眼睛。

text: Try to twist the dove.
translation: 试着拧动鸽子。

text: Examine the box for inscriptions.
translation: 检查盒子上有无铭文。

text: [Pry at the lid of the box with a fingernail.]
translation: 用指甲撬动盒盖。

text: With almost no pressure, the lid pops easily and unceremoniously out: the box is open. Inside, a little white ceramic jar.
translation: 几乎没用什么力气，盒盖便轻易、毫不讲究地弹开：盒子开了。里面是一只小小的白色瓷罐。

text: Shake the box.
translation: 摇一摇盒子。

text: You're a doctor, and your patient records are confidential.... unless I crack open your puzzle-box. That's a little unusual, isn't it?
translation: 你是医生，病人的病历是保密的……除非我撬开了你的谜盒。这多少有点不寻常，不是吗？

text: Yes. Irregular, even. But though I wish to help, I must account for my actions. If I am asked why I shared this information - then if I can say that I needed your expertise - it will go easier for us both.
translation: 是的，甚至可以说是不合常规。但即便我愿意相助，也必须为自己的行为负责。若有人问起我为何泄露这些信息——那时，我若能说，我需要你的专业——对我们俩都会好办些。

text: The sunlight folds itself tidily across the desk, softened by the glass of the window. The softened colour of it takes me back...
translation: 阳光穿过窗玻璃，柔柔地、整整齐齐地叠在桌面上。那柔化的颜色，让我回到从前……

text: Just so the Cornish sunlight folded itself across the desk in the Westcott Room, where Serena would wait to question me after my visits to the infirmary. This Aubière is a little like Serena: a velvet surface, but under pressure, hard as oak.
translation: 正如康沃尔的阳光也曾那样叠在韦斯科特室的桌面上——我每回探过医务室，塞蕾娜都会在那儿等着盘问我。这个奥比埃，有几分像塞蕾娜：天鹅绒的表面，一旦受压，却硬如橡木。

text: [Remain silent.]
translation: [保持沉默。]

text: Of course you are. I'm sorry.
translation: 你当然如此。我抱歉。

text: Mm. The files suggest some complexity in that regard... but of course. You know then that a pyx is used to convey the Host.
translation: 嗯。档案显示，那方面有些复杂……不过，当然。那你应当知道，圣体盒是用来运送圣体的。

text: Perhaps we can talk about that later.
translation: 也许，我们晚些再谈这个。

text: [Truth] Better to say, I was lost.
translation: 真话。不如说，我是迷了路。

text: [Truth-ish] The seaside.
translation: 半真话。海边。

text: Please accept my sympathies. How may I assist you?
translation: 请接受我的哀悼。我能帮你什么？

text: Mm. I hope you found your seaside stay restful.
translation: 嗯。希望你的海边小住还算安宁。

text: Very well. How may I assist you?
translation: 好吧。我能帮你什么？

text: Nothing happens.
translation: 什么都没发生。

text: Over steepled fingers, Aubière watches.
translation: 奥比埃指尖相抵，静静看着。

text: Nothing happens.
translation: 什么都没发生。

text: A rattling sound. There is something inside, the weight of a large coin. Definitely neither consecrated wafers nor dust.
translation: 里面传来咔嗒声。有东西，分量像一枚大硬币。绝非祝圣面饼，也绝非尘埃。

text: Latin, scratched, not engraved, on the base. The scratches have worn so thin that, had I not turned it to reflect the sunlight, I wouldn't have seen it at all. ECCE PRAESENSUM ROSARUM.
translation: 底部是拉丁文，划刻而成，而非镌刻。划痕磨损得极浅，若不是我把它转过来对着阳光，我根本不会看见。ECCE PRAESENSUM ROSARUM。

text: Scratches on the bottom. Perhaps someone scratched a message there and it wore away. Perhaps someone just stored it in a bag of nails.
translation: 底部有划痕。也许有人在那儿刻过一句话，后来磨损掉了。也许只是有人把它同一袋钉子放在一处。

text: Examine the box for hidden catches.
translation: 检查盒子上有无暗扣。

text: Nothing. Though my fingers linger on the details of the feathers. This was shaped with love.
translation: 没有。不过我的指尖在羽毛的细节间流连。这是怀着爱意塑成的。

text: Nothing.
translation: 什么也没有。

text: [Sombre interpretation] 'Mark well this foreboding of roses.'
translation: 沉郁之解。「谨记这玫瑰的凶兆。」

text: [Neutral interpretation] 'Behold, a presentiment of roses.'
translation: 中性之解。「看哪，这玫瑰的预感。」

text: [Optimistic interpretation] 'Here is the revelation of roses.'
translation: 乐观之解。「这便是玫瑰的启示。」

text: Not a phrase I've heard in any liturgical or theological context.
translation: 这句话，我在任何礼拜仪式或神学语境中都未曾听过。

text: Aubière's mouth is also open.
translation: 奥比埃的嘴也张着。

text: Remarkable!
translation: 了不起！

text: Aubière cracks open a new notebook, clicks a clean chrome ballpoint pen, and excitedly jots down a note.
translation: 奥比埃翻开一本新笔记本，咔嗒一声按出一支锃亮的镀铬圆珠笔，兴奋地记下一笔。

text: Your turn.
translation: 轮到你了。

text: So... Nina?
translation: 那么……尼娜？

text: Aubière stops writing. He purses his mouth thoughtfully.
translation: 奥比埃停下笔。他抿起嘴，若有所思。

text: I apologise most sincerely, M. Hobson. I have reconsidered. I think it would be therapeutically unhelpful for me to tell you where to find Mlle Lagasse.
translation: 我万分真诚地向你道歉，霍布森先生。我重新考虑过了。我想，告诉你拉加斯小姐的去处，对你的治疗并无好处。

text: Really.
translation: 是吗。

text: You'll find it pretty damned therapeutically unhelpful if you don't tell me.
translation: 你要是不告诉我，你很快就会领教，那才叫对治疗毫无好处。

text: I'm disappointed in you, Dr Aubière.
translation: 我对你很失望，奥比埃医生。

text: [Look him in the eye and wait.]
translation: 直视他的眼睛，等着。

text: My revised proposal is this. You remain as my guest for a few days, so that I can satisfy my - my concerns about your wellbeing. Your medical history is extraordinary. You must know that.
translation: 我修订后的提议是这样的。你以我客人的身份再留几天，好让我满足我——我对你安康的担忧。你的病史非同寻常。你应当知道这点。

text: You mean, the Worms ate me, but here I am?
translation: 你是说，蠕虫吃了我，可我还在这儿？

text: I do understand that. And I can only repeat my apology.
translation: 我确实明白。而我只能再次道歉。

text: M. Hobson! We are surely not the kind of men to make threats!
translation: 霍布森先生！我们想来都不是会发出威胁的那种人！

text: After a few moments, Aubière looks away. He coughs to cover his embarrassment.
translation: 片刻之后，奥比埃移开目光。他咳了一声，掩饰窘迫。

text: To hell with your revised proposal. To hell with your institution. And to particular hell with you.
translation: 去你修订后的提议。去你的疗养院。尤其，去你。

text: 'Guest'. And what if I want to leave?
translation: 「客人。」那，要是我执意离开呢？

text: Good heavens, M. Hobson, then you can leave, of course, at any time! I would in any case find it very difficult to restrict your movements.
translation: 天哪，霍布森先生，那您当然随时都可以离开！况且，要限制您的行动，我无论如何也会觉得很难办。

text: [Aubière makes a moue of distaste.] Just so. Among other things.
translation: 奥比埃厌恶地撇了撇嘴。正是如此。诸如此类。

text: Do you want to treat me, or to study me?
translation: 你是想治疗我，还是研究我？

text: [Aubière flaps a hand deprecatingly.] An old friend of mine would say: 'Why only one? Why only two?'
translation: 奥比埃不以为然地摆摆手。我的一位老朋友会说：「为什么只有一个？为什么只有两个？」

text: [Mull a response.]
translation: 斟酌着如何作答。

text: It is full sunlight in this room, but I can almost hear the night. The night would say: stay here, and you might win this man's co-operation. Or you might find another way. You might not need his co-operation.
translation: 这间屋子里阳光满溢，但我几乎能听见夜晚。夜晚会说：留在这里，你或许能赢得这个人的合作。或者你可以另寻他路。也许你根本不需要他的合作。

text: Ask more questions.
translation: 再问些问题。

text: [Decide] Dr Aubière...
translation: 下定决心。奥比埃医生……

text: Yes?
translation: 嗯？

text: I agree to your revised proposal.
translation: 我接受你修订后的提议。

text: I'll stay here for the moment. And perhaps we'll talk again.
translation: 我暂且留在这里。也许，我们还会再谈。

text: I understand your feelings, M. Hobson, most sincerely I -
translation: 我理解你的感受，霍布森先生，万分真诚地，我——

text: [Stand up abruptly; stalk out, daring Aubière to ask for his box back.]
translation: 猛然起身；大步离去，看奥比埃敢不敢开口讨回他的盒子。

text: [Stand up abruptly; drop the pyx clattering on his desk; stalk out.]
translation: 猛然起身；把圣体盒哐当丢在他桌上；大步离去。

text: [Stand up abruptly; pocket the little ceramic jar; drop the pyx clattering on his desk; stalk out.]
translation: 猛然起身；把小瓷罐揣进兜里；把圣体盒哐当丢在他桌上；大步离去。

text: Thank you, M. Hobson. I could in all candour ask for nothing more. Except... euh... perhaps my box. May I please have my box back?
translation: 谢谢你，霍布森先生。坦率而言，我已别无所求。除了……呃……也许还有我的盒子。能把我的盒子还给我吗？

text: You know, I think that would be therapeutically unhelpful for you.
translation: 你知道吗，我倒觉得，那对你的治疗可没什么好处。

text: Of course. Here.
translation: 当然。给你。

text: Here. [Pass him the pyx, but pocket the little jar you found in it.]
translation: 给你。把圣体盒递给他，但把盒里发现的小瓷罐揣进自己的口袋。

text: I'd like to examine it further. I'm sure you won't mind.
translation: 我想再仔细研究它。想必你不会介意。

text: Thank you so much.
translation: 多谢你。

text: Hm. I suppose I rather brought that on myself.
translation: 嗯。我想，这多少算是我自找的。

text: And the... I see. Well, so be it. I am a realist.
translation: 还有那……我明白了。好吧，也只能如此了。我是个现实主义者。

text: Goodbye for now, M. Hobson. I hope you will speak to our other guests... I am interested to learn what you all make of each other.
translation: 暂时别过，霍布森先生。希望你会同我们的其他客人谈谈……我很想知道你们彼此会有什么看法。

text: You said you had files on me. I'd like to see them.
translation: 你说过你手上有我的档案。我想看看。

text: Oh no no. Our Incorporate patrons have files, which I have been privileged to see. But I have no file on you.
translation: 哦，不不。我们集团的赞助人们有档案，我有幸看过。但我没有你的档案。

text: Although most certainly I will now open a file of my own!
translation: 不过，眼下我肯定要为你单独开一份档案了！

text: Is there nothing you can tell me? I've come a long way to find her.
translation: 你就没有什么能告诉我的吗？我走了很远的路，只为找到她。

text: However...
translation: 不过……

text: Well...
You may know that I'm a medical man myself. I'm concerned for her health.
translation: 你可能也知道，我自己是行医之人。我担心她的身体。

text: Indeed. I do not discount your expertise. But you have no credentials in this country.
translation: 确实。我并不轻视你的专业。但在这个国家，你没有行医资格。

text: That is true. But you have no credentials in this country. Monsieur Hobson
translation: 说得没错。但在这个国家，你也没有行医资格。霍布森先生。

text: [Remain silent, but keep watching him.]
translation: 保持沉默，但一直盯着他。

text: Euh... a vessel for the consecrated Host. To convey it to those who will not... euh... attend church... mm.
translation: 呃……盛放祝圣圣体的容器。用来把圣体送抵那些不会……呃……去教堂的人手中……嗯。

text: [Lie] Back to Algeria. Another engagement with the Légion.
translation: 谎话。回阿尔及利亚。再入外籍军团服役。

text: I am glad you survived so intact. Without even, if I may say, the usual Légion desert tan.
translation: 我很高兴你全须全尾地活了下来。甚至，恕我直言，连外籍军团常有的沙漠晒痕都没有。

text: Night campaign.
translation: 夜战。

text: [Just smile.]
translation: 只是微笑。

text: 'A few days.' How long, exactly?
translation: 「几天。」具体是多久？

text: Oh, not so very long. I would not expect so long as a week. But I must make my assessment.
translation: 哦，不会太久。我想用不了一星期。但我必须做出评估。

text: Right.
translation: 好。

text: You seem surprised, Doctor.
translation: 你似乎很惊讶，医生。

text: Yes; I must confess that I am. I had hoped you would be able to open the box. I did not expect you to succeed so... anticlimactically.
translation: 是的；我承认确实如此。我本指望你能打开这盒子。却没想到你成功得如此……平淡。

text: Don't underestimate me again.
translation: 别再小看我。

text: I will endeavour so not to do.
translation: 我会努力不再如此。

text: Touch the box with a tongue-tip.
translation: 用舌尖触碰盒子。

text: The chill of the metal is more clearly perceptible. There is no taste; except the dust of an object kept for some time in a doctor's desk.
translation: 金属的凉意更清晰可辨。没有味道；只有某件在医生抽屉里搁置已久的器物所沾的灰尘味。

text: Withdraw tongue.
translation: 收回舌尖。

text: Give the box a more definite, slurping lick. As if addressing oneself to an ice-cream.
translation: 更用力地舔一口盒子，发出啜吸声。就像对着一个冰淇淋。

text: Nothing further occurs. Except that Aubière, clearly alarmed, half-raises a hand in protest.
translation: 再无其他发生。只是奥比埃明显受了惊，半举起一只手表示抗议。

text: I feel Aubière's eyes on my back, but he says nothing.
translation: 我感觉奥比埃的目光落在我背上，但他什么也没说。

text: The director is a man in distinguished middle age with a look of sleek intelligence. His hair, his nails, his smile are all extremely clean.
translation: 院长是位风度高雅的中年人，神情透着油滑的机敏。他的头发、指甲、笑容，全都干净得出奇。

text: I need to see a patient of yours. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我要见你的一位病人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: Mm. Mademoiselle Lagasse, I'm afraid, has left us.
translation: 嗯。恐怕，拉加斯小姐已经离开我们了。
那么……？

text: The director of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui smiles at me from behind his desk.
translation: 今日疗养院的院长隔着办公桌向我微笑。

text: DEBUG exit early
translation: 调试：提前退出。

text: Hello again, M. Hobson. Do sit down.
translation: 又见面了，霍布森先生。请坐。

text: [Sit down.]
translation: 坐下。

text: Later, perhaps, Doctor.
translation: 也许改天吧，医生。

text: [Turn and leave without a word.]
translation: 转身，一言不发地离开。

text: Do you know where?
translation: 你知道她在哪吗？

text: 'Mademoiselle'?
translation: 「小姐」？

text: Just so.
translation: 正是如此。

text: DEBUG exit early, swipe thing
translation: 调试：提前退出，顺走东西。

text: We have already prepared Mlle Lagasse's room for a new guest. You'll find it upstairs.
translation: 我们已经把拉加斯小姐的房间收拾出来，留给新客人了。你上楼就能找到。

text: A dove. There is an Hour named Elegiast. The Ivory Dove, he's called.
translation: 一只鸽子。有位司辰名为悼歌诗人。人称骨白鸽。

text: '[[Elegiast]].' I am not especially familiar with these esoteric doctrines.
translation: 「[[悼歌诗人]]。」我对这些秘传教义并不特别熟悉。

text: A kindly Hour. It's the Elegiast who ensures the Dead are remembered.
translation: 一位仁慈的司辰。正是悼歌诗人，确保亡者为人铭记。

text: An Hour of secrets. He knows the names of all the Dead.
translation: 一位掌握秘密的司辰。他知晓所有亡者的名字。

text: An Hour of forbidden appetites. He inspires his votaries to consume the flesh of the dead...
translation: 一位心怀禁忌欲求的司辰。他激励信徒们吞食亡者的血肉……

text: How revolting. Why?
translation: 真叫人作呕。为什么？

text: A busy Hour, then, these last ten years.
translation: 那么，这十年来，这位司辰想必繁忙得很。

text: I wonder what secret this box contains, hm?
translation: 不知道这盒子里藏着什么秘密，嗯？

text: [Reveal] With the right alchemies, you can learn the knowledge folded in their flesh. It's forbidden, of course...
translation: 揭示。凭合适的炼金术，你能学到封存于他们血肉中的知识。当然，那是被禁止的……

text: [Evade] Birds. You know how birds are.
translation: 回避。鸟而已。你知道鸟是什么德行。

text: [Think things through on my way out of the office.]
translation: 在走出办公室的路上，把事情想清楚。

text: What are my options?
translation: 我有哪些选择？

text: Coercion?
translation: 胁迫？

text: Night-work?
translation: 夜活？

text: The other kind of night-work?
translation: 另一种夜活？

text: Simple courtesy?
translation: 以礼相待？

text: [That's everything that I might consider doing. Let's explore the Sanitarium.]
translation: 这就是我所能想到的全部选择。去探索疗养院吧。

text: Blackmail, perhaps. If I can sniff out his secrets.
translation: 敲诈，或许可行。只要我能嗅出他的秘密。

text: At night, when Aubière is gone from his office, I might be able to locate his records.
translation: 到了夜里，等奥比埃离开办公室，我也许能找到他的档案。

text: With the right tools - or the right assistance - his dreams might be open to me.
translation: 若有合适的工具——或合适的助力——他的梦境或许会向我敞开。

text: I could just co-operate with the man, as he suggested, and hope to win him round eventually.
translation: 我也可以按他的提议，同这人合作，指望最终能把他争取过来。

text: It's obviously the honourable path.
translation: 这显然是体面之道。

text: Worth a go, I suppose.
translation: 我想，值得一试。

text: Sod that for a game of soldiers.
translation: 去他妈的吧。

text: Very well. Tell me what comes to mind when I say each of these things.
translation: 很好。听我说出这些词，告诉我你各自想起什么。

text: 'The Thunderskin.'
translation: 「轰雷之皮。」

text: [HOROMACHISTRY] 'He cannot be stilled; he demands the dance; he is beaten, like a drum.'
translation: 司辰学。「他无法静止；他渴求舞蹈；他遭人敲打，如同鼓面。」

text: [Evade] Sounds dangerous.
translation: 回避。听起来很危险。

text: [Lie] 'Thunderskin?' I've never heard of it.
translation: 谎话。「轰雷之皮？」我从没听说过。

text: The Thunderskin is the Heart Relentless: the Hour that preserves.
translation: 轰雷之皮即不息之心：那位守护的司辰。

text: You are religious, I see.
translation: 看得出，你信教。

text: Very well. 'The Flowermaker.'
translation: 很好。「制花人。」

text: [HOROMACHISTRY] 'He cannot harm you; he cannot find you; he always has what you desire.'
translation: 司辰学。「他无法伤害你；他无法找到你；他总拥有你所渴望的东西。」

text: A catechism, M. Hobson?
translation: 霍布森先生，你是在背教理问答吗？

text: One more. 'Carapace Cross.'
translation: 再来一个。「介壳种。」

text: [Horomachistry] 'The Cross died not, but passed within.' They're gone, but some of them became us.
translation: 司辰学。「介壳种并未死去，而是转入内里。」他们消失了，但其中一些化作了我们。

text: [Preservation] Our blood was red... but theirs was golden.
translation: 保存术。我们的血是红的……他们的却是金色的。

text: Very well...
translation: 很好……

text: Really? You surprise me, Spencer.
translation: 是吗？你让我吃惊，斯宾塞。

text: [Done]
translation: 完成。

text: 'Hour.' You believe in these 'Hours'? These 'secret gods'?
translation: 「司辰。」你相信这些「司辰」？这些「隐秘之神」？

text: Lorem ipsum?
translation: Lorem ipsum？

text: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit - [[Skills]] - sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat...
translation: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit - [[技艺]] - sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat……

text: Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.
translation: Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.

text: Tell me about your dream. The dream of the stair.
translation: 跟我讲讲你的梦。楼梯之梦。

text: It's not the worst. But it's not much fun.
translation: 不是最糟的。但也不怎么愉快。

text: It's almost every night...
translation: 几乎每晚都会……

text: Almost every night?
translation: 几乎每晚？

text: I'm high up - very high up. There is a flight of stairs, stretching down into the dark. It is light by torches. Someone will come. I will guard against them...
translation: 我在高处——很高的地方。有一段楼梯，向下延伸进黑暗。火把照亮着它。会有人来。我得防着他们……

text: When I've spent the day as my outer self, I don't dream about it.
translation: 当我以「外在的我」度过一整天，便不会梦见它。

text: 'Your outer self'. We will talk more about that later. But for now, tell me the dream.
translation: 「你的外在自我。」这个我们稍后再详谈。眼下，先讲那个梦。

text: Which is the worst?
translation: 哪个最糟？

text: The dream of the wood. I don't like the dark.
translation: 树林之梦。我不喜欢黑暗。

text: The dream of worms. [Shudder]
translation: 蠕虫之梦。打了个寒颤。

text: We will need to speak of it later. But let's not make you suffer today. It is such a lovely morning... tell me about the dream of the stair.
translation: 我们改日再谈它。今天就不让你受罪了。多么可爱的早晨……给我讲讲楼梯之梦吧。

text: Hélas; my little sin is exposed.
translation: 唉；我的小罪过败露了。

text: Then you don't provide any... little luxuries... for Strathcoyne?
translation: 这么说，你从不为斯特拉斯科因提供任何……小小的奢侈……？

text: [Aubière draws a slip of printed paper from his pocket and passes it to me.] Here is the proof of it. Now. I propose to put this sordid matter behind us. I look forward to speaking of happier things.
translation: 奥比埃从口袋里掏出一张印刷纸条，递给我。这就是证据。现在，我提议把这桩不光彩的事抛到脑后。我盼着谈些更愉快的事。

text: We'll see.
translation: 走着瞧。

text: So...
translation: 那么……

text: Do you ever make use of the black market, Doctor?
translation: 医生，你可曾用过黑市？

text: 'Black market'. It's a diffuse concept, is it not? Of course one makes certain... informal transactions. But nothing that would interest the authorities.
translation: 「黑市。」这是个含混的概念，不是吗？当然，人难免会做某些……非正式的买卖。但绝无会让当局感兴趣的事。

text: I see. Never mind, then.
translation: 我明白了。那就算了。

text: À bientôt.
translation: 回头见。

text: Cut it out, Aubière. You're taking back-handers from Strathcoyne to get him Cuban cigars.
translation: 别装了，奥比埃。你从斯特拉斯科因那儿收好处费，替他搞古巴雪茄。

text: [Say nothing; place a cigar carefully on Aubière's desk; shake my head regretfully.]
translation: 一言不发；把一支雪茄轻轻放在奥比埃的桌上；遗憾地摇摇头。

text: Aubière picks up the cigar and runs it under his nose, smiling his smile of scrupulous cleanness.
translation: 奥比埃拿起雪茄，放到鼻下嗅了嗅，露出他那副一丝不苟的干净笑容。

text: But it is a such a little sin, is it not, M. Hobson? I hardly think you would wish to waste the time of the police with this. And I am a man of some standing in Antibes.
translation: 可这是多么微小的罪过，不是吗，霍布森先生？我想，你总不至于想为这点事浪费警察的时间。何况，我在昂蒂布也算有些声望。

text: But your Incorporate masters might take a dim view of your private operations.
translation: 但你的集团主子们，怕是会对你的私下勾当大为不满。

text: A very little sin. And I'm sorry that I've come to you in this sordid way. Tell me what I need to know, and we need never speak of it again.
translation: 一个非常微小的罪过。我也抱歉，以这般不光彩的方式来找你。告诉我我想知道的，我们便再也不用提起此事。

text: [Fold my arms, remain impassive.]
translation: 抱起双臂，不动声色。

text: [Sigh regretfully, shrug more regretfully, wait.]
translation: [遗憾地叹口气,更遗憾地耸耸肩,然后等着。]

text: Very well. [[Nina Lagasse]]?
translation: 那好吧。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]?

text: [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: [[Nina Lagasse]]. And whatever cash you might have in that desk of yours.
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]。还有你那张书桌里可能放着的现钞。

text: [Dr Aubière's smile falters; it becomes tinged with sorrow. But he opens a drawer and places a crisp wad of notes on to the desk.] There. As to the other matter...
translation: [奥比埃医生的笑容微微僵住,染上一丝哀色。但他还是拉开抽屉,把一沓崭新的钞票放到桌上。]钱在这。至于另一件事……

text: Mlle Lagasse travels with a circus. She left it to come here; she left here to catch up with it. The name of the circus was Rosa Mundi, and its next destination was the city of Mimata. That is as much as I know.
translation: 拉加斯小姐跟着一个马戏团四处巡游。她离开马戏团来到此地;离开此地,是为了赶回去。那马戏团名叫罗莎·蒙迪,下一站是米玛塔城。我所知道的,仅此而已。

text: Of course, Doctor. I'm sorry to have troubled you.
translation: 当然,医生。打扰您了,抱歉。

text: [Smile nastily.]
translation: [不怀好意地笑了笑。]

text: [Smile enigmatically.]
translation: [高深莫测地笑了笑。]

text: M. Hobson, I have lost a trinket. A little silver coin I'm certain it was on my desk when we spoke. Do you know what might possibly have happened to it?
translation: 霍布森先生,我丢了件小玩意儿。一枚小小的银币,我记得咱们说话的时候它还放在我桌上。你知道它可能上哪儿去了吗?

text: Come now, doctor. I have my quirks, but I've never been a petty thief. [Smile amiably.]
translation: 得了吧,医生。我确实有些怪癖,但从来不做小偷小摸的事。[和气地笑了笑。]

text: [Bristle Englishly] Really? [Pause] Really!
translation: [摆出英国人的派头]真的?[顿了顿]真的!

text: Interesting. An effect of the Wars, you know. As the onteiric order crumbles, it becomes much easier to lose things. I'm astonished I have any socks left at , for instance.
translation: 有意思。战争的效应,你知道。太虚的秩序一旦崩解,丢东西就容易得多。我倒很惊讶自己现在还能剩几双袜子呢,比如说。

text: Humm. I'm sorry to have troubled you. I'm sure it's somewhere. It's probably somewhere.
translation: 唔。打扰你了,抱歉。肯定在什么地方。大概在什么地方吧。

text: Humm. I suppose we'll see.
translation: 唔。我想我们总会知道的。

text: [Return the silver spintria.]I apologise. I submitted to an ignoble impulse.
translation: [归还那枚银币。]我道歉。我屈从于一念之鄙。

text: [Shrug.]
translation: [耸耸肩。]

text: Humm.
translation: 唔。

text: Oh! Well. Thank you. It is forgotten.
translation: 哦!好吧。谢谢你。这事就翻篇了。

text: Was there anything else?
translation: 还有别的事吗?

text: What shall we talk about today?
translation: 我们今天聊点什么?

text: An acquaintance...
translation: 一个旧识……

text: [[Nina Lagasse]]. Again.
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]。还是她。

text: I have reconsidered, Monsieur Hobson. I am ready to tell you where you might find her.
translation: 我重新考虑过了,霍布森先生。我准备告诉你去哪儿找她。

text: Really?
translation: 真的?

text: Mm.
translation: 唔。

text: I wonder - I wonder if you find it comforting, perhaps. I mean that in these times, all of us must make hard choices - decisions about where to take our lives. While you are so fixated on Mme Lagasse, you do not need to consider other matters. You are like a questing knight, perhaps, freed from the quotidian.
translation: 我在想——我在想,这或许令你安心。我的意思是,在这年月,我们谁都得做出艰难的选择——决定要把人生带向何方。而当你如此专注地追着拉加斯夫人,就不必再考虑别的事了。你就像一位行侠的骑士,也许,摆脱了尘世的琐屑。

text: For the time being, I think we have said all there is to say on that matter.
translation: 就眼下而言,我想这件事我们已经把话都说完了。

text: 'A questing knight. Yes. I like that.
translation: “一位行侠的骑士。”不错。我喜欢这个说法。

text: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。

text: I don't want to answer that just now.
translation: 我现在不想回答这个。

text: I suppose. In a sense.
translation: 也许吧。在某种意义上。

text: Very well.
translation: 好吧。

text: I see. [He makes a note.]
translation: 我明白了。[他记了一笔。]

text: What a lot of tripe psychiatrists talk.
translation: 精神病医生净说些废话。

text: [Aubière gives a deep, sigh. His usual composure flickers.]
translation: [奥比埃深深叹了口气。他惯常的镇定闪烁了一下。]

text: Really. You have proven your goodwill and your reliability. And I am ashamed of the small - but shabby - trick that I have played on you.
translation: 说实话。你已证明了自己的善意和可靠。而我为自己对你耍的那个小把戏——卑劣却无伤大雅——感到羞愧。

text: I must be frank. You have brought disharmony to my house. Your presence here makes it increasingly difficult to concentrate on more important business.
translation: 我得直说。你给我的宅院带来了不谐。你的在场,让我愈发难以专心处理更要紧的事务。

text: [Chuckle, smugly.]
translation: [得意地轻笑了几声。]

text: [Remain silent.]
translation: [保持沉默。]

text: I see your point. I regret it. But some men are simply not suited to each other's company.
translation: 我明白你的意思。很遗憾。但有些人就是合不来,仅此而已。

text: Yes. This. Exactly. So I am going to tell you where I will find your Lagasse. And I hope that you will no longer trouble my affairs.
translation: 是的。正是。正因如此,我打算告诉你到哪儿去找你的拉加斯。希望从今往后,你不再搅扰我的事务。

text: Count on it.
translation: 放心。

text: I promise nothing.
translation: 我什么也不保证。

text: Mlle Lagasse travels with a circus. She left it to come here; she left here to catch up with it. The name of the circus was Rosa Mundi, and its next destination was the city of Mimata. That is as much as I know.
translation: 拉加斯小姐跟着一个马戏团四处巡游。她离开马戏团来到此地;离开此地,是为了赶回去。那马戏团名叫罗莎·蒙迪,下一站是米玛塔城。我所知道的,仅此而已。

text: You may leave now, Monsieur Hobson. I very much hope that you will. Good day.
translation: 你现在可以走了,霍布森先生。我非常希望你会走。日安。

text: [Aubière nods minimally, and returns to his work.]
translation: [奥比埃微微点了点头,又回去忙他的工作。]

text: Mlle Lagasse travels with a circus. She left it to come here; she left here to catch up with it. The name of the circus was Rosa Mundi, and its next destination was the city of Mimata. That is as much as I know.
translation: 拉加斯小姐跟着一个马戏团四处巡游。她离开马戏团来到此地;离开此地,是为了赶回去。那马戏团名叫罗莎·蒙迪,下一站是米玛塔城。我所知道的,仅此而已。

text: I imagine you will wish to leave without further delay. But I hope that you will return. You are an interesting man. I speak professionally, and otherwise.
translation: 我猜你会希望尽快离开,不再耽搁。但我希望你能回来。你是个有趣的人。这话出于职业立场,也出于别的。

text: Thank you, Dr Aubière. But I doubt our paths will cross again.
translation: 多谢,奥比埃医生。但我看咱们以后不会再见了。

text: [Nod; leave.]
translation: [点头;告辞。]

text: And you, Dr Aubière. I hope we will meet again.
translation: 你也保重,奥比埃医生。希望咱们后会有期。

text: Something I've seen.
translation: 我见过一样东西。

text: Go on.
translation: 说下去。

text: There's a painting of the Mansus on open display in your library.
translation: 你的图书馆里,公开挂着一幅漫宿的画。

text: Never mind.
translation: 没什么。

text: The Mansus! A particularly fascinating symbology-superstition. And psychologically potent. Extremely potent.
translation: 漫宿!一种格外引人入胜的象征-迷信。而且心理效力极强。极强。

text: You are right to identify a certain risk to the fragile psyche - even when we have of course discarded the esoteric myths around the symbol. But fire also is perilous, no? And we keep fire in our library. Safely behind a grate.
translation: 你说得对,要看出这对脆弱心灵的某种风险——哪怕我们当然已经摈弃了围绕这象征的神秘传说。但火也危险,不是吗?可我们照样在图书馆里生火。安安全全地待在壁炉栏栅后面。

text: Didn't the painting come from Hush House?
translation: 那幅画不是来自噤声居屋吗?

text: Hm.
translation: 唔。

text: It is possible? Hush House is a private library, is it not, in England? The patrons of this institution have connections with other institutions of learning - especially those that deal in onteirological matters.
translation: 有可能吗?噤声居屋是座私人图书馆,对吧,在英格兰?本院的赞助人跟其他学府有些联系——尤其是那些治梦学的机构。

text: That painting - the mountain lake - looks a lot like one I saw in Hush House. Long ago now.
translation: 那幅画——山间湖泊——很像我在噤声居屋见过的一幅。那已经是很久以前的事了。

text: Indeed? As I recall, one of the Librarians there claimed the gift of 'prefiguration'. That is to say - he produced works that he attributed to others - but before those others had in fact produced those works. An interesting case. Psychologically, and perhaps otherwise.
translation: 是吗?据我所知,那里的某位馆员自称拥有“预言”之能。就是说——他创作的作品,署的是别人的名字——却在那些别人真的创作出那些作品之前。一个有趣的案例。从心理学上讲,也许,还有别的方面。

text: Yes, exactly. It's signed by Levinsen - the prefiguring Librarian.
translation: 对,正是。署着列文森的名字——那位会预言的馆员。

text: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

text: So interesting! Then, I wonder, should we call this the original? Or only a prophetic falsehood? Thank you, Monsieur Hobson. I will regale my other visitors with this little morsel.
translation: 真有意思!那么,我在想,我们该把它称作原作?还是仅仅一件预言的赝品?谢谢你,霍布森先生。我会拿这个小逸闻去款待其他访客。

text: Yes - you had said as much.
translation: 是的——您之前已经说过类似的话了。

text: It's quite a coincidence, isn't it? Two paintings here, both from a distant English institution? And a collection of ornaments, chosen to continue the theme?
translation: 这巧合未免太巧了,不是吗?两幅画,都出自英格兰那家遥远的学府?还有一套陈设,专挑这个主题往下续?

text: It is. But do you mean to suggest, perhaps, that I am concealing something from you in this matter?
translation: 是巧。但你是想说,或许,我在这件事上对你有所隐瞒?

text: Yes. I suggest you tell me the truth, Doctor.
translation: 是。我劝你把真相告诉我,医生。

text: Of course not, Doctor.
translation: 当然没有,医生。

text: [Aubière briefly removes his glasses to polish them. When he replaces them, his eyes seem sharper.]
translation: [奥比埃摘下眼镜擦了擦。再戴上时,他的眼神似乎更锐利了。]

text: I have concealed nothing from you. The circles in which we both move - the same matters occur, and co-occur. And this institution - indeed, this building itself - benefits from certain parallels to your [[Hush House]]. Some, I will be frank, beyond my understanding.
translation: 我对你什么都没隐瞒。我们彼此活动的圈子里——同样的事一再发生,交相发生。而本院——说实在的,连这栋房子本身——得益于与你的[[噤声居屋]]的某些相似。其中一些,老实说,超出我的理解。

text: That is all. If there is a deeper design, it is hidden from me also. You have my word on it.
translation: 就这些。若说背后还有更深的设计,那对我同样隐而不见。我以名誉担保。

text: You're a liar, Aubière.
translation: 你撒谎,奥比埃。

text: Your word is enough for me, Doctor.
translation: 医生,你的话,我信。

text: It is a regrettable thing you have said. I do not wish to speak further on the matter. Pray give me a moment to compose myself.
translation: 你这话说得令人遗憾。这件事我不想再谈了。请容我平复一下心绪。

text: I appreciate that. I will not always be frank with you, you know. But I will always try.
translation: 我领这份情。你知道,我不会总是对你开诚布公。但我会一直尽力。

text: [Withdraw, for the moment.]
translation: [暂且告退。]

text: [END] Nothing more for now, Doctor.
translation: [结束]现在没什么别的事了,医生。

text: ...no-one, actually.
translation: ……其实,没谁。

text: No. This is important business. I wouldn't waste my time on it otherwise.
translation: 不。这是要紧事。不然我才不会在这上面浪费时间。

text: The shelves in the living room. A number of the items in the collection have some relationship with Cornwall - even, specifically, with Brancrug, and with Hush House?
translation: 客厅里的那些搁架。藏品里有不少东西跟康沃尔有渊源——甚至,具体说,跟布兰库格、跟噤声居屋有关?

text: Oh? That's odd.
translation: 哦?那倒是怪了。

text: In candour, I chose very little of what you see beyond my office. Our patrons provided tasteful and suitable appointments for the rooms.
translation: 说句实话,我办公室以外的陈设,几乎没一件是我挑的。赞助人们为各间屋子提供了品味高雅、得体的摆设。

text: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗?

text: Rodia Vlachou.
translation: 罗迪娅·弗拉胡。

text: Fraser Strathcoyne.
translation: 弗雷泽·斯特拉斯科因。

text: The Lantern-long upstairs.
translation: 楼上那位灯之长生者。

text: Vincent.
translation: 文森特。

text: Mathis.
translation: 马蒂斯。

text: We are privileged to have an artist of Mme Vlachou's stature as our guest.
translation: 能有弗拉胡夫人这样的艺术家做我们的客人,是我们的荣幸。

text: The cat in the living room.
translation: 客厅里那只猫。

text: It came with Mlle Lagasse. But when she left, it stayed.
translation: 那是拉加斯小姐带来的。但她走的时候,猫留了下来。

text: Doesn't she like cats?
translation: 她不喜欢猫吗?

text: Like a curse?
translation: 像一道诅咒?

text: Like a spy?
translation: 像一个探子?

text: A man of culture. We play chess sometimes: I hope you might join our games.
translation: 一位有格调的人。我们偶尔下棋:希望你能来对弈几局。

text: Yes. Wiser not to discuss her, even during daylight. And especially not to mention her name.
translation: 是的。明智的做法是不要谈起她,哪怕是在白天。尤其不要提起她的名字。

text: Will she recover?
translation: 她会痊愈吗?

text: Will he recover?
translation: 他会痊愈吗?

text: 'Dr Sinombre'?
translation: “西诺姆布尔医生”?

text: 'Silence is silver.'
translation: “沉默是金。”

text: [He winces, as if I'd said something crude.]
translation: [他皱了一下眉,仿佛我说了什么粗鄙的话。]

text: Bessy.
translation: 贝茜。

text: If you ever learn a way to be certain what Mlle Lagasse likes... do please share it with me.
translation: 如果你哪天弄明白拉加斯小姐喜欢什么……务必也告诉我一声。

text: I am afraid that might in fact have been her intention. The animal is difficult to anticipate. It often interrupts my sessions with its... opinions. Even through two thicknesses of door.
translation: 恐怕那正是它的本意。这畜生难以预料。它常拿它的……意见打断我的诊疗。隔着两层门板都拦不住。

text: As payment?
translation: 作为报酬?

text: Mlle Lagasse settled her bill in full. Perhaps the animal was intended as lagniappe.
translation: 拉加斯小姐的账是全额结清的。也许这畜生是当小添头留下的。

text: You are recalling folk-tales and fairy-stories in which an animal is recruited as a spy.
translation: 你是想到了那些民间故事和童话吧,里面总有动物被招募去做探子。

text: But it is too stubborn to leave. I suspect Bessy of feeding it.
translation: 可它太犟,怎么都不肯走。我怀疑是贝茜在喂它。

text: The world, I grant you, has changed. More things are possible that once were not.
translation: 世界,我承认,是变了。从前不可能的事,如今更多了。

text: But, sincerely, I doubt it has the wits to be a spy.
translation: 但说真的,我怀疑它有没有当探子的脑子。

text: If that is so, I wish she had been less generous.
translation: 若果真如此,我倒希望她别这么大方。

text: Rich, too.
translation: 而且还阔绰。

text: I suppose.
translation: 算是吧。

text: A difficult term to define, where the [[Cross]]-nature manifests. Perhaps better to say that he will advance.
translation: 一个难以定义的说法,尤其当[[介壳种]]本性显现时。或许更妥当的说法是,他将继续前行。

text: She has Icarian sympathies. This place, I think, is touched by the Incorporates. Is there any... friction?
translation: 她有伊加利亚主义的同情倾向。这个地方,我觉得,沾染着集团的气息。可有什么……龃龉吗?

text: I should not discuss the health of other guests. But I can say that there is some reason for optimism.
translation: 我不该谈论其他客人的健康状况。但我可以说,有理由乐观。

text: This is a place of healing and refuge, M. Hobson. A house of science.
translation: 这是处疗愈与庇护之所,霍布森先生。一栋科学的宅邸。

text: Is she a patient, or an experimental subject?
translation: 她是病人,还是实验对象?

text: Commendable.
translation: 可敬。

text: I find it more fruitful not to limit myself to narrowly binary ontologies.
translation: 我发现,不把自己局限在狭隘的二元本体论里,更有收获。

text: Orderlies come and go.
translation: 护工们来来去去。

text: A charming young woman with, I dare say, unsuspected depths.
translation: 一位迷人的年轻女子,我敢说,藏着出人意料的深邃。

text: She's staff, or a patient, or...?
translation: 她是职员,还是病人,还是……?

text: As you say.
translation: 就依您所言。

text: General chatter
translation: 闲谈

text: [Exit]
translation: [离开]

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: The doctor observes my dressing gown.
translation: 医生打量起我的睡袍。

text: He makes a note.
translation: 他记了一笔。

text: Interesting. Did you wear this to offer defiance, perhaps? Or is it a token of intimacy?
translation: 有意思。你穿这个,是为了挑衅,也许?还是亲昵的凭证?

text: [Yawn rudely.]
translation: [粗鲁地打了个哈欠。]

text: [Smile encouragingly.]
translation: [鼓励地笑了笑。]

text: [Wink saucily.]
translation: [俏皮地眨了眨眼。]

text: He makes another note.
translation: 他又记了一笔。

text: A dreamily smiling, dreamily humming woman in horn-rimmed glasses. Delicious scents waft from the kitchen behind her: ham, onions.
translation: 一位戴着玳瑁框眼镜的女子,笑意迷离,哼着歌。她身后厨房里飘来诱人的香气:火腿,洋葱。

text: Word gets around.
translation: 消息传得快。

text: Hi, Spence. What's the scene?!
translation: 嗨,斯宾塞。什么风把你吹来了?!

text: My name is Spencer Hobson. 'Mr Hobson', if you can't manage that.
translation: 我的名字叫斯宾塞·霍布森。“霍布森先生”,你要是叫不全的话。

text: (Cube.)
translation: (方头。)

text: Sure, man, whatever floats.
translation: 行啊,老兄,随你便。

text: [Resolve not to have heard that.]
translation: [打定主意没听见那句话。]

text: What did you say to me?
translation: 你刚才对我说什么?

text: Just... kinda... okay. Sorry, Mr Hobson. Sure.
translation: 就……有点……好吧。对不住,霍布森先生。成。

text: Mis-ter Hobson. Hi.
translation: 霍布森先生。嗨。

text: Spencer, right? I'm Bessy. What's shaking?
translation: 斯宾塞,对吧?我是贝茜。近来可好?

text: You know my name?
translation: 你知道我的名字?

text: Does everyone here know who I am already?
translation: 这里所有人都已经知道我是谁了?

text: You hungry? This omelette... I think I went too far. It's really two omelettes. Maybe three. I'm going to need some help.
translation: 饿不饿?这份煎蛋卷……我觉得我摊过头了。实际上这是两份蛋卷。也许三份。我需要帮手。

text: I'm fine, Bessy, thank you.
translation: 我没事,贝茜,谢谢。

text: Ravenous.
translation: 饿坏了。

text: A little.
translation: 有一点。

text: Western omelette, coming up.
translation: 西式蛋卷,这就来。

text: Something smells wonderful.
translation: 好香啊。

text: [Wary] ...I'll eat later.
translation: [警惕地]……我待会儿再吃。

text: The omelette is excellent. Fresh eggs, peppers, ham: all of those are difficult to come by.
translation: 煎蛋卷美味极了。鲜蛋、甜椒、火腿:这些如今可都不好弄到。

text: Suit yourself. I'll battle this monster alone.
translation: 随你便。我自己对付这头怪兽。

text: Bessy eats with surprising enthusiasm. She talks with her mouth full. She even hums with her mouth full, or she taps her fingers to the rhythm - always variations on the same swinging, gentle tune.
translation: 贝茜吃得热情得惊人。她嘴里塞满食物还说话。嘴里塞满食物还哼歌,要么就跟着节拍敲手指——总是同一支摇摆而轻柔的曲调的各种变奏。

text: This is really good.
translation: 真好吃。

text: You're... American?
translation: 你是……美国人?

text: Thanks, man! It's nice to cook for someone who appreciates it.
translation: 谢啦,老兄!能有人懂这份手艺,做起来才有劲。

text: The doc's a vegetarian. Rodia's always on a diet. The Strath doesn't like 'foreign food'. Though Vincent and Mat... those cats have appetites.
translation: 医生吃素。罗迪娅永远在节食。斯特拉斯科因不喜欢“外国菜”。倒是文森特和马特……那俩家伙胃口好得很。

text: Uh-huh. Half, anyhow. My mother's from Quebec. So I grew up speaking the language. I couldn't seem to get started in New York - singing, I mean - so I tried in Paris.
translation: 嗯哼。一半是,怎么都算。我妈是魁北克人。所以我从小就说这语言。我在纽约怎么都起不了步——唱歌,我是说——所以就到巴黎试试。

text: Do you work here? Or is the doctor treating you, too?
translation: 你在这儿工作?还是医生也在给你治病?

text: I dug Paris. Paris was gone! I mean, the end, you know?
translation: 我爱透了巴黎。巴黎没了!我是说,完蛋了,你懂吗?

text: Her face clouds.
translation: 她的脸色暗了下来。

text: Then, the Enemy came... and it was gone. I mean, it was the end.
translation: 然后,敌人来了……它就没了。我是说,那就是终局。

text: Different gone?
translation: 另一种没了?

text: But you stayed?
translation: 可你留下了?

text: Different gone.
translation: 另一种没了。

text: I stayed for a while. I knew Mat, I knew Mat's crowd. Me, two other girls, we were singing. We were doing okay, even then.
translation: 我留了一阵。我认识马特,认识马特那帮人。我,还有另外两个姑娘,我们一起唱歌。哪怕在那时候,我们混得也还凑合。

text: But it kept getting stickier. Then, in '43, I came south. After - after -
translation: 可日子越来越难熬。然后,43年,我南下。在——在——

text: Hey. You mind if we talk about something else?
translation: 嘿。咱们换点别的聊聊,不介意吧?

text: Work. I guess you could say I came with the place? Audrey - Audrey Chadwick - Audrey owns the villa. I knew her pretty well, back home.
translation: 工作。我猜你可以说,我是随房子一起来的?奥德丽——奥德丽·查德威克——奥德丽是这别墅的主人。在家乡,我跟她挺熟。

text: I called her when I came down here from Paris. She let me know where to pick up the keys. Told me to keep an eye on the place.
translation: 我从巴黎下来的时候给她打了电话。她告诉我去哪儿拿钥匙。让我照看着这地方。

text: Then the doc's people leased it from her. But Audrey told them I could stay as long as I liked.
translation: 后来医生那边的人从她手里租了下来。但奥德丽跟他们说了,我想待多久都行。

text: Decent of her.
translation: 她人真不错。

text: The doc's people?
translation: 医生那边的人?

text: Yeah. Audrey's cool.
translation: 是啊。奥德丽人很酷。

text: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。

text: I should go. Thanks for the omelette, Bessy.
translation: 我该走了。谢谢你的蛋卷,贝茜。

text: Any time!
translation: 随时都行!

text: Some kind of Incorporate foundation? Menninger, maybe? Graveyard, man. I don't know.
translation: 某种集团的基金会?曼宁格那样的,也许?公墓呗,老兄。我不知道。

text: Later.
translation: 改日再说。

text: What it is.
translation: 就是这么回事。

text: [Nod.]
translation: [点头。]

text: What it is. [Bessy nods, smiling, humming.]
translation: 就是这么回事。[贝茜点点头,笑着,哼着歌。]

text: Uh... [Bessy, confused, looks around, spotting a coffee-pot behind her.]
translation: 呃……[贝茜一脸困惑,环顾四周,看见身后有个咖啡壶。]

text: It's a coffee-pot?
translation: 是个咖啡壶?

text: What it is.
translation: 就是这么回事。

text: Bessy... I'm looking for someone who stayed here. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 贝茜……我在找一个曾住在这里的人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: Nina!
translation: 尼娜!

text: Nina was sunset. [Bessy shakes her head in admiration.]
translation: 尼娜可是落日啊。[贝茜赞叹地摇了摇头。]

text: Bessy, can you talk like an adult, just for now? Where did she go?
translation: 贝茜,你就不能像大人一样说话吗,就现在?她上哪儿去了?

text: Sunset is good?
translation: 落日是好的意思?

text: Sunset is something.
translation: 落日是了不得。

text: Sunset is bad?
translation: 落日是不好的意思?

text: Sunset. [Smile broadly.]
translation: 落日。[咧嘴一笑。]

text: Bessy dimples.
translation: 贝茜露出酒窝。

text: Bessy looks briefly wary.
translation: 贝茜的神色短暂地警惕起来。

text: Yeah, she was here. She left pretty suddenly. I think she got what she needed from the doc.
translation: 嗯,她住过这儿。她走得挺突然。我觉得她从医生那儿得到了需要的东西。

text: Whatever you say, Mister Hobson.
translation: 您怎么说都行,霍布森先生。

text: [A smiling humming shrug.]
translation: [笑着哼着歌耸了耸肩。]

text: She came, she stayed, she left. I think she got what she wanted.
translation: 她来了,她住下了,她走了。我觉得她得到了想要的东西。

text: Thanks, Bessy.
translation: 谢谢,贝茜。

text: [Sigh impatiently.]
translation: [不耐烦地叹了口气。]

text: Hey. What's your thing with her? Why are you looking?
translation: 嘿。你跟她是怎么回事?为什么找她?

text: [Truth] Let's say I'm following my heart.
translation: [真话]就当我是在跟随内心吧。

text: That's my affair, and none of yours.
translation: 那是我的私事,与你无关。

text: Well, okay.
translation: 行吧,随你。

text: Sorry, Bessy. I don't know you well enough.
translation: 抱歉,贝茜。我还不够了解你。

text: Oh, hey, it's cool. We've all got our secrets.
translation: 哦,嘿,没事。谁都有秘密。

text: [Truth] Feels right. I haven't thought too much about it.
translation: [真话] 感觉对。我没怎么细想过。

text: [Lie] She owes me a great deal of money.
translation: [谎言] 她欠了我一大笔钱。

text: Oh, wow. Wow. Okay.
translation: 哦,哇。哇。好吧。

text: Ha, okay. Funny thing? That's how I felt about coming here.
translation: 哈,好吧。有意思的是?我当初来这儿,也是这种感觉。

text: My last name's Bloom. But I didn't go by Bloom, you know? Not for a while there.
translation: 我姓布卢姆。但我不叫布卢姆,你知道吗?好一阵子不用了。

text: Is that another one of your omelettes?
translation: 那又是你的煎蛋卷?

text: What can I say? It's a habit. Interested?
translation: 我能说什么呢?习惯罢了。感兴趣?

text: Very.
translation: 非常。

text: If I'm not imposing...
translation: 如果我不打扰的话……

text: Later, perhaps.
translation: 改日再说吧。

text: You kidding? I can't do this alone.
translation: 开什么玩笑?这种事我一个人可干不来。

text: Let's do this.
translation: 动手吧。

text: Fresh eggs, peppers, ham: rare treasures combined by a woman of real talent.
translation: 鲜蛋、甜椒、火腿:一位真正有天赋的女人,把难得的珍宝合而为一。

text: Thanks, Bessy.
translation: 谢谢,贝茜。

text: [Wipe my mouth and push the plate away.]
translation: [擦擦嘴,推开盘子。]

text: Any time!
translation: 随时都行!

text: Too soon, the omelette is defeated.
translation: 没过多久,煎蛋卷便败下阵来。

text: Omelette, yes, but is that... coffee?
translation: 煎蛋卷,没错,可那是……咖啡?

text: Sure. Only the good stuff here. I'll get you a cup.
translation: 当然。这儿只有好东西。我给你倒一杯。

text: [Give my full attention to the coffee.]
translation: [把全部注意力交给咖啡。]

text: The coffee is irreproachable - bitter enough to make an impression, gentle enough not to leave one.
translation: 这咖啡无可指摘——苦得足以让人记住,柔得让人记不住。

text: Much better.
translation: 好多了。

text: Okay! Hungry, too?
translation: 好嘞!也饿了吗?

text: The cat's eyes fix upon me. Its stare is at once both terrified and indignant.
translation: 猫的眼睛定在我身上。那目光既惊恐,又愤慨。

text: (Charming little creature.)
translation: (迷人的小东西。)

text: (I'm a dog person, really.)
translation: (其实我是爱狗之人。)

text: (They let this thing run loose? Well, if I don't get too close, it probably can't attack.)
translation: (他们让这东西到处乱跑?好吧,只要我别靠太近,它大概伤不了我。)

text: [Reach out to touch the luxuriant fur.]
translation: [伸手去摸那丰厚的皮毛。]

text: [This thing is not respectful. Frighten it away.]
translation: [这东西不懂规矩。把它吓走。]

text: [Maintain a safe distance.]
translation: [保持安全距离。]

text: Mrrrp.
translation: 喵呜。

text: The cat suffers my touch, although no purr is forthcoming. The fur is very soft. The eyes are quite mad.
translation: 猫容忍了我的抚摸,尽管并未发出呼噜声。毛非常柔软。那双眼睛相当疯狂。

text: [Move on.]
translation: [继续走。]

text: Once again, the cat suffers my touch; once again, no purr is forthcoming; but it seems a little less wary.
translation: 猫再一次容忍我的抚摸;再一次没有呼噜声;但它似乎稍稍不那么警惕了。

text: Mrrowr!!
translation: 喵呜!!

text: The cat leaps, skids, scrambles away in a tangled paroxysm of terror. It finds refuge on the top of the piano, staring warily from wide, resentful eyes.
translation: 猫跳起,打滑,在一团纠缠的恐惧痉挛中连滚带爬地逃窜。它躲到钢琴顶上,睁着圆瞪的、怨恨的眼睛警惕地望来。

text: Mrrowp?
translation: 喵呜?

text: Evidently the cat recognises me.
translation: 显然,猫认出了我。

text: Mrrowr.
translation: 喵呜。

text: The cat watches me with unblinking suspicion.
translation: 猫一眨不眨地、满含猜疑地望着我。

text: That'll teach it.
translation: 这算给它个教训。

text: [Move on to other things.]
translation: [去做别的事。]

text: The cat remains motionless on the sofa.
translation: 猫在沙发上一动不动。

text: The cat remains safely out of reach on the piano's summit.
translation: 猫安然待在钢琴顶上,让人够不着。

text: Mrrowp.
translation: 喵呜。

text: This is how such a cat would prefer to be touched.
translation: 这样才是这种猫喜欢的摸法。

text: [Ignore the animal.]
translation: [别理会这只动物。]

text: Beneath the chin, for instance. And the absurd, magnificent chest-ruff also requires attention.
translation: 比如下巴底下。还有那团荒唐又华美的胸毛,也需要照料。

text: No no. The ears, apparently, are not for us to touch.
translation: 不不。耳朵,显然,不是给我们摸的。

text: [Yes, this is clearly acceptable. Quite acceptable.]
translation: [对,这显然可以。相当可以。]

text: [Renew diplomatic ties.]
translation: [续建外交关系。]

text: [The cat does not let down its guard. The eyes continue to blaze like frightened head-lights at night. But we have established diplomatic relations.]
translation: [猫没有放松警惕。那双眼睛仍像夜里惊恐的车头灯般灼灼燃烧。但我们确立了外交关系。]

text: Prrp.
translation: 咕噜。

text: [The Hobson-Cat detente is affirmed by both sides, and may continue.]
translation: [霍布森与猫之间的缓和,得到了双方的确认,或可长续。]

text: The door behind me, m'sieu.
translation: 门在我身后,先生。

text: Excuse me.
translation: 失陪了。

text: [Grunt vaguely.]
translation: [含糊地哼一声。]

text: You're very annoying.
translation: 你真烦人。

text: [The most Gallic of shrugs]
translation: [一个最法兰西式的耸肩]

text: [Step back.]
translation: [退后一步。]

text: Oh, that door!
translation: 哦,那扇门!

text: That door! I must get my eyes examined.
translation: 那扇门!我该去检查检查眼睛了。

text: Haven't you got anywhere else to go?
translation: 你就没有别的地方可去吗?

text: I might ask you the same, m'sieu.
translation: 我也想这么问您,先生。

text: Fair point.
translation: 说得在理。

text: [Growl.]
translation: [低吼一声。]

text: I'm looking for [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: I need to speak with the Director.
translation: 我要见院长。

text: I'm expected.
translation: 有人等着见我。

text: Lagasse. Of course.
translation: 拉加斯。当然。

text: Then you must surely have an appointment.
translation: 那您想必有预约。

text: I need no appointment. My business is of the highest importance.
translation: 我不需要预约。我要办的事至关重要。

text: Tell me your name.
translation: 报上你的名字。

text: [Show British passport] My name is Spencer Hobson.
translation: [出示英国护照] 我叫斯宾塞·霍布森。

text: [Show French passport] Sylvain Huissier.
translation: [出示法国护照] 西尔万·韦西耶。

text: [The big man dangles the passport from one corner between finger and thumb. He inspects it without interest.]
translation: [大汉用拇指和食指捏着护照一角,让它悬着。他毫无兴致地检视它。]

text: This is not the Republic. Your papers are worthless.
translation: 这里不是共和国。你的证件一文不值。

text: This is becoming tiresome. I'm not a man you want to cross. Take me to the Director.
translation: 这可越来越让人生厌了。我可不是你想招惹的人。带我去见院长。

text: Please, monsieur. I'm sorry to be a nuisance, but I really only need a moment of his time. And I don't want to waste any more of yours. [Offer my warmest smile.]
translation: 求您了,先生。抱歉打扰您,但我真的只需要他片刻时间。我也不想再浪费您的时间。[献上我最热诚的微笑。]

text: [The big man folds his arms. He neither moves nor changes expression.]
translation: [大汉抱起双臂。他不动,表情也不变。]

text: But now she is gone.
translation: 但她如今不在了。

text: Where?
translation: 去哪儿?

text: You strike me as a man who understands the value of his time. Let me put a number to that value. [20 francisques]
translation: 我看您是懂得自己时间价值的人。让我给这价值标一个数。[20 法兰西斧币]

text: The Director might know. I do not. This is not a library. It is not a bureau of information.
translation: 院长或许知道。我不知道。这里不是图书馆,也不是情报处。

text: [The big man softens, just a little. It is after all a golden kind of afternoon.]
translation: [大汉缓和了一些,只有一点点。毕竟这是个金光灿灿的下午。]

text: Then I'd like to speak to the Director.
translation: 那我还是要和院长谈谈。

text: [I hold the big man's gaze steadily. He gnaws at the inside of his cheek, suddenly uneasy.]
translation: [我稳稳地迎上大汉的目光。他咬起脸颊内侧,忽然有些不安。]

text: I will know who you are, and what you're doing here.
translation: 我会弄清楚你是谁,以及你在这里做什么。

text: [The big man folds the money away with an air of complacent virtue. He is pleased, clearly, that the value of his time has been recognised.]
translation: [大汉带着一副自得的美德气派,把钱收了起来。显然他很满意,自己时间的价值终于得到了承认。]

text: [The big man scoffs.] 'I am not to be bought.' [He glances around to reassure himself that his virtue has been registered.]
translation: [大汉嗤笑一声。]『我可不是能被收买的。』[他环顾四周,好确认自己的美德已被看在眼里。]

text: [The night knows there is some small risk in sharing my name. But there may be no other way forward here.]
translation: [夜深知,说出自己的名字有些许风险。但眼下或许没有别的路可走。]

text: The Director is in his office. Over there, by the stairs.
translation: 院长在他的办公室里。那边,楼梯旁。

text: [The big man folds his arms. He neither moves nor changes expression.]
translation: [大汉抱起双臂。他不动,表情也不变。]

text: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢你。

text: Finally.
translation: 终于。

text: [Mathis steps back to let me pass.]
translation: [马蒂斯退后一步,让我过去。]

text: You have a name that opens doors, Monsieur 'obson.
translation: 您有一个能开门道的名字,奥布森先生。

text: The big man reaches out for the passport.
translation: 大汉伸手来拿护照。

text: [Let him take it.]
translation: [让他拿去。]

text: [Hold it just out of reach.]
translation: [举在他够不着的地方。]

text: [He scrutinises the passport, eyes crinkling, lips moving slightly. He hands it back to me.]
translation: [他细看护照,眼角皱起,嘴唇微微翕动。他把护照递还给我。]

text: [He scowls, but makes no attempt to snatch it. Instead he scrutinises it, eyes crinkling, lips moving slightly.]
translation: [他皱起眉,却并不来夺。他只是细看护照,眼角皱起,嘴唇微微翕动。]

text: Regrettably I have none, but I think the Director will want to see me nevertheless.
translation: 很遗憾,我没有。但我相信院长仍然会想见我。

text: Listen to the music warbling from the radio.
translation: 听收音机里婉转流出的乐声。

text: A poignant, graceful jazz piece - guitar, violin, double bass? -with a driving rhythm that somehow seems stately - almost like a waltz.
translation: 一首凄美优雅的爵士——吉他、小提琴、低音提琴?——节奏强劲,却不知为何透着庄严——几乎像一首华尔兹。

text: Is that... Reinhardt? Grappelli? I don't know it.
translation: 那是……莱因哈特?格拉佩利?我没听过这首。

text: You know Reinhardt, but you don't know 'Nuages'?
translation: 你知道莱因哈特,却不知道《云》?

text: What was it you wanted?
translation: 您想要什么来着?

text: Take time to examine the radio.
translation: 花点时间细看这台收音机。

text: Lambent brass, and black bakelite shiny as a beetle's carapace. A handsome bit of kit. And remarkably portable - less than two feet across. It's branded with a crown, and the words ZENITH TRANS-OCEANIC.
translation: 黄铜泛着柔光,黑色电木亮得像甲虫的鞘翅。一件漂亮的机子。而且出奇地便携——宽不到两英尺。上面印着一顶王冠,以及 ZENITH TRANS-OCEANIC 的字样。

text: Lambent brass, and black bakelite shiny as a beetle's carapace. A handsome bit of kit. And remarkably portable - less than two feet across.
translation: 黄铜泛着柔光,黑色电木亮得像甲虫的鞘翅。一件漂亮的机子。而且出奇地便携——宽不到两英尺。

text: I knew one of the clubs he used to play. Chez Bricktop. I've been away a long time... but you don't forget Reinhardt. This must be new?
translation: 他以前常演的俱乐部,我知道一家——布里克托普之家。我离开太久了……但莱因哈特是忘不掉的。这首一定是新作?

text: That's what I said. Is it new?
translation: 我正想问呢。是新作吗?

text: No. You don't forget Reinhardt.
translation: 不。莱因哈特是忘不掉的。

text: When the [[Enemy]] was in Paris, Reinhardt wrote this. They had little affection for swing, the Enemy. So Reinhardt was careful. So this isn't precisely swing...
translation: [[敌人]]在巴黎时,莱因哈特写了这首。敌人对摇摆乐没什么好感。所以莱因哈特很小心。所以这首并不算是严格的摇摆乐……

text: The blond man is watching me impatiently.
translation: 金发男人正不耐烦地看着我。

text: That's [[Incorporate]] manufacture. An American import. There can't be many of those in France - either the [[State]] or the [[Republic]].
translation: 那是[[集团]]的产品。美国进口货。在法国——无论是[[邦国]]还是[[共和国]]——这种东西都不会有多少。

text: A large blond gentleman in orderly's whites blocks the hallway listening to a portable radio. He raises his eyes to regard me without enthusiasm.
translation: 一位高大的金发先生穿着护理员的白衣,堵在走廊里,听着便携收音机。他抬起眼,不带热忱地打量我。

text: Some sort of jazz? Pretty.
translation: 某种爵士?不错。

text: DEBUG: EARLY EXIT
translation: DEBUG: EARLY EXIT

text: [Mathis blinks slowly in response to my curtness. With insolent deliberation, he steps back to let me pass.]
translation: [马蒂斯对我生硬的回应缓缓眨了眨眼。他带着傲慢的从容,退后一步让我过去。]

text: [Turn to the radio. Silence it with a pale phrase.]
translation: [转向收音机。用一个苍白的短句让它归于寂静。]

text: [The radio crackles, and fades abruptly to silence. The hall seems chillier. Mathis' eyes widen, and he takes a step back.]
translation: [收音机噼啪作响,骤然淡去,归于寂静。走廊似乎更冷了。马蒂斯睁大眼睛,退了一步。]

text: [The radio crackles and begins to fade... but almost immediately recovers. Mathis frowns, puzzled.]
translation: [收音机噼啪作响,开始变弱……但几乎立刻又恢复过来。马蒂斯皱着眉,一脸困惑。]

text: She makes an impression, Mlle Lagasse.
translation: 她给人留下深刻印象,拉加斯小姐。

text: The Director awaits, m'sieu.
translation: 院长在等您,先生。

text: [Bricktop's.... like a lit window across a wide river, that memory.]
translation: [布里克托普之家……那记忆,像宽阔河对岸一扇亮着灯的窗。]

text: [Onwards.]
translation: [继续前行。]

text: [Move on.]
translation: [继续走。]

text: You're back.
translation: 您回来了。

text: [Mathis does not seem excited by my return.]
translation: [马蒂斯似乎并不为我的归来而振奋。]

text: [Mathis' tone is still flat, but he meets my eyes now, almost courteously.]
translation: [马蒂斯的语气仍然平淡,但现在他会迎上我的目光,几乎称得上客气。]

text: Can you tell me about...
translation: 你能跟我说说……

text: Vincent mentioned you.
translation: 文森特提起过你。

text: Busy.
translation: 忙。

text: Very busy.
translation: 非常忙。

text: You know Vincent?
translation: 你认识文森特?

text: For a long time. We were both with the Lègion.
translation: 认识很久了。我们俩都在军团待过。

text: ...goodbye, then.
translation: ……那就再会吧。

text: ...goodbye, then. (Oaf.)
translation: ……那就再会吧。(蠢货。)

text: Vincent is all right.
translation: 文森特还行。

text: [Mathis' eyebrows rise fractionally.]
translation: [马蒂斯的眉毛微微扬起。]

text: He said I should ask you about the Rue Pigalle.
translation: 他说我该向你打听皮加勒街的事。

text: My secret is out, hein? The little follies of youth.
translation: 我的秘密败露了,嗯?年轻时的荒唐事。

text: [Unleash my most charming smile and reach to shake his hand] Thank you so much for your help earlier. I've spoken to the doctor.
translation: [绽放我最迷人的微笑,伸手去握他的手] 太感谢您之前的帮助了。我已经和医生谈过了。

text: [Under this focused beam of bonhomie, Mathis unbends very slightly.] Euh.
translation: [在这道热忱的目光之下,马蒂斯稍稍松弛了些。]呃。

text: Bah.
translation: 哼。

text: He says hello.
translation: 他向你问好。

text: Huhm.
translation: 哼。

text: We were speaking of Bricktop's, earlier. Of Django Reinhardt.
translation: 我们刚才在说布里克托普之家,说姜戈·莱因哈特。

text: They were very different, those days. Sometimes good. Always different.
translation: 那些日子大不一样。有时很好。但总是不同。

text: [No stories seem to be forthcoming. But Mathis is briefly lost in a pleasant reverie, and the atmosphere has thawed appreciately.]
translation: [似乎不会再有什么故事了。但马蒂斯短暂地陷入愉快的遐想,气氛明显回暖。]

text: We were. It was good to remember. Though I never heard Reinhardt there. He moved on, in the Occupation years. To the Roulotte.
translation: 确实。回忆是件好事。不过我从没在那儿听过莱因哈特。占领年代里,他转去了大篷车。

text: I said that the [[Enemy]] disliked swing. But not all of them. They let the Roulotte stay open late, you know? The men in grey. So they could listen to Reinhardt.
translation: 我说过[[敌人]]不喜欢摇摆乐。但并非人人如此。他们让大篷车开到很晚,你知道吗?那些穿灰衣的人。就为了能听莱因哈特。

text: My friends and I, we would get in through the kitchen, to listen. Then one of my friends drew attention from the men in grey...
translation: 我和朋友们会从厨房溜进去听。后来,我有个朋友引起了那些灰衣人的注意……

text: [Sadness creases Mathis' face]. It did not end well. I did not go back.
translation: [悲伤在马蒂斯脸上刻下皱纹]。结局并不好。我再没回去过。

text: I'm sorry.
translation: 「我很抱歉。」

text: These things happen.
translation: 这种事在所难免。

text: It was a long time ago.
translation: 那是很久以前的事了。

text: It could have been no more than four or five years ago. But the more I speak to Mathis, the younger he seems.
translation: 那或许不过四五年前的事。可我越和马蒂斯交谈,就越觉得他年轻。

text: [A long shrug.]
translation: [一个长长的耸肩。]

text: Do you mind if I ask you about someone?
translation: 介意我向你打听一个人吗?

text: About Vincent...
translation: 关于文森特……

text: About Strathcoyne...
translation: 关于斯特拉斯科因……

text: Aubière...
translation: 奥比埃……

text: [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]……

text: I know nothing.
translation: 我一无所知。

text: Vincent is all right.
translation: 文森特还行。

text: The richer the man, the harder to like. M. Strathcoyne [the name is much gallified] is very rich.
translation: 人越有钱,越难让人喜欢。斯特拉斯科因先生[这名字被法语化得厉害]非常有钱。

text: But his arm has a certain charm. Those eyes. Vincent and I, we call her 'Annabelle'.
translation: 但他那条手臂倒有几分魅力。那双眼睛。我和文森特管她叫『安娜贝尔』。

text: [Store that one away.]
translation: [把这条记下。]

text: I have nothing to say about monsieur le Directeur.
translation: 关于院长先生,我无可奉告。

text: Bessy...
translation: 贝茜……

text: Bessy is all right.
translation: 贝茜还行。

text: [A fleeting smile] She sings better than she cooks.
translation: [转瞬即逝的一笑]她唱得比做得好。

text: Sinombre...
translation: 西诺姆布尔……

text: No.
translation: 不。

text: But...
translation: 可是……

text: No?
translation: 不?

text: No.
translation: 不。

text: Rodia...
translation: 罗迪娅……

text: I don't like her records. And one is never certain, with a Greek.
translation: 我不喜欢她的唱片。况且,希腊人,你永远摸不准。

text: But I think that she is all right.
translation: 但我觉得她人还行。

text: [Casually examine a ten-francisque note] Well, look, I recognise the value of information. If you remembered anything, I would be happy to compensate you...
translation: [漫不经心地端详一张十法兰西斧币的钞票] 这么说吧,我明白情报的价值。如果你记起什么,我很乐意补偿你……

text: Pity.
translation: 可惜。

text: I don't believe you.
translation: 我不信。

text: [A long shrug.]
translation: [一个长长的耸肩。]

text: I have remembered something. [Mathis accepts the note, which disappears without fuss.]
translation: 我记起了一件事。[马蒂斯收下钞票,它不动声色地消失了。]

text: Generous. But as I have said: unhappily, I know nothing.
translation: 慷慨。但我说过了:遗憾,我一无所知。

text: The Director has a second office behind the mirror in his office, where he keeps his records.
translation: 院长在他办公室的镜子后面还有一间办公室,他的档案都收在那里。

text: I have not told you this.
translation: 这话不是我告诉你的。

text: What else?
translation: 还有呢?

text: And?
translation: 然后呢？

text: And what?
translation: 还有什么?

text: Who?
translation: 谁?

text: She sings?
translation: 她会唱歌?

text: In Paris, she sang.
translation: 在巴黎,她唱过歌。

text: She knows you?
translation: 她认识你?

text: She knew me. Yes.
translation: 她认识我。是的。

text: Young idiots.
translation: 年轻的白痴。

text: [Mathis' eyes flash with anger. But he says nothing.]
translation: [马蒂斯眼中闪过怒意。但他什么也没说。]

text: [Turn away.]
translation: [转身走开。]

text: Never mind, actually.
translation: 算了,没事。

text: Ta ta for now.
translation: 就此别过。

text: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

text: Come in, my [[pilgrim]]; let's hear all your news.
translation: 进来吧,我的[[巡礼者]];让我们听听你所有的见闻。

text: What is wrong with you, exactly? Can I catch it from you?
translation: 你到底怎么了?会传染吗?

text: [Move closer; look at the skin of her legs.]
translation: [靠近些;看她双腿的皮肤。]

text: [Bow my head and withdraw.]
translation: [低下头,退开。]

text: A new twist for our little exile knot! My name is Rodia; welcome to this house.
translation: 我们这流亡小圈子里来了新变化!我叫罗迪娅;欢迎来到这所房子。

text: Rodia's smile becomes more sardonic. She raises her skirt a little.
translation: 罗迪娅的笑容更带讥诮。她稍稍撩起裙子。

text: Does it hurt?
translation: 疼吗?

text: [Her calves are furred with mosses and spotted with lichens. Beneath that, her skin is glossy, but with dashed lines and bumps, like the bark of an olive tree. Her feet are bare: below her ankles, the effect is even more marked, and her flesh has begun to curl like roots.]
translation: [她的小腿覆着苔藓的绒毛,缀着地衣的斑点。底下,她的皮肤泛着光泽,却布满断线般的纹路和隆起,像橄榄树的树皮。她赤着脚:脚踝以下,那种变化更加明显,她的血肉已开始像根须一样卷曲。]

text: Move even closer; bend down to examine her skin in detail.
translation: 再靠近些;俯下身,细细端详她的皮肤。

text: The wood of the chair has begun to bow and twist yearningly towards the flesh of her legs... the magazine is also crinkled with green where her hand touches it.
translation: 椅子的木头已开始弯折扭转,渴望地朝她双腿的血肉倾去……她手触到的那本杂志也泛起绿意,起了皱褶。

text: The wood of the chair has begun to bow and twist yearningly towards the flesh of her legs.
translation: 椅子的木头已开始弯折扭转,渴望地朝她双腿的血肉倾去。

text: [Rodia sighs, very softly.]
translation: [罗迪娅轻轻地叹了口气。]

text: The other hand, however, the one holding her cigarette, is almost clear of greenery.
translation: 然而,另一只手——夹着香烟的那只——几乎不见草木滋生。

text: My little vice protects me, so it seems. Tobacco's poisons - so our doctor says - purge animalcules from my tainted skin... and we all know the deep wood fears the fire.
translation: 我这点小恶习,似乎护住了我。烟草的毒素——我们那位医生说的——能从我受染的皮肤上清除微生物……而众所周知,深林畏火。

text: The looking first; perhaps the listening next? One question is enough.
translation: 先是打量;接下来,兴许是聆听?一个问题,足矣。

text: How did it happen?
translation: 这是怎么发生的?

text: Do you flower?
translation: 你会开花吗?

text: My pilgrim. When a lady's seen the dawn, she's earned the right not to be questioned in on the dew. D'you follow me?
translation: 我的巡礼者。一位女士既已见过黎明,便有资格不被盘问晨露之事。你明白我的意思吗?

text: The Plague of Leaves: it came to Epirus. It took the streets, the churches, then our flesh. We fled in sorrow, or we joined the green. But some of us did not leave when we might.
translation: 叶疫:它降临伊庇鲁斯。它夺走街道、教堂,然后是我们的血肉。我们或含悲逃离,或融入那片绿意。但我们之中有些人,本该离开时却没有走。

text: The Plague of Leaves? Perhaps. But none has yet. In Epirus, its spores are precious in our flesh. But here, they do not make their homes in us.
translation: 叶疫?也许吧。但至今还没有人染上。在伊庇鲁斯,它的孢子在我们血肉中弥足珍贵。但在这里,它们不会在我们体内安家。

text: The Plague of Leaves? A little. When I rise. No wood is quite so pliable as flesh. And so I rarely venture from this room. My view is charming, but I tire of it. And so I greet all visitors as friends. Even the ones like Fraser and his pet.
translation: 叶疫?有一点。在我起身的时候。没有哪种木头,像血肉这般柔韧。所以我很少离开这间屋子。窗景迷人,可我也看腻了。因此,我把所有访客都当作朋友。连弗雷泽和他那只「宠物」也不例外。

text: You don't like Strathcoyne?
translation: 你不喜欢斯特拉斯科因?

text: Why don't you tell me some diverting thing?
translation: 你何不跟我讲讲,什么解闷的事?

text: [A look of clear disappointment flashes across Rodia's face, before she composes herself.]
translation: [罗迪娅脸上掠过一抹明显的失望,随即,她收拾起神色。]

text: Madame Rodia. A pleasure to make your acquaintance. My name is Spencer Hobson.
translation: 罗迪娅夫人。很高兴认识您。我是斯宾塞·霍布森。

text: Rodia. I'm Spencer.
translation: 罗迪娅。我是斯宾塞。

text: Not all of Europe's gentlemen are dead.
translation: 看来,欧洲的绅士还没有死绝。

text: Ha!
translation: 哈!

text: Spencer's an English name. You're far from home.
translation: 斯宾塞是个英国名字。你离家很远。

text: Farther than you think.
translation: 比你想象的更远。

text: As are you.
translation: 你也是。

text: Nod non-commitally.
translation: [不置可否地点点头。]

text: 'Rodia...'
translation: 「罗迪娅……」

text: Rodia... Rodia Vlachou?
translation: 罗迪娅……罗迪娅·弗拉胡?

text: A Greek name. I half-remember the word... rose? Pomegranate? Possibly?
translation: 一个希腊名字。我依稀记得那个词……玫瑰?石榴?也许吧?

text: A woman in green. In this part of the world, they would say she is 'between two ages.' Her eyes are steady; perhaps a little cynical; not obviously unkind.
translation: 一位身着绿衣的女人。在这一带,人们会说她「介于两个年纪之间」。她的目光沉静;或许有几分世故;但并不明显刻薄。

text: You're Greek?
translation: 你是希腊人?

text: Yes, those were mine, it's true. But very old now - fifteen years, I think. You will not judge me by my early songs?
translation: 是的,那些确实是我的。但已是很久以前了——我想,有十五年了。你不会以我早年的歌来评判我吧?

text: 'Rose'? 'Pomegranate'?
translation: 「玫瑰」?「石榴」?

text: [Rodia shrugs; draws on her cigarette until the end brightens.]
translation: [罗迪娅耸耸肩;吸了一口烟,直到烟头亮起。]

text: I've been away from Europe almost all that time. I didn't know you'd recorded anything else.
translation: 那段时间,我几乎一直不在欧洲。我不知道你还录过别的歌。

text: They were lovely. I'd like to hear more.
translation: 它们很美。我想多听一些。

text: How did you come to Antibes?
translation: 你是怎么来到昂蒂布的?

text: Do excuse me, Rodia. I have to go.
translation: 请原谅,罗迪娅。我得走了。

text: Reluctantly. My Mimis, and myself - in Epirus we made our home, and there his bones remain. Poor Epirus has fallen to a double scourge. The doctor offered help with my condition, when I fled the city's fall.
translation: 说来勉强。我的米米斯与我——我们在伊庇鲁斯安了家,他的骸骨至今留在那里。可怜的伊庇鲁斯,遭了双重灾祸。我逃离城陷之时,医生主动提出,愿意帮我诊治我的病症。

text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be impertinent. It was a botanical enquiry.
translation: 抱歉,我无意冒犯。那只是一次植物学上的探询。

text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be crude. I wondered if there were benefits to your condition - rejuvenations.
translation: 抱歉,我无意粗鲁。我只是在想,你的病症是否也有好处——比如返老还童。

text: I'm sorry - sometimes, when a gentleman is dazzled by beauty, he fumbles his manners.
translation: 抱歉——有时候,绅士被美色晃了眼,便会乱了礼数。

text: I don't have time to fence with you, Rodia. Tell me or not.
translation: 我没工夫与你周旋,罗迪娅。你说也罢,不说也罢。

text: Then no. The Plague of Leaves was known to gift its sufferers so, in Epirus. It has been called the Plague of Flowers too. But Rodia left not quite too late, and so she has no flowers.
translation: 那么,没有。在伊庇鲁斯,据说叶疫正是这样恩赐染病之人的。它也曾被称作花疫。但罗迪娅离开得不算太迟,所以,她身上没有花。

text: Then no. We whom the Plague of Leaves has touched are ripe - but not in any human sense. In Epirus one saw the bodies sprouting in the streets. But none bore children.
translation: 那么,没有。我们这些被叶疫触碰过的人,已然成熟——但绝不是人类意义上的成熟。在伊庇鲁斯,人们曾看见街上的躯体萌出新芽。但没有人怀上子嗣。

text: You're looking for my favour? Well, it's yours. And to your question - I was not among the unfortunate fruiting few, in Epirus. The Plague of Leaves still spared me that.
translation: 你在求我的垂青?好吧,它归你了。至于你的问题——在伊庇鲁斯,我不在那些不幸结果的少数人之中。叶疫好歹,没让我遭那一桩。

text: Then no. In Epirus one saw that sometimes. But Rodia, no.
translation: 那么,没有。在伊庇鲁斯,有时也能见到那样的事。但罗迪娅,没有。

text: I also have an ailment.
translation: 我也有一个病症。

text: Always. But now a subject of the doctor's realm.
translation: 一向如此。不过如今,你是医生辖下的子民了。

text: Entice me, pilgrim. What's your special curse?
translation: 引我好奇吧,巡礼者。你背负着什么特别的诅咒?

text: I was hollowed out by [[Worms]]. Although now I'm recovering.
translation: 我曾被[[蠕虫]]掏空。不过如今,正在恢复。

text: My heart is not quite the one I was born with.
translation: 我的心,已不是生来的那颗。

text: I spent a decade outside the world. I'm not who I used to be. I don't know exactly who I am now. Not yet.
translation: 我在世界之外度过了十年。我已不是昔日的我。我也不清楚,自己如今究竟是谁。还没有。

text: [Rodia frowns, stubs out her cigarette, lights another.] I don't know what that means. Although it doesn't sound like any state I'd choose.
translation: [罗迪娅皱起眉头,掐灭香烟,又点上一支。] 我不知道那是什么意思。虽说,那听上去不像是我会选择的任何状态。

text: [Flattery] I came here for a trivial reason. Now I've met you, I have a much better one.
translation: [恭维] 我来这里,本是为了一件微不足道的小事。如今遇见了你,我便有了好得多的理由。

text: [Rodia tilts her head.] This widow's heart, my pilgrim, is all stone. But still the gallantries are sweet.
translation: [罗迪娅侧了侧头。] 这颗寡妇的心,我的巡礼者,是石头做的。不过,恭维话依然中听。

text: [Spontaneity] I came here for a trivial reason. Now I've met you, I have a much better one.
translation: [率直] 我来这里,本是为了一件微不足道的小事。如今遇见了你,我便有了好得多的理由。

text: "My heart is not my own." I've heard that phrase. But, pilgrim, you mean something different, yes? I thank you.
translation: 「我的心已不是我自己的。」我听过这句话。但,巡礼者,你说的不是那个意思,对吧?我谢谢你。

text: If you had spent the last ten in the world - I can't say if you'd understand much more. We all of us have changed.
translation: 就算你在世间度过这十年——我也说不上,你会多明白几分。我们全都变了。

text: I find him churlish. And his arm revolts me. There; it's said.
translation: 我觉得他粗鲁。他的胳膊,令我作呕。好了,说出来了。

text: You've met that toothsome Mathis. He's the one that calls it 'Annabelle' - the arm. But don't tell Fraser - for I swear the man is humourless as beef.
translation: 你见过那位讨喜的马蒂斯了。就是他,管那条胳膊叫「安娜贝尔」。但别告诉弗雷泽——我敢发誓,那人无趣得像块牛肉。

text: I wonder if you mean your heart has imposed upon you? Sometimes I think that Strathcoyne's arm must be an imposition. But I find you more appealing than that man.
translation: 我在想,你的意思是不是说,你的心强加于你?有时我觉得,斯特拉斯科因的胳膊,想必也是一种强加。不过,你比那个人讨人喜欢得多。

text: [Rodia shudders.]
translation: [罗迪娅打了个寒颤。]

text: (I thought I'd locked the door. That's odd. But never mind.)
translation: (我以为我锁了门。真奇怪。不过,算了。)

text: [Incline my head and stay.]
translation: [微微点头,留下来。]

text: I'm looking for a woman who was here in the Sanitarium. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找一个女人,她曾在这家疗养院里住过。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: A man who seeks a woman always wears a certain air. It's one I know, too well.
translation: 一个寻找女人的男人,总带着某种神色。那种神色,我认得,太熟了。

text: Yes, I knew Nina. What was she to you?
translation: 是的,我认识尼娜。她与你,是什么关系?

text: [Truth] I know in my heart that I need to find her.
translation: [实话] 我心中明白,我必须找到她。

text: [Truth] There's a matter that only Nina can help with.
translation: [实话] 有件事,只有尼娜帮得上忙。

text: [Truth] I still haven't really thought about it.
translation: [真话] 我其实,还没好好想过这件事。

text: My business is my own.
translation: 我的事,是我自己的事。

text: Your heart, you say? But not the heart you carried at your birth?
translation: 你说你的心?但不是你出生时带着的那颗?

text: The heart's a well of truths. I sang that once. Better in Greek.
translation: 心是真理之井。我唱过这一句。用希腊语唱,更妙。

text: I wish you every chance. But Nina's gone. I liked her, but I never trusted her. So smooth; so bright; so sharp. I don't know what she sought, here in Antibes. She said once that the sun sets here; but yet I do not think she liked to watch it set.
translation: 我祝你一切顺利。但尼娜已经走了。我喜欢她,却从不信任她。那么圆滑;那么明艳;那么锋利。我不知道她在昂蒂布寻求什么。她曾说过,太阳在这里落下;可我觉得,她并不喜欢看它落下。

text: A mystery, then. I've always liked them.
translation: 那么,是个谜。我一向喜欢谜。

text: A double scourge?
translation: 双重灾祸?

text: Do you regret coming here?
translation: 你后悔来这儿吗?

text: I could be in a camp. Or lost to flowers. Or foundered in a pit of bones. [She gestures with her cigarette.] And so I think, this place is not so bad. Here's my advice. Be the good doctor's guest; and be my company in the sun.
translation: 我本可能待在营地里。或迷失于繁花。或沉没于骸骨之坑。[她拿香烟比了个手势。] 所以我想,这地方还不算太糟。这是我的忠告:当好医生的座上宾,也做我日光下的伴侣。

text: The Plague of Leaves - but first the civil war. [[Icarians]] made a stronghold of our Epirus. I sang for them; so when the King's men took the city, it went hard for me.
translation: 叶疫——但在那之前,是内战。[[伊加利亚人]]把我们的伊庇鲁斯变成了据点。我曾为他们歌唱;所以当国王的人马攻陷城邦时,我便遭了殃。

text: [She stubs her cigarette out, viciously, lights another.]
