translation: [她狠狠掐灭香烟,又点上一支。]

text: But Rodia's name has weight. I made my mark with battle-songs, you know? Against the [[Enemy]]. And I stayed free, when royalists were arresting [[Icarians]].
translation: 但罗迪娅的名字,是有分量的。我是靠战歌闯出的名头,你知道吗?对抗[[敌人]]的战歌。当保皇党人逮捕[[伊加利亚人]]时,我依然自由。

text: You're an Icarian?
translation: 你是伊加利亚人?

text: A patriot first, then everything besides. Against the [[Enemy]], we had no help - except, that is, the Stars and [[Ministries]]. Our idiot King had fled, but now he thinks the throne is his to claim again, with British help -
translation: 先是爱国者,然后才是其他一切。对抗[[敌人]]之时,我们得不到任何援助——除了,也就是说,群星与[[联盟]]。我们那个蠢国王早就逃了;可如今,他以为有英国人撑腰,王位又可以由他认领了——

text: Oh, pilgrim, look at what you've done to me. I'm talking politics - although I promised that I never would again. Another promise broken.
translation: 噢,巡礼者,看看你把我变成了什么样。我在谈政治——尽管我发过誓,再也不谈了。又一个誓言,被打破了。

text: Enough about Greece for now.
translation: 希腊的事,先说到这里吧。

text: Stay.
translation: 留下吧。

text: Leave.
translation: 告辞。

text: 'Your Candleflame'? 'Let Me Be Forgotten?'
translation: 「你的烛焰」?「让我被遗忘」?

text: Her eyes flicker to my dressing-gown; she looks faintly amused.
translation: 她的目光瞟向我的睡袍;她看起来,有几分忍俊不禁。

text: Be careful, [[pilgrim]]! When a gentleman comes calling dressed like that - a lady might misunderstand his aims.
translation: 当心些,[[巡礼者]]!一位绅士,穿着那样登门拜访——女士可是会误解他的来意的。

text: Rodia grins.
translation: 罗迪娅咧嘴一笑。

text: Who has come to Sinombre? Whose heart and whose name? Come closer, my dear. Let me see.
translation: 是谁来到了西诺姆布尔面前?谁的心,谁的名字?走近些,亲爱的。让我看看。

text: [Approach.]
translation: [走上前。]

text: [Keep my distance.]
translation: [保持距离。]

text: [Back away.]
translation: [退后。]

text: Who is hollow of spirit and brazen of heart? Who has come here through iron and salt? I know you and name you, Lieutenant S.H. Now tell me in turn what I am.
translation: 谁灵魂空洞,谁心肠厚颜?谁穿过铁与盐,来到这里?我认得你,也唤出你的名字,中尉 S.H.。现在,轮到你来告诉我,我是什么。

text: You're a fulgent. A Lantern-long. A bodiless immortal of the Company of Lights...
translation: 你是一名辉耀者。灯之长生者。辉光会社中无形的不朽者……

text: You're a Mansus-spirit. And not a well one, or you wouldn't choose to be here in the Sanitarium.
translation: 你是漫宿之灵。而且是个不健全的,否则你不会选择待在这疗养院里。

text: Perhaps where you're standing, you hybrid of mirk.
translation: 或许,在你站着的地方是这样,你这幽暗的杂种。

text: What do you mean? That it isn't the twentieth century everywhere?
translation: 你什么意思?难道不是处处都在二十世纪?

text: What do you mean? That it isn't the twentieth century where you're standing?
translation: 你什么意思?难道你站着的地方,不在二十世纪?

text: Stop it. Or I'll leave you here in the dark.
translation: 住口。不然,我就把你留在这黑暗里。

text: You are wise to be wary, my guttering light. But Sinombre is not what she was. Come closer, come closer, look into the scrine... and Sinombre will give you her light.
translation: 你懂得提防,是明智的,我这将熄的光。但西诺姆布尔,已不是昔日的她。走近些,再走近些,望向圣龛……西诺姆布尔会把她的光给你。

text: You've returned to Sinombre, Lieutenant S.H. And Sinombre is ready to speak.
translation: 你回到了西诺姆布尔面前,中尉 S.H.。而西诺姆布尔,已准备好开口。

text: Come, cautious petitioner, Sinombre awaits. Let's hear what you bring me today.
translation: 来吧,谨慎的请愿者,西诺姆布尔在等着。让我听听,你今天带来了什么。

text: [The light is compellingly bright. It's difficult to look away. It would be much easier to step closer.]
translation: [那光强烈得摄人心魄。很难移开目光。迈步靠近,要容易得多。]

text: [Murmur a protective charm.]
translation: [低声念出一道护身咒。]

text: [Remain in place through force of will - even if it exhausts me.]
translation: [凭意志力留在原地——哪怕耗尽气力。]

text: [The light doesn't dim, but it seems more remote, and the voice a little flatter. The pressure to approach eases so abruptly that I sway backwards.]
translation: [光没有变暗,却似乎更加遥远,声音也更平了些。那股催促靠近的压力骤然消解,我身形一晃,向后仰去。]

text: [The charm falters on my lips, and I find I've taken a step closer.]
translation: [咒语在唇边一顿,我发觉自己已经迈近了一步。]

text: Well, have it your own way, you thin scrap of flesh. Stay there in your shadowy muck. We can speak at this distance, like travellers by night. But tell me then, first, what I am.
translation: 好吧,随你的便,你这片单薄的肉。就待在你那阴翳的烂泥里吧。隔着这个距离,我们照样可以交谈,就像夜行的旅人。那么,先告诉我,我是什么。

text: ...and you're trapped in a scrine, here in the Wake, because someone back in the Mansus has destroyed your scrineway. No fulgent would risk staying this long in a scrine of something as impermanent as ice.
translation: ……而你被困在醒界的一座圣龛里,因为漫宿之中,有人毁掉了你的龛道。没有哪个辉耀者,会冒险在一座以冰这种无常之物制成的圣龛里,逗留这么久。

text: ...manifesting here in a scrine...of ice?
translation: ……在这座圣龛里显形……一座冰做的圣龛?

text: [A human-height block of something brilliantly luminous, almost hidden beneath a heavy velvet drape. Damp spots on the drape, drops of water on the floor, a hazy chill in the air of the room, all suggest that the 'something' is ice.]
translation: [一块一人高的东西,焕发着璀璨的光芒,几乎整个藏在一块厚重的天鹅绒帷幕之下。帷幕上的湿痕、地板上的水珠、房间里弥漫的寒意,都表明那「东西」是冰。]

text: I'm not going to talk to you like this, Sinombre. It's the twentieth century.
translation: 我不会这样跟你说话,西诺姆布尔。如今是二十世纪。

text: The aristocracy of the old Sun; a power of the Mansus gracing the Wake. [Incline your head.]
translation: 旧日太阳的贵族;一位驾临醒界的漫宿权柄。[微微颔首。]

text: When you've learnt all that I have, my petitioner-thing, perspective will grant you new eyes.
translation: 等你学尽了我所学的一切,我的请愿之物,眼界自会赐你新的眼睛。

text: Sinombre is listening. Tell her what you seek. If it touches her whims, she may help.
translation: 西诺姆布尔在聆听。告诉她,你求的是什么。若合她的心意,她或许会帮你。

text: All right; I'll indulge you.
translation: 好吧;我便依你。

text: It is harder, it's true, since the fall of the Sun. We are none of us all that we were.
translation: 确实,自太阳陨落以来,行事愈发艰难。我们之中,谁也不复昔日的自己。

text: You are not quite a scholar, but not quite a boor. It will do, for this sliver of day.
translation: 你算不上学者,也算不上粗人。于这一隙白昼,已然足够。

text: I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 「我在找一个女人,名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。」

text: [Sinombre's light pulses softly.]
translation: [西诺姆布尔的光,柔和地脉动着。]

text: The last witch of Lagash! A traitress, a fraud.
translation: 拉格什的末代女巫!一个叛徒,一个骗子。

text: Ah... of course. The compulsion of brass.
translation: 啊……当然。黄铜的驱使。

text: You are not the first fool to be snared.
translation: 你不是第一个被网住的傻瓜。

text: [Wait impassively. Don't rise to the bait.]
translation: [无动于衷地等着。不上钩。]

text: Don't think you understand my motives, Sinombre.
translation: 别以为你看得透我的动机,西诺姆布尔。

text: I have seen your poor spirit, remember, S.H. You are bent by the sign of the Gate.
translation: 我看过你那可怜的魂灵,记得吗,S.H.。你被「门」的印记压弯了。

text: So the wisdom of silence's not lost to the world? That will serve you, perhaps, with the Witch.
translation: 这么说,沉默的智慧,还没有在世间失传?这或许能帮到你,在那女巫面前。

text: I see deeper, petitioner, than any mere flesh. Have a care what you say in this place.
translation: 我看得比任何血肉之躯都深,请愿者。在这个地方说话,当心些。

text: None of us are ever really free... but I shouldn't need to tell you that, should I, Sinombre?
translation: 我们谁都不会真正自由……不过这话,不必由我来说吧,西诺姆布尔?

text: Well, Nina has left us, that much you must know. The Director dreams brightly of why. Would you walk in his dreams, then? To learn of her fate? If you offer me what I must have?
translation: 唔,尼娜离开了我们,这一点你必定知晓。至于缘由,院长梦得澄亮。那么,你可愿意走进他的梦里?去探知她的命运?只要你给我,我必需之物?

text: About the dreams of Dr Aubière.
translation: 关于奥比埃医生的梦。

text: [Sinombre's light pulses avidly.]
translation: [西诺姆布尔的光,急切地脉动起来。]

text: Use Nyctodromy to brew something that will let me walk in his dreams? That's a good idea, actually.
translation: 用夜游术炼制出某种东西,让我得以走进他的梦?这主意,其实不坏。

text: Hmf. After so many years I should really have learnt not to fritter my insights away.
translation: 哼。这么多年了,我本当学会,不把自己的洞见随手挥霍。

text: I can craft Labrikon with an Unworldly skill, enabling entry to Aubière's dream. Or I can still make an arrangement with Sinombre, if I prefer.
translation: 我可以用一项超凡技艺炼制拉布里孔,从而进入奥比埃的梦境。或者,倘若我更愿意,仍可与西诺姆布尔谈成一笔交易。

text: What price would you accept to take me into the doctor's dream?
translation: 要什么代价,你才肯带我进入医生的梦境?

text: What safeguards would you offer to take me into the doctor's dream?
translation: 带我进入医生的梦境,你能给出什么保障?

text: ...actually, never mind.
translation: ……罢了,当我没说。

text: All right. I'm ready to discuss an arrangement to enter the doctor's dreams.
translation: 好吧。我准备好谈一笔交易,以进入医生的梦境。

text: Oh, banish your fears, I won't feast on your thoughts. I'll offer the oath you prefer.
translation: 噢,收起你的恐惧吧,我不会以你的思绪为食。我会立下你中意的誓言。

text: [Consider safeguards when dealing with a Lantern-long like this.]
translation: [与这样一位灯之长生者打交道,须得思量些保障。]

text: [Any number of binding oaths suggest themselves. There are ways to be safe.]
translation: [种种约束性的誓言,纷至沓来。总有些法子,可以保自己周全。]

text: [She could offer safeguards. She could make promises. But could I really be sure?]
translation: [她可以给出保障。她可以许下承诺。可我真的能确信吗?]

text: I am generous; and always, I'm ready to trust. Only give me your word that you'll help. The next time I find myself needful and lost... I'll call on your services then.
translation: 我慷慨大方;而且,我向来愿意信任。只要给我一句话,说你愿意相助。下一次,我若困顿无依……我便来请你出力。

text: Or if you've found for me the customary gift - then that's easier of course for us both.
translation: 又或者,你为我寻来了惯例的献礼——那我们双方,自然都更省事。

text: I acknowledge your insight... disparage your tact. We'll agree that it is as you say.
translation: 我认下你的洞见……也看不上你的圆滑。我们姑且同意,事情就如你所说。

text: Now just let your thoughts wander, just open your eyes. It's so bright, is it not? It's so clear.
translation: 现在,只管让你的思绪漫游,只管睁开你的眼睛。多么明亮,不是吗?多么清澈。

text: [A moment of peace. Perhaps more than a moment.]
translation: [片刻的安宁。或许,不止片刻。]

text: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

text: But you will not forget me, petitioner mine. Sinombre will dwell in your thoughts.
translation: 但你不会忘记我的,我的请愿者。西诺姆布尔,将在你的思绪中栖居。

text: Then you'll offer me what? For the dreams that I'll bring?
translation: 那么,你愿意给我什么?换我带来的梦境?

text: The traditional payment. [Hold up a spintria.]
translation: 传统的酬谢。[举起一枚斯宾特里亚。]

text: Our agreement still stands?
translation: 我们的约定,依然算数?

text: I am ready to guide you, as we have agreed. Place my name on your lips when you sleep.
translation: 我已准备好为你引路,如我们所约。入睡之时,把我的名字置于唇间。

text: Are you a patient here? Or a prisoner?
translation: 你是这里的病人?还是囚徒?

text: I have doctorates from Leiden, Navarre, and Bonn. I'm a colleague of dear Aubière's.
translation: 我在莱顿、纳瓦拉和波恩都取得过博士学位。我是亲爱的奥比埃的同事。

text: Sometimes.
translation: 有时候。

text: You have my promise that I'll help you, the next time that you'll need it.
translation: 我向你承诺:下次你需要帮助之时,我会相助。

text: Wait. I'm not ready after all.
translation: 等等。我终究还没有准备好。

text: You are teasing me now. I had thought we were friends. But it seems I am nothing to you.
translation: 你这是在戏弄我了。我原以为,我们已是朋友。可看来,我对你什么都不是。

text: Uninspiring, but Sinombre takes what she must. Place it under my drape and step back.
translation: 平平无奇,但西诺姆布尔,取其所必需。把它放在我的幕布之下,然后退开。

text: Ah, my sweet petitioner! How welcome you are; for that promise is all that I need.
translation: 啊,我甜蜜的请愿者!真是欢迎之至;因为你那句话,正是我所需的一切。

text: Ah, the sweetest of Spencers! How welcome you are; for that promise is all that I need.
translation: 啊,最甜蜜的斯宾塞!真是欢迎之至;因为你那句话,正是我所需的一切。

text: When you sleep, say my name as you wait for the dark. Once, twice, and a third time, no more.
translation: 入睡之时,在等待黑暗之际,念我的名字。一遍,两遍,至第三遍,不可再多。

text: [When I lift the drape, the light from beneath is enthrallingly bright. But I place the coin and step back before my mind can drift.]
translation: [我掀开幕布,底下溢出的光令人心神俱醉。但在心神游走之前,我放下钱币,退后一步。]

text: I swear that I'll guide you; nor draw from your strength; nor enter where I am not bid. On the [[Watchman]] I swear it, the Door in the Eye, on his robe and his [[Names]] and his light.
translation: 我发誓,为你引路;不汲取你的力量;不踏入未受邀请之地。以[[守夜人]]起誓,以瞳中之门、以他的衣袍、他的[[名号]]与他的光起誓。

text: I look forward to meeting again on the other side of sleep, shining one.
translation: 期待与你在睡眠的彼岸重逢,光辉者。

text: It must be tedious for you being trapped in this scrine. I hope it's a welcome diversion.
translation: 被困在这座圣龛里,想必十分乏味。但愿,这是个受欢迎的消遣。

text: Don't keep me waiting.
translation: 别让我久等。

text: You are mortal. And ignorant. Nothing you say can approach what a Lantern-long feels.
translation: 你是凡人。而且无知。你说的一切,都无从触及灯之长生者的感受。

text: We have made our arrangement. I'll keep to my word.
translation: 我们已定下约定。我会信守承诺。

text: A pity the [[Mansus]] is barred to us both. We could walk in the Orchard of Lights... but the War in the Sun has denied us that joy. We must take what we can from what's left.
translation: 可惜,[[漫宿]]对我们俩,双双紧闭。我们本可在辉光果园中漫步……但太阳之战,夺走了这份欢愉。我们只能从余下的残迹中,取用所能取的一切。

text: A pity the [[Mansus]] is barred to us both. I would like to speak more with your heart. It is rare to share [[History]] with one of your kind. But we'll have to make do with what's left.
translation: 可惜,[[漫宿]]对我们俩,双双紧闭。我很想与你的心,再多谈谈。与你这般的人共享[[历史]],实属罕事。但我们只能将就,以余下的残迹度日。

text: I have what I needed from the doctor - I found it in his dream.
translation: 我已从医生那里得到了所需之物——我在他的梦里找到了它。

text: It is good when we open the vaults of the soul. It is good when a secret's revealed.
translation: 当我们打开灵魂的宝库,是好的。当一个秘密被揭示,是好的。

text: What was Nina doing here?
translation: 尼娜在这里做什么?

text: The witch followed another, as you follow her - an old woman of Raveline blood. I concerned myself not with her beast-taint and curse. But your Nina sought something from her.
translation: 那女巫追随着另一个人,正如你追随着她——一位拉韦林血统的老妇人。她的兽污与诅咒,我不曾理会。但你的尼娜,想从她那里得到什么。

text: My heart thumps uncomfortably. Jealousy? Apprehension? Difficult to be sure.
translation: 我的心,不安地擂动。嫉妒?忧惧?说不准。

text: Earlier, you wanted me to look into the scrine. So you could know me, wasn't it? I offer you that.
translation: 方才,你想让我望向圣龛。好让你识得我,不是吗?如今,我成全你。

text: You are friendlier now that Sinombre can help? Well, let's call it a change of the heart.
translation: 西诺姆布尔能帮上忙了,你就热络起来?唔,就当这是一次心的转变吧。

text: [Approach, and look into the scrine.]
translation: [走上前,望向圣龛。]

text: Now just let your thoughts wander, now open your eyes. It's so bright, is it not? It's so clear.
translation: 现在,只管让你的思绪漫游,现在睁开眼睛。多么明亮,不是吗?多么清澈。

text: [A moment of peace. Perhaps more than a moment.]
translation: [片刻的安宁。或许,不止片刻。]

text: Who is hollow of spirit and brazen of heart? Who has come here through iron and salt? I know you and name you, Lieutenant S.H. And I'll help you with Aubière's dream.
translation: 谁灵魂空洞,谁心肠厚颜?谁穿过铁与盐,来到这里?我认得你,也唤出你的名字,中尉 S.H.。而我,会助你进入奥比埃的梦。

text: Use Bosk to brew something that will let me walk in his dreams? That's a good idea, actually.
translation: 用丛林学炼制出某种东西,让我得以走进他的梦?这主意,其实不坏。

text: Use Ithastry to brew something that will let me walk in his dreams? That's a good idea, actually.
translation: 用盗火术炼制出某种东西,让我得以走进他的梦?这主意,其实不坏。

text: [Leave the matter for now.]
translation: [此事暂且放下。]

text: [Go.]
[Shrug] Perhaps.
translation: [耸肩] 也许吧。

text: Fitful fires flicker beneath the velvet veil...
translation: 断续的火焰,在天鹅绒帷幕下明灭……

text: This entity is dormant - or its attention is elsewhere.
translation: 这个存在正处于沉眠——或者说,它的注意力在别处。

text: Leave.
translation: 告辞。

text: You'll be Hobson, then.
translation: 那么,你就是霍布森了。

text: An honour to make your acquaintance, sir. But you have the advantage of me.
translation: 有幸与您相识,先生。只是,您认得我,我却还不认得您。

text: My name is Fraser Strathcoyne. Did you have business with me?
translation: 我是弗雷泽·斯特拉斯科因。你找我,有何贵干?

text: My condolences on your condition, Mr Strathcoyne.
translation: 斯特拉斯科因先生,对您的状况,我深表同情。

text: What? The [[Cross]]-change? Pray do not distress yourself, Mr Hobson. I have waited a great many years for it to begin.
translation: 什么?[[介壳种]]蜕变?请不要为此不安,霍布森先生。我等它开始,已经等了漫长的岁月。

text: Mr Hobson.
translation: 霍布森先生。

text: Aye. Dark times. But Dr Aubière sees to it for me.
translation: 是啊。黑暗的时局。但奥比埃医生,替我照看着。

text: Out of the goodness of his heart?
translation: 出于他的一片好心?

text: [The air around Strathcoyne carries a distinctive odour. Sniff discreetly.]
translation: [斯特拉斯科因周身的气息,带着一种独特的气味。不动声色地嗅了嗅。]

text: I understand your arm is named Annabelle?
translation: 我听说,您的胳膊名叫安娜贝尔?

text: My arm has no 'name', Mr Hobson! This is a tedious and puerile bit of pawkiness perpetrated by an... ignoramus.
translation: 我的胳膊没有「名字」,霍布森先生!这是某个……无知之徒,炮制出的乏味又幼稚的促狭把戏。

text: Dr Aubière is an 'ignoramus'? He has his flaws, but he's an educated man, surely.
translation: 奥比埃医生是「无知之徒」?他确实有缺点,但他毕竟是个受过教育的人。

text: Dr Aubière is most certainly not the author of this calumny! In fact, I have his personal assurance that he will discipline that author.
translation: 奥比埃医生,绝非这诽谤的炮制者!事实上,他向我当面保证过,会好好管教那个炮制者。

text: I'm sorry to tell you, Mr Strathcoyne, that I heard this 'Annabelle' nonsense directly from Dr Aubière. I had no idea it would offend you so. I'm very disappointed in him.
translation: 很抱歉告诉您,斯特拉斯科因先生,这「安娜贝尔」的胡话,我是从奥比埃医生那里亲耳听来的。我不知道这会如此冒犯您。我对他,非常失望。

text: Are you sure? I had thought much better of him.
translation: 你确定吗?我原以为,他远比这高明。

text: I'm sorry to tell you, Mr Hobson, that you must be mistaken. Dr Aubière is a man of excellent character.
translation: 很抱歉,我要告诉你,霍布森先生,你一定是弄错了。奥比埃医生,品行端方。

text: I'm afraid so. I had it directly from him. In fact, the doctor is the only person I've heard use this silly nickname.
translation: 恐怕是的。我是从他本人那里听来的。事实上,这个傻绰号,我只听医生一个人用过。

text: Perhaps I was mistaken. It doesn't sound very much like him.
translation: 也许是我弄错了。听起来,不太像他会做的事。

text: This is very disappointing. Very disappointing indeed. He is not the man I thought, not that man at all. I should have known when - hm.
translation: 这实在令人失望。实在令人失望。他不是我以为的那个人,全然不是。我本该早就察觉——嗯。

text: When what, Mr Strathcoyne?
translation: 您本该早察觉什么,斯特拉斯科因先生?

text: Well, we have an arrangement, he and I. I have very specific requirements, d'y'see? Creature comforts and so forth. I pay a small surcharge to the doctor, to ensure my requirements are fulfilled. He has asked me to be discreet about our arrangement. But the surcharge has grown less small of late. It has been troubling me, Mr Hobson.
translation: 我与他有份约定,霍布森先生。我有一些很特别的要求,你明白吧?起居上的舒适之类。我向医生付一笔小小的额外费用,好让我的要求得到满足。他请我对这份约定守口如瓶。可近来那笔费用已不那么「小小」了。这让我颇为不安,霍布森先生。

text: It sounds to me as if he has been taking advantage of your good nature.
translation: 依我看,他是一直在利用您的好心肠。

text: Interesting.
translation: 有意思。

text: I'm not surprised at all. I think he may not even be a real doctor.
translation: 我一点也不意外。我看他甚至可能根本不是真正的医生。

text: Don't flannel me, Hobson. I'm not so great a fool as all that. But yes, it is disappointing.
translation: 别跟我耍滑头,霍布森。我还没蠢到那份上。不过,确实令人失望。

text: Let's not get carried away, Mr Hobson.
translation: 我们别得意忘形,霍布森先生。

text: It is. But perhaps kept between us two for the time being, hey?
translation: 确实如此。但暂且只限于你我之间,嗯?

text: [Raising the subject with Aubière may provide an opportunity to pressure him.]
translation: [向奥比埃提起此事,或可借机给他施压。]

text: Cigar smoke. Of course: he has those black market Romeo y Julietas in the humidor in his room.
translation: 雪茄烟雾。自然:他房间的保湿盒里存着那些黑市罗密欧与朱丽叶。

text: Well, I pay a small surcharge. This is the world we live in, Mr Hobson. I trust the matter will remain between us. I wouldn't want to provoke unseemly envy.
translation: 嗯,我付了一笔小小的额外费用。我们活在这个世道里,霍布森先生。我相信此事会止于你我之间。我可不想招来不合时宜的艳羡。

text: This is one of the privileges for which I pay my little surcharge to Dr Aubière. As I said, I hope the matter will remain between us. I wouldn't want to provoke unseemly jealousy.
translation: 这正是我付那笔小小费用给奥比埃医生换来的特权之一。如我所说,我希望此事止于你我之间。我可不想招来不合时宜的嫉妒。

text: When he and I made the arrangement to supply my special requirements, Mr Hobson. This is the world we live in; but it is not an arrangement that an honest man would have offered me.
translation: 就在我与他就供应我的特别要求达成约定之时,霍布森先生。我们活在这个世道里;可这不是一个诚实的人会给我的约定。

text: Are you a cigar man, Mr Strathcoyne?
translation: 您是抽雪茄的人吗,斯特拉斯科因先生?

text: [Don't mention the cigars.]
translation: [别提雪茄的事。]

text: Strathcoyne wears a fixed smile which suggests a kind of chilly benevolence. His arm's expression is harder to read.
translation: 斯特拉斯科因脸上挂着凝固的微笑,透着一种冷然的仁厚。他那只胳膊的神情,则更难以读懂。

text: Good day, Mr Strathcoyne.
translation: 日安,斯特拉斯科因先生。

text: I am. I couldn't do without my Churchills. Although cigar smoke does not entirely agree with my other nature, so I may yet be forced to give up that little pleasure.
translation: 正是。我离不开我的丘吉尔型雪茄。虽说雪茄烟雾与我的另一重本性并不完全相合,我或许终究要被迫舍弃这点小小的乐趣。

text: Churchills? Cuban cigars? I haven't seen those in France since the war.
translation: 丘吉尔型?古巴雪茄?战后我在法国就没再见过这种东西。

text: How do you know my name?
translation: 您怎么知道我的名字?

text: You were a Bureau man, were you not? I used to make it my business to keep abreast of Bureau matters.
translation: 你曾是防剿局的人,对不对?从前,打探防剿局的事务是我的本分。

text: When the Bureau still mattered a damn.
translation: 在防剿局还值得一提的那个年头。

text: Really just a social call, Mr Strathcoyne. But if I might impose on you to answer a few questions -
translation: 真的只是登门拜访,斯特拉斯科因先生。不过,若我斗胆劳烦您回答几个问题——

text: Yes. I have questions that need answering.
translation: 是的。我有几个问题需要答案。

text: Indeed?
translation: 是吗?

text: Strathcoyne waits. His arm twiches now and then, but its eyes never move.
translation: 斯特拉斯科因等待着。他的胳膊不时抽动,可它上面的眼睛却一动不动。

text: You have something - something on - [Brush significantly at your own arm.]
translation: 您身上有什么——有什么——[意味深长地掸掸自己的胳膊。]

text: What on Earth is going on with your arm?
translation: 您的胳膊到底是怎么回事?

text: The [[Cross]]-change, Mr Hobson. A final personal advancement. The efflorescence of a long-held secret.
translation: 介壳种之变,霍布森先生。一次最终的个人进阶。一桩久藏秘密的绽放。

text: And there is only a very little pain.
translation: 而且只有一点点疼痛。

text: [Take stock of the arm.]
translation: [打量那只胳膊。]

text: You are speaking of the [[Cross]]-change, I suppose, Mr Hobson? What an amusing fellow you are. Perhaps you should consider a career on the stage.
translation: 你说的想必是介壳种之变吧,霍布森先生?你可真是个有趣的人。也许你该考虑去舞台上谋个前程。

text: I've seen Cross-touched humans, and Cross-relics in the wild places. Never anything quite like this. It's clearly the Cross-change. But...
translation: 我见过受介壳种沾染的人,也在荒野之地见过介壳种遗物。从未见过与此相似的景象。这显然是介壳种之变。但是……

text: I've seen Cross-touched humans, and Cross-relics in the wild places. Never anything quite like this. But it's clearly the Cross-change.
translation: 我见过受介壳种沾染的人,也在荒野之地见过介壳种遗物。从未见过与此相似的景象。但显然,这是介壳种之变。

text: Is the Change why you're in the Sanitarium?
translation: 您来疗养院,是因为这场变化吗?

text: It is a pleasant enough dallying-place. I'll remain here until my translation to the Incorporate territories is arranged. I have important business in the West.
translation: 这里是个足够宜人的逗留之所。我会在此待到前往集团领土的行程安排妥当。我在西方有要事在身。

text: You're going to America?
translation: 您要去美国?

text: For a time. When I return, I'll take my place in one of my kind's new cities. They should be well in progress by that time.
translation: 待上一段时间。我回来后,便会在同类的某座新城市中安身。到那时,那些城市应该已经颇具规模了。

text: New cities?
translation: 新城市?

text: A bright future.
translation: 光明的未来。

text: Indeed.
translation: 的确。

text: Too early to speak of, Mr Hobson. Put it from your mind.
translation: 说来尚早,霍布森先生。把这事从脑子里赶走吧。

text: [Nod. Pull a coin out of Strathcoyne's ear and offer it to him.]
translation: [点头。从斯特拉斯科因先生的耳朵里变出一枚硬币,递给他。]

text: I apologise for my flippancy, Mr Strathcoyne.
translation: 我为自己的轻浮致歉,斯特拉斯科因先生。

text: [Shrug.]
translation: [耸耸肩。]

text: Hrmp.
translation: 哼。

text: Strathcoyne's eyes pop. He takes the coin, examines it for a second, and then - apparently to his own surprise - guffaws.
translation: 斯特拉斯科因瞪大了眼。他接过硬币,端详片刻,然后——显然连他自己都没想到——放声大笑。

text: Unfortunately, Strathcoyne's arm interprets my sudden movement as an attack. It rears up, hissing, and Strathcoyne recoils.
translation: 可惜,斯特拉斯科因的胳膊把我这突然的动作当作袭击。它竖了起来,嘶嘶作响,斯特拉斯科因也随之退避。

text: Exceptional, Hobson. Exceptional.
translation: 了不起,霍布森。了不起。

text: Steady there, man. Steady.
translation: 稳住,伙计。稳住。

text: [An awkward silence.]
translation: [一阵尴尬的沉默。]

text: There's a rather grim scholarly debate on whether the Cross-changed actually become the end product, or are consumed by the Cross-seed within them. Strathcoyne's arm moves with unsettling independence.
translation: 学界有一场颇为阴森的争论:经介壳种之变者,究竟是真正成为最终的产物,还是被体内的介壳种子所吞噬。斯特拉斯科因的胳膊正以令人不安的独立性自行活动着。

text: It may be that he won't enjoy the Change as much as he expects. The night is amused.
translation: 或许他并不会如自己所愿那般享受这场变化。夜色为之窃喜。

text: It would be cruel to point that out.
translation: 点破此事未免残忍。

text: It will gain me nothing to point that out.
translation: 点破此事对我毫无益处。

text: [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]……

text: Lagasse, you say? Lagasse?
translation: 你说拉加斯?拉加斯?

text: What is she to you, Hobson?
translation: 她与你有什么关系,霍布森?

text: We've never met. But she has information I need.
translation: 我们素未谋面。但她握有我需要的情报。

text: I'm afraid I'm not at liberty to say.
translation: 恐怕我不便相告。

text: Mind your own business.
translation: 不关您的事。

text: The woman is a white carrion crow, Hobson. A baleful nidus of betrayals! If you know what's good for you, you'll stay well away.
translation: 那女人是只白色的食腐乌鸦,霍布森。一个不祥的背叛之巢!你若明白什么对你有好处,就离她远远的。

text: That is all I have to say on the matter.
translation: 关于此事,我言尽于此。

text: I have already made my feelings very clear on that... icy villainess.
translation: 对于那个……冰冷的恶妇,我的态度已经表达得很清楚了。

text: One human eye tracks my movements. Three other eyes glitter.
translation: 一只人眼追随着我的动作。另外三只眼睛闪闪发亮。

text: [Raising the subject with Aubière may provide an opportunity to pressure him.]
translation: [向奥比埃提起此事,或可借机给他施压。]

text: Three eyes seem unfazed by my dressing-gown. The fourth widens indignantly.
translation: 三只眼睛似乎对我的睡袍无动于衷。第四只则愤然瞪圆。

text: Perhaps, sir, we can speak further when you've troubled to dress yourself. Hrmph!
translation: 先生,也许等你费心穿戴整齐之后,我们再继续谈吧。哼!

text: [Retreat.]
translation: [退下。]

text: Hrmph!
translation: 哼!

text: ...so it takes me a few moments to recognise him. He's quicker off the mark.
translation: ……于是我花了好一会儿才认出他。他却更快认出了我。

text: Lieutenant - Lieutenant [[Huissier]]! It's you, damn your eyes! [Vincent is grinning.]
translation: 中尉——韦西耶中尉!是你,真见鬼![文森特咧嘴笑着。]

text: Vincent - Vincent Chraibi! In my Légion du Seuil days, we were posted together to watch the Bounds in Algeria. I remember that Vincent was a bit of a scoundrel. But a lot of us were scoundrels, in the Légion. And the two of us always got on.
translation: 文森特——文森特·沙莱比!我还在门关军团时,我们曾一同被派驻阿尔及利亚看守边界。我记得文森特有点无赖习气。但在军团里,无赖者大有人在。而且我们俩一直处得来。

text: Come to think of it, I saved his leg.
translation: 说起来,我还救过他的腿。

text: Vincent. How's the leg?
translation: 文森特。腿怎么样了?

text: It's, ah... Hobson now. Spencer Hobson.
translation: 是,呃……如今是霍布森了。斯宾塞·霍布森。

text: Call me Sylvain, Vincent. You're out of the Légion too.
translation: 叫我西尔万吧,文森特。你也离开军团了。

text: Sylvain. All right, chef. [Vincent chortles.]
translation: 西尔万。好的,头儿。[文森特咯咯笑着。]

text: Only bad in bad weather. So I stay on this side of the park, hey?
translation: 只有遇上坏天气才疼。所以我待在这公园的这一边,嗯?

text: Huh. All right. I remember you talked in your sleep, in English.
translation: 嚯。行吧。我记得你说梦话,说的是英语。

text: Weren't you dead? What are you doing here?
translation: 你不是死了吗?你在这儿做什么?

text: I'm looking for someone.
translation: 我在找一个人。

text: Can I trust you?
translation: 我能信你吗?

text: Sylvain. Going somewhere?
translation: 西尔万。要出远门?

text: Spencer. Going somewhere?
translation: 斯宾塞。要出远门?

text: Out.
translation: 出去。

text: Away. Is that likely to cause difficulties for you?
translation: 离开。这会给你带来麻烦吗?

text: Don't get in my way.
translation: 别挡我的路。

text: Wouldn't dream of it. I was going to offer my help. Want company?
translation: 想都不会想。我正想助你一臂之力。要个伴吗?

text: Heavens, no. Want company?
translation: 老天,可别。要个伴吗?

text: Picking flowers.
translation: 采花。

text: Want company? I'll lend a hand with the flowers.
translation: 要个伴吗?我来帮你采花。

text: Want company?
translation: 要个伴吗?

text: Why?
translation: 为什么?

text: All right. [Gain Vincent's positive Skill modifiers.]
translation: 好。[获得文森特的正面技艺修正。]

text: Don't you want to know more about where I'm going, first?
translation: 你难道不想先多了解我要去哪儿吗?

text: I'm not sure about this.
translation: 我拿不准这事。

text: All right!
translation: 好嘞!

text: [Vincent has joined you as a companion, and will assist with Skill challenges where he can.]
translation: [文森特已成为你的同伴,会在力所能及处协助你应对技艺挑战。]

text: Easily bored. You remember me. And there are people here I don't like so much.
translation: 容易无聊。你还记得我。而且这里有些我不太喜欢的人。

text: Did Aubière put you up to this? Are you spying on me?
translation: 是奥比埃指使你的吗?你在监视我?

text: It'll be dangerous, where I'm going.
translation: 我要去的地方会很危险。

text: [Vincent guffaws.] My lieutenant - we were in the Légion!
translation: [文森特放声大笑。]我的中尉——我们可是在军团里待过的人!

text: Are we going back to Algeria?
translation: 我们要回阿尔及利亚吗?

text: No.
translation: 不。

text: Good. I don't want to go back to Algeria.
translation: 那就好。我可不想回阿尔及利亚。

text: Oh, my friend, I only wish monsieur le docteur would pay me enough to spy on you.
translation: 哦,我的朋友,我倒希望那位医生先生付得起让我监视你的钱呢。

text: Travelling light, is it?
translation: 轻装上路,是吧?

text: All right. But call me Spencer. That's my name now. Spencer Hobson. [Gain Vincent's positive Skill modifiers.]
translation: 好。但叫我斯宾塞。这是我现在的名字。斯宾塞·霍布森。[获得文森特的正面技艺修正。]

text: Huh. All right. I remember you talked in your sleep, in English.
translation: 嚯。行吧。我记得你说梦话,说的是英语。

text: Sylvain!
translation: 西尔万!

text: Spencer!
translation: 斯宾塞!

text: Vincent. Can I ask you some questions?
translation: 文森特。我能问你几个问题吗?

text: Tell me about Strathcoyne.
translation: 跟我说说斯特拉斯科因。

text: Mathis and I started calling that arm of his 'Annabelle'. I don't know if he overheard us. I stay out of his way now, when I can.
translation: 我和马蒂斯开始把他那只胳膊叫作「安娜贝尔」。不知道他有没有偷听到。现在能躲我就躲着他走。

text: Did I tell you? Mathis and I started calling that arm of his 'Annabelle'. I don't think he likes that.
translation: 我跟你说过吗?我和马蒂斯把他那只胳膊叫作「安娜贝尔」。我觉得他不喜欢这样。

text: A wiry, handsome man. His eyes are hidden behind smoked-glass goggles, rather like something an arc-welder might wear.
translation: 一个精瘦英俊的男人。双眼藏在烟熏玻璃护目镜后面,像极了电焊工戴的那种东西。

text: My heart pounds in dismay.
translation: 我的心因惊惶而怦怦直跳。

text: The night is entertained...where it can find its place in the shadowless sanitarium. It speculates how it would be if I were alone again.
translation: 夜色自得其乐……在无影的疗养院里,它也能寻到自己的位置。它揣想着,若我再度孤身一人,会是何种光景。

text: Reconsider -
translation: 再想想——

text: Course you can. Once a Legionnaire, always a Legionnaire. 'Honneur et Humanité', remember?
translation: 当然可以。一日为军团兵,终身为军团兵。「荣誉与人性」,还记得吗?

text: Oho! A woman? Bet it's a woman.
translation: 哦嚯!是个女人?我打赌是个女人。

text: Yes. But it's not what you think.
translation: 没错。但不是你想的那样。

text: Not dead, but not far off dead.
translation: 没死,但离死也不远了。

text: It's been rough, hasn't it? You see much action?
translation: 这些年不好过吧?见过不少大场面?

text: No. Thankfully.
translation: 没有。谢天谢地。

text: No. But not through choice.
translation: 没有。但并非出于选择。

text: Who is she, then? What is she to you?
translation: 那她是谁?她跟你有什么关系?

text: Who is she to me? I've never met her. But her name is [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 她跟我有什么关系?我从未见过她。但她名叫尼娜·拉加斯。

text: Yes. There's something I need from her.
translation: 是的。我有样东西要从她那儿得到。

text: Yeah, she was here. Not long ago. Don't know where she went. I'll keep my ears open, though, chef. What I know, you'll know.
translation: 是啊,她来过这儿。没多久以前。不知道她去了哪儿。不过我会竖起耳朵听着的,头儿。我知道的,你都会知道。

text: Thanks, Vincent.
translation: 谢了,文森特。

text: The moment you hear anything, yes?
translation: 你一听到任何风声,就来告诉我,好吗?

text: I'm glad to find you here.
translation: 我很高兴在这儿遇见你。

text: It's nothing, chef.
translation: 这不算什么,头儿。

text: You too, chef.
translation: 你也是,头儿。

text: Course. [Vincent looks faintly hurt.]
translation: 当然。[文森特神情略显受伤。]

text: Listen. Are you a visitor? Resident? Staff?
translation: 听着。你是访客?住客?还是工作人员?

text: Resident.
translation: 住客。

text: Resident... for now.
translation: 住客……暂时是。

text: [Lie] Staff.
translation: [撒谎]工作人员。

text: I think I'm a visitor. Aubière thinks I'm a resident.
translation: 我觉得我是访客。奥比埃觉得我是住客。

text: Welcome, then!
translation: 那就欢迎你了!

text: Good luck, then! You'll find it a lot stranger than the Légion. And the Légion was pretty strange, hey? [He chortles.]
translation: 那就祝你好运!你会发现这里比军团怪得多。而军团已经够怪的了,嗯?[他咯咯笑着。]

text: On the other side of this curtain... well, you know about that already. I'll stay here.
translation: 这道帘子的另一边……嗯,你已经知道了。我就待在这儿。

text: On the other side of this curtain... well residents are allowed to talk to each other, so go in there if you're feeling brave.
translation: 这道帘子的另一边……嗯,住客之间是允许交谈的,所以你要是胆子够大,就进去吧。

text: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思?

text: Sorry. Can't talk about... it. Gives it power. But you'll be fine. It won't hurt another resident.
translation: 抱歉。不能说……它。说了会给它力量。不过你会没事的。它不会伤害别的住客。

text: See you about, chef!
translation: 回头见,头儿!

text: Ask! It gets lonely up here.
translation: 问吧!这上头怪冷清的。

text: Poor old fool. I don't know if he wants to be cured or not. Don't think he can be, course. I've never seen someone stop going [[Cross]].
translation: 可怜的老傻瓜。我不知道他到底想不想被治愈。当然,我想他也治不好。我从没见过有人能中止走向介壳种的。

text: The whole business is making him... surly. No sense of humour.
translation: 这整档子事让他变得……乖戾。一点幽默感也没有了。

text: Do you know Rodia?
translation: 你认识罗迪娅吗?

text: What do you think of Dr Aubière?
translation: 你觉得奥比埃医生怎么样?

text: He's, ehh... I've known worse. Pay's good, and it's stinking hard to find work since the War, you know? Especially somewhere like this. The sun still shines. The rain doesn't burn. No difficult dead.
translation: 他嘛,呃……我见过更差的。薪水不错,而且战后这日子,想找份活儿难得很,你知道吧?尤其是这种地方。阳光照样照耀。雨水不会灼人。也没有难缠的死人。

text: You mean your employer? And mine? Nothing I'd care to air. [Vincent winks.]
translation: 你是说你的雇主?也是我的?没什么我想声张的。[文森特挤挤眼。]

text: How do you get on with Mathis?
translation: 你跟马蒂斯处得怎么样?

text: Your friend behind the curtain...
translation: 帘子后面你的那位朋友……

text: Not my friend. Listen, chef, I'd rather not talk about it.
translation: 不是我的朋友。听着,头儿,我宁愿不谈那事。

text: [Vincent leans forward and whispers:] It got into my dreams, last time.
translation: [文森特探过身来,低声说:]上次,它钻进了我的梦里。

text: Plenty else to talk about.
translation: 别的事多得很,够聊的。

text: Know her, love her! Heart of a lioness, voice of a lark.
translation: 认识她,也敬爱她!母狮般的心,百灵鸟般的嗓子。

text: She misses her country, and her husband. But I don't know how much is left of those - either of them - and she likes it here. 'Out of the cold,' she says. And the doctor is helping her with the pain.
translation: 她想念她的祖国,还有她的丈夫。但我不知道那两者还剩下多少——无论是哪个——而她喜欢这里。「远离寒冷,」她这么说。医生也在帮她缓解疼痛。

text: I don't think she expects ever to leave the Sanitarium alive. Stinking shame.
translation: 我看她没指望自己能活着离开疗养院。真他妈的可惜。

text: How about Bessy?
translation: 那贝茜呢?

text: Lovely girl, Bessy. I'm not her type, though.
translation: 贝茜是个好姑娘。可惜不是我的类型。

text: I told you: it got into my dreams once already. It's hard to get it out once it's in there, you know?
translation: 我跟你说过:它已经钻进过我的梦里一次了。一旦进了去,就很难把它赶出来,你懂吧?

text: Not the friendliest, you know? But he's all right once you get to know him.
translation: 不算最友善,你知道吧?不过熟了之后他还行。

text: He ran with the zazous, you know? In Paris, during the [[Enemy]] occupation.
translation: 他跟那群扎祖青年混过,你知道吧?在巴黎,敌人占领时期。

text: Ask him about rue Pigalle some time. If he likes you, he might share some stories.
translation: 改天问问他皮加勒街的事。要是他喜欢你,也许会讲上几段故事。

text: Maybe she likes 'em intellectual, or maybe she's one of those. Maybe both!
translation: 也许她喜欢斯文型的,又或者她是那种人。也许两者都是!

text: We have a good laugh, though. Lovely girl...
translation: 不过我们处得很开心。多好的姑娘……

text: You like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这儿吗?

text: You know. You take what you can get. Better than sleeping on the ground. Or in a barn. Or in a ditch waiting for the spidermist to get me. Or even the barracks back in Ghardaïa.
translation: 你知道的。有什么就凑合什么。总比睡在地上强。比睡在谷仓里强。也比躺在沟里等蜘蛛雾来收拾我强。甚至比加达亚军营里的日子强。

text: Wish they'd put me back downstairs, though. I don't know how much more of this I can take.
translation: 不过,我倒希望他们把我调回楼下。我不知道自己还能撑多久。

text: So it could be a lot worse. But I never know what's going on behind his eyes. You know what I mean.
translation: 所以说,本来还能糟得多。可我从不知道他那双眼睛后面藏着什么。你明白我的意思。

text: The world's a big place...
translation: 这世界大得很……

text: I can imagine...
translation: 可以想见……

text: It's true. Strathcoyne won't shut up about the [[Incorporate]] states. He's just waiting for his papers to come through. And I know Europe... well, Europe's on the way out. But when it goes, I'll be here to see it go.
translation: 千真万确。斯特拉斯科因整天念叨集团诸邦,没完没了。他正等着他的证件批下来。而我知道欧洲……嗯,欧洲气数将尽。可等它完了,我会亲眼看着它完。

text: Brr! That's what you turn to thinking, when you spend all day in the dark.
translation: 咝!整天待在黑暗里,你就会开始想这些。

text: Her name is [[Nina Lagasse]]... and I'm certain you'd remember her.
translation: 她的名字叫尼娜·拉加斯……而且我敢肯定你一定记得她。

text: Do I. Do I ever.
translation: 记得。岂止是记得。

text: [Vincent shivers - though with what emotion is not immediately obvious.]
translation: [文森特打了个寒颤——至于那是出于何种情绪,一时还看不分明。]

text: [Move on.]
translation: [继续走。]

text: Actually - I'll talk to you later.
translation: 其实——我回头再跟你聊。

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: Horomachistry test
translation: 司辰学检定

text: Success!
translation: 成功!

text: Failure :(
translation: 失败 :(

text: [Exit]
translation: [离开]

text: [Exit]
translation: [离开]

text: Cable-knit vest, cashmere-blend errols, and a pair of saddle-brown oxfords. Clothes of an unassuming cut.
translation: 绞花针织背心,羊绒混纺长裤,一双鞍棕色牛津鞋。剪裁低调的衣着。

text: [Open it.]
translation: [打开它。]

text: [Leave it for now.]
translation: [暂且搁下。]

text: A reassuringly friendly outfit. Comforting and heartening.
translation: 一身让人安心的亲切行头。妥帖而振奋。

text: A reassuringly friendly outfit. Honest and unpretentious.
translation: 一身让人安心的亲切行头。诚实而不矫饰。

text: A reassuringly friendly outfit. Useful.
translation: 一身让人安心的亲切行头。实用。

text: [You can now don the Father's Day outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation: [你现在可以在衣橱换上「父亲节」套装了。]

text: [Until then.]
translation: [到那时再说。]

text: Strikingly modern clothing, made to measure.
translation: 剪裁合体的现代衣着,令人瞩目。

text: [Open it.]
translation: [打开它。]

text: [Leave it for now.]
translation: [暂且搁下。]

text: Black cashmere polo-neck, black notched bag trousers, black suede loafers. A statement. And the statement is:
translation: 黑色羊绒高领衫,黑色缺口廓形长裤,黑色麂皮乐福鞋。一个宣言。而这个宣言是:

text: 'You don't know me. But you'll remember me.'
translation: 「你不认识我。但你会记住我。」

text: 'I'll see you next decade.'
translation: 「我们十年后再见。」

text: 'Guess who!'
translation: 「猜猜我是谁!」

text: [You can now don the Man of Mystery outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation: [你现在可以在衣橱换上「谜样男子」套装了。]

text: [Until then.]
translation: [到那时再说。]

text: Silk scarf, heavy high-waisted woollen trousers, a merino wool submariner jumper, a gabardine drill trench coat. Made to measure for colder climates.
translation: 真丝围巾,厚重的羊毛高腰长裤,一件美利奴羊毛水手厚毛衣,一件华达呢风衣。为更寒冷的气候量身定制。

text: [Open it.]
translation: [打开它。]

text: [Leave it for now.]
translation: [暂且搁下。]

text: I'll cut a dash.
translation: 我要穿出风采。

text: I like the cold.
translation: 我喜欢寒冷。

text: I wonder where I'll wear it? A snow festival? An arctic expedition? At the head of the stairs to an unnamable abyss?
translation: 不知道我会在哪儿穿它?一场冰雪节?一次北极探险?还是在通往不可名状之渊的楼梯顶端?

text: [You can now don the Trenchcoat Brigade outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation: [你现在可以在衣橱换上「风衣纵队」套装了。]

text: [Until then.]
translation: [到那时再说。]

text: [Change your Outfit at the wardrobe; or just by entering your inventory anywhere in this room.]
translation: [在衣橱更换行头;或直接在本房间任意位置打开物品栏即可。]

text: [Consider my Outfit choices.]
translation: [斟酌我的行头选择。]

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: A little ceramic jar, small enough to fit in the palm of the hand, light enough to ride unnoticed in a pocket.
translation: 一只小陶罐,小得恰好能放进掌心,轻得放进口袋也不会引人注意。

text: Open it.
translation: 打开它。

text: Dip a finger in and taste it.
translation: 伸进一根手指,尝一尝。

text: Try to identify it.
translation: 试着辨认它。

text: Leave it for now.
translation: 暂且放着。

text: Inside: a small quantity of viscous, yellow-golden fluid. The mouth of the jar is too narrow to admit much light, but the fluid within glitters like mica in sunlight.
translation: 里面:少量黏稠的金黄色液体。罐口太窄,透不进多少光,但罐中的液体仍像阳光下的云母般闪烁。

text: Sniff it.
translation: 闻一闻。

text: It smells like sunlight on hot stone. As I lower the jar again, flashes of phantom light blur my vision.
translation: 闻起来像热石上的阳光。我把罐子重新放下时,幻影般的闪光模糊了我的视线。

text: Sharp, quartzy . As I lower the jar again, flashes of phantom light blur my vision.
translation: 气味尖锐,如石英。我把罐子重新放下时,幻影般的闪光模糊了我的视线。

text: A bright thing... a holy thing... a thing of vivid colour...
translation: 明亮之物……神圣之物……色彩鲜活之物……

text: A half-guessed memory sparkles infuriatingly at the brain-lobe tip, and is gone. I can't work out what this is.
translation: 一种隐约可辨的记忆在脑叶尖端恼人地闪烁,随即消失。我认不出这是什么。

text: This is a tiny quantity of uzult - one of the Great Inks, the encausta terminalia. The elect of the great libraries - one of them [[Hush House]] - could write determinations of [[History]] in these inks, and the [[Hours]] might choose to take notice...
translation: 这是一小份乌祖尔特——大墨之一,终末彩墨。大图书馆中的遴选者——其中之一便是[[噤声居屋]]——曾以这些墨水书写[[历史]]的裁定,而[[司辰]]们或许会选择留意……

text: Or so the story went. Impossible to prove or disprove. And everything is different now. Still! Uzult! Nice find.
translation: 至少故事是这么说的。无从证明,也无从证伪。而如今一切都已不同。不过!乌祖尔特!真是好收获。
